title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us:
At Rodan Energy, our mission is Making Sustainable, Attainable. As a leading North American energy services company, we provide innovative energy solutions that help clients reduce energy costs and GHG emissions, support electrification, and enhance grid efficiency. With over 20 years of expertise, we’re trusted by North America’s largest energy users, power producers, and utilities.

Why Join Rodan:

  • Thriving Industry: Join a rapidly growing sector at the forefront of innovation and sustainability, shaping the future of energy management.
  • Product Market Fit: With a 98% client retention rate and consistent YOY growth, Rodan has built a reputation for delivering trusted, long-term partnerships with industry leaders.
  • Top Talent & Strong Culture: Collaborate with high-performing, passionate individuals who are committed to excellence and sustainability.

What Makes This Role Great:
  • Direct, Measurable Impact: Your models directly drive customer savings by maximizing battery and price-responsive load (PRL) performance against market price signals and events.
  • Built for Growth: Rodan is building out its central data platform to support a goal of 10x revenue growth in 5 years, centered on energy market optimization across IESO, AESO, PJM, NYISO, MISO, and ERCOT.
  • Modern Data Stack: Work in Databricks (notebooks, MLflow and Unity Catalog Model Registry, serverless compute) with real market and meter data.
  • Structured Ramp-Up: In your first weeks, you'll shadow an external battery optimization build to learn the problem space, provide input, and prepare to take over the project.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build and own optimization models for battery and PRL performance, maximizing value against day-ahead and real-time (DA/RT) price signals, demand response events, and coincident peaks
  • Take ownership of the battery optimization project following an initial shadowing period with the external build team
  • Backtest optimization models against historical market and meter data to validate performance before deployment
  • Track experiments and backtest results systematically in MLflow so model iterations are comparable over time
  • Partner with forecasting data scientists to integrate their forecasts as inputs to your optimization models
  • Partner with Data Engineering on the quality of the data your models depend on
  • Support the expansion of battery and PRL optimization from IESO into AESO, PJM, NYISO, MISO, and ERCOT

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Degree in Operations Research, Applied Math, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience (MSc or PhD preferred)
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building optimization models (mathematical programming, mixed-integer programming, or control-theory approaches) in a production or applied research setting
  • Demonstrated experience backtesting models against historical data and tracking experiment and backtest results systematically (MLflow or a comparable experiment-tracking tool)
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including processing large time-series datasets
  • Experience translating a real-world operational problem (asset dispatch, resource allocation, scheduling) into a mathematical model
  • Ability to work independently in an early-stage, ambiguous environment

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks; Databricks certification is an asset
  • Experience with energy markets, battery storage, or demand response programs
  • Familiarity with commercial or open-source solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, or similar)
  • Experience partnering with data scientists who build forecasting models used as inputs to optimization

Rodan Role, Compensation & Benefits Include:
  • Hybrid: 3 days in office in Mississauga, Ontario
  • Profit sharing Plan
  • Comprehensive health benefits package
  • Group RRSP with employer matching
  • Base salary range of CAD $110,000 to $130,000

Life at Rodan – Our Culture:
At Rodan, we believe a great workplace goes beyond the work itself. Recognized as Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employer of 2026, we’ve built a culture rooted in collaboration, celebration, and giving back. Here’s what you can look forward to when you join the team:
  • Celebrations Throughout the Year: We mark occasions and holidays all year long with team events including holiday parties, team dinners, bowling nights, go-karting, Annual Summer BBQ, golf tournaments, and more.
  • Learning & Growth: Lunch and learns, crossword challenges, and education-funding programs to keep you sharp and growing in your career.
  • Giving Back: Our Employee Initiatives Committee (EIC) organizes food drives and fundraising for local charities throughout the year – and everyone is welcome to get involved.

Apply Now: If you’re an optimization specialist who wants to see your models drive real customer savings in a fast-growing energy market, we want to hear from you!

Hiring Process
Rodan Energy's hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are the right fit: technically, culturally, and professionally. As part of our process, candidates should be aware of the following:
  • Background Check: As part of our hiring process, the successful candidate will be required to complete a background check, which may include a criminal record check, credential verification, and a driver's abstract (if applicable). Professional references will also be collected as part of the process.
  • Assignment: Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical technical assignment. This is an opportunity to demonstrate how you frame an optimization problem, build your model, and validate results against real-world data.

We respect your time and will provide clear instructions and reasonable timelines for any assignments requested.

Referral Bonus: Do you know someone who would be a great fit for our team? We are offering a CAD $2,500 referral bonus for successful referrals that lead to a hire for this role, effective until further notice. Please connect with Jenny Dong at jenny.dong@rodanenergy.com

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure
Rodan Energy may use artificial intelligence tools to support the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants during the recruitment process.

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Rodan Energy Solutions is committed to an inclusive, accessible recruitment and employment experience in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA). Accommodation is available upon request throughout the hiring process and, if hired, during employment. If you require an accommodation, please contact Asmin.Shadir@rodanenergy.com so we can work with you to meet your needs in a manner that respects dignity, independence, integration, and equal opportunity.

title: Director of Product Design
description:

This person will lead ideation, execute on and present designs, scope and push projects forward, and leverage AI tools to create components and other front end builds. The ideal candidate will raise the bar on craft and champion an AI-forward design-to-production pipeline.

This is a crucial role in the organization that will define how 1M+ monthly visitors interact with our digital product for the next 100 years.

What you will do…

  • Pragmatism in a lean, agile, iterative environment; you know when "good enough" is the right decision for the business and when to push for pixel-perfect.
  • A builder's mindset: self-starting, comfortable moving quickly, and energized by shaping both a product and a team.
  • Craft mindset: you are always raising the bar on our designs and inspiring everyone around you to do the same.

title: Software Engineer, Feature Engineering Platform
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Quality Liaison
description:
Job Summary

The Quality Liaison is responsible for supporting daily operations, quality standards, staff accountability, and culture improvement within RiverValley Behavioral Health Children’s Hospital. This position serves as a visible and active resource on the hospital floor to help ensure Team Leads and Behavioral Health Technicians are performing consistently with hospital expectations, safety standards, patient care needs, and organizational values.

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibility over Team Leads or Behavioral Health Technicians. However, the Quality Liaison has functional authority to provide real-time instruction, coaching, redirection, feedback, and escalation when operational or quality expectations are not being met.

The purpose of this role is to strengthen consistency across shifts, improve communication between front-line staff and hospital leadership, support Team Lead accountability, reinforce quality and safety expectations, and help ensure BHTs receive the support needed to perform their roles effectively.

Essential Functions

Operational Support and Floor Presence

  • Maintains a consistent and visible presence throughout the Children’s Hospital.
  • Conducts regular rounding to observe shift flow, staff engagement, coverage, patient safety needs, and adherence to expectations.
  • Assesses whether Team Leads are visible, available, and supporting BHTs appropriately.
  • Provides real-time direction and clarification to Team Leads and BHTs when expectations, assignments, or processes are not being followed.
  • Helps identify operational barriers that impact staff performance, patient safety, communication, or unit consistency.
  • Serves as a resource to staff during high-acuity, escalated, or disorganized shift conditions.

Quality, Safety, and Standards Reinforcement

  • Monitors adherence to hospital policies, patient safety expectations, documentation standards, observation requirements, therapeutic boundaries, and unit procedures.
  • Conducts quality checks and operational audits as assigned by hospital leadership.
  • Identifies patterns of non-compliance or inconsistent practice and communicates findings to appropriate leadership.
  • Reinforces expectations related to patient safety, staff conduct, professionalism, supervision, rounding, documentation, and communication.
  • Supports implementation of quality improvement initiatives within the Children’s Hospital.

Team Lead and BHT Support

  • Observes whether Team Leads are performing the role as intended, including visibility, floor support, communication, coverage coordination, and leadership behavior.
  • Provides coaching and feedback to Team Leads and BHTs regarding performance expectations, professionalism, communication, and adherence to standards.
  • Reviews whether assigned Team Lead processes are being completed, including rounding expectations, handoffs, and coverage communication.
  • Checks in with BHTs to assess whether they feel supported, informed, and equipped during their shift.
  • Identifies concerns related to morale, communication, teamwork, staff support, and culture on the floor.
  • Escalates repeated or significant performance concerns to hospital leadership.

Communication and Process Improvement

  • Provides timely updates to hospital leadership regarding operational concerns, quality issues, staffing support concerns, and Team Lead performance.
  • Escalates urgent safety, compliance, patient care, or staff conduct concerns immediately to appropriate leadership.
  • Documents observations, coaching conversations, audits, and follow-up needs as directed.
  • Assists and leads onboarding, MANDT training and retraining, and ongoing education for Team Leads and BHTs.
  • Serves as a communication bridge between hospital leadership and front-line staff.

Functional Authority and Role Boundaries

The Quality Liaison has authority to provide real-time instruction, coaching, redirection, and feedback to Team Leads and BHTs regarding operational expectations, quality standards, patient safety, communication, professionalism, and process compliance.

The position may require immediate correction of observed operational, safety, quality, or compliance concerns and may escalate repeated concerns or failure to follow direction to hospital leadership and Human Resources.

This position does not have independent authority to hire, terminate, discipline, approve timecards, approve leave, or make final employment decisions. Those responsibilities remain with designated hospital leadership and Human Resources.

This job description represents an overview of the responsibilities for the above referenced position. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive list of responsibilities. An employee should perform all duties as assigned by his/ her supervisor.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by the employee’s ability to maintain a visible presence on the floor, identify and communicate concerns timely, provide effective coaching and feedback, help improve consistency in Team Lead performance, support BHTs, assist leadership in verifying expectations are being followed, and contribute to improved culture, communication, safety, and accountability within the Children’s Hospital.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

  • Ability to work in a behavioral health hospital environment.
  • Ability to walk, stand, and move throughout assigned units for extended periods.
  • Ability to respond to urgent or high-acuity situations as needed.
  • Ability to teach, demonstrate, and fully perform MANDT techniques on both the hospital unit and in the training classroom.
  • May be exposed to emotionally escalated situations, behavioral health crises, and other conditions common to an inpatient psychiatric setting.
  • Must follow all safety, infection control, patient rights, confidentiality, and organizational policies.

Why Choose RiverValley?

RiverValley is now a Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC), expanding access to high-quality, integrated care in the communities we serve. Join a mission-driven organization committed to clinical excellence, professional growth, and meaningful impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive pay

  • Comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, Telehealth)

  • Paid time off + 9 holidays

  • Retirement plan options

  • Tuition reimbursement + free CEUs

  • Clinical supervision

  • Wellness & employee assistance programs

  • Mileage reimbursement for work related travel

  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) - eligible employer

title: Senior Infor M3 Technical Analyst
description:
Senior Infor M3 Technical Analyst

Location: Christchurch, New Zealand

About Us

HamiltonJet is a highly regarded global leader in marine propulsion systems, serving customers around the world. Our products and services are trusted by boat builders, naval architects, commercial operators, defence organisations, and a diverse range of end users in more than 120 countries. Renowned for reliability and performance in demanding applications, HamiltonJet continues to set the standard for waterjet propulsion technology. To learn more about our company, products, and services, visit HamiltonJet.

We are seeking a Senior Infor M3 Technical Analyst to join our ERP Development & Support team in Christchurch. This is an excellent opportunity to take the senior technical lead on Infor M3 CE and Infor OS solutions within a well-established precision engineering business that is continuing to invest in its core systems.

The successful applicant will be employed on a full-time, permanent basis, reporting to the ERP Development & Support Manager.

The Opportunity

HamiltonJet is engaged in a program of continuous investment in its underlying systems. As Senior Infor M3 Technical Analyst, you will design, build and deliver technical solutions across Infor M3 CE and the Infor OS platform, including integrations, business rules, automation and scripting.

This is a hands-on, Level 3 technical role. Around 80% of your time will be spent on technical delivery for projects and improvement work, with the balance split between M3 administration and deep technical escalation. Level 1 and Level 2 support and user training sit elsewhere in the team. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking the senior technical lead on M3 project and improvement work, from solution design and build through to configuration, testing and deployment.

  • Designing, building and maintaining ION integrations between M3 and internal and external systems, including document flows, mappings, connection points, monitors and alarms.

  • Building business rules, business messages and event-driven automation that remove manual effort from business processes.

  • Developing H5 scripts and personalisations, and developing and consuming M3 APIs (MI programs, ION APIs, REST), including API Gateway configuration.

  • Monitoring integration health, diagnosing failures and driving permanent fixes at root cause.

  • Carrying out M3 and Infor OS administration, including security and user roles, environment configuration, and coordination of Infor releases and updates.

  • Acting as the deep technical escalation point for the M3 support team, and managing support incidents with Infor and third-party partners.

  • Designing and leading data quality initiatives, including auditing, cleansing and validation, and building the technical tooling to support them.

  • Leading system testing for M3 changes, integrations and releases, including test design, regression testing and release verification.

  • Producing technical design documentation and applying consistent standards for naming, version control and change management.

  • Building constructive relationships with M3 users across the business and leading technical improvements that address recurring pain points.

As our investment program develops, the scope of this role is expected to grow. We are looking for someone who wants to build their influence over time, taking the technical lead on larger pieces of work, shaping how solutions are designed and delivered, and contributing to the direction of our wider ERP and integration roadmap. Your development in this direction will be actively supported.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Significant hands-on experience with Infor M3 (typically 4+ years), with strong technical skills across core M3 modules and configuration.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and building ION integrations between M3 and other systems.

  • Practical experience with business rules, business messages and event-driven automation in M3 / Infor OS.

  • Scripting and development capability, including H5 scripting (JavaScript) and working with M3 APIs (MI programs, ION APIs, REST).

  • The ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex technical M3 issues, including root-cause analysis across integrations and configuration.

  • A sound understanding of technical delivery discipline, including design documentation, version control, testing and change management.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, initiative, and a collaborative, customer-focused mindset with a willingness to share your knowledge.

  • The right to work in New Zealand.

Experience as a technical lead on ERP projects, M3 CE (Cloud), Infor OS administration and release management, Data Lake, Compass SQL or Birst, API Gateway management, Infor Document Management (IDM), Experience Designer or workflow configuration, other ERP systems (such as SAP, Oracle or Dynamics), or the manufacturing or engineering industry would be highly regarded. A relevant tertiary qualification in Information Systems, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline is an advantage, though equivalent practical experience is equally valued.

Why Join HamiltonJet?

This is an opportunity to join a high-performing global organisation that values craftsmanship, teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will work alongside skilled professionals who take pride in delivering world-class products to customers around the globe.

What We Offer

  • Full-time, permanent employment.

  • Competitive salary package, depending on skills and experience.

  • The opportunity to work for a global industry leader.

  • A senior technical role with genuine scope to grow your influence over the ERP and integration roadmap.

  • A supportive team environment with opportunities for ongoing training and career development.

How to Apply

If you are a hands-on Infor M3 technical specialist looking for a long-term opportunity with a respected and growing company, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV and cover letter via the Quick Apply link on SEEK. Applications close on Friday 23rd October 2026

Position Summary

The Quality Assurance (QA) Coordinator is responsible for strengthening internal accountability, consistency, and compliance statewide across Agency for Persons with Disabilities (APD) operations. This position plays a critical role in evaluating compliance with Federal and State law, rule, and code; internal processes; agency systems such as iConnect, identifying risks and compliance gaps, and supporting leadership with data-driven recommendations for improvement. This position is required to work in assigned office or headquarters. This position is not eligible for telework. This position will require travel to regions and community locations throughout the state.

The Work You Will Do

Conduct comprehensive internal quality assurance audits of APD programs and operations, regional processes, units, and operational processes to assess compliance with applicable statutes, rules, policies, contractual requirements, and internal operating procedures.

Develop, maintain, and implement standardized audit tools, methodologies, and schedules to ensure consistency, objectivity, and reliability of internal reviews.

Develop and maintain Quality Assurance operating procedures, tools, guidance documents, and workflows to support consistent execution of QA activities across the agency.

Analyze audit findings to identify systemic trends, risks, strengths, and opportunities for improvement, with focus on operational efficiency, compliance, and service quality.

Prepare clear, concise, and actionable written audit reports for leadership that summarizes findings, root causes, and prioritized recommendations for corrective or preventative action.

Provide recommendations to executive and program leadership regarding enhancements to operating procedures, internal controls, quality assurance practices, and policy alignment based on audit results and best practices.

Collaborate with program areas, leadership, and subject matter experts to clarify expectations, interpret requirements, and support corrective action planning following audits.

Monitor and track follow-up actions and corrective measures to assess effectiveness and ensure sustained compliance and improvement.

Serve as a technical resource and advisor to leadership and staff on quality assurance principles, internal controls, and continuous quality improvement strategies.

Support leadership in preparing summaries, briefings, and presentations related to quality assurance findings, trends, and agency-wide improvement initiatives.

Keep current on state and federal regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices relevant to APD programs and quality assurance activities.

Perform other related duties assigned to support APD’s mission, strategic priorities, and commitment to accountability and service excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience related to analyzing program requirements and auditing data to provide qualitative and quantitative data for decision- making.
  • Experience related to providing technical assistance and customer service to ensure accurate interpretation and implementation of federal and state requirements.
  • Experience related to evaluating the reliability and validity of reported data to provide recommendations and viable solutions to complex problems.
  • Experience analyzing and evaluating policies and procedures to determine compliance with federal, state, and agency requirements.
  • Experience in customer service.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited college or university preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge of:

  • APD service delivery systems including Quality Management Remediation components and DD/HCBS Handbooks.
  • Quality Systems and technical applications. of current CMS Assurances/Sub-assurance requirements and reporting.
  • Microsoft Suite – Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Intermediate to advanced skills working with data in Microsoft Excel.
  • Software development lifecycle to include design, build, and test.

Ability to:

  • Work independently and be detail oriented.
  • Utilize problem- solving techniques.
  • Write and edit using proper grammar and writing style outlined by agency and program requirements.
  • Manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, set goals, and develop systems for achieving those goals.
  • Analyze available information, observations, and evidence to determine appropriate action.

Demonstrate Skills in:

title: Senior Data Engineer (Remote)
description:
The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an experienced Senior Data Engineer who will be an exceptional addition to our growing engineering team. The Senior Data Engineer will work closely with engineering, product managers and data science teams to meet data requirements of various initiatives in Hyatt.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will take on big data challenges in an agile way. In this role, you will build data pipelines that enable engineers, analysts and other stakeholders across the organization. You will build data models to deliver insightful analytics while ensuring the highest standard in data integrity. You will integrate different data sources, improve the efficiency, reliability, and latency of our data system, help automate data pipelines, and improve our data model and overall architecture. You will be leading multiple data projects with planned and coordinated execution and on-time delivery of quality products.

You will be part of a highly visible, collaborative and passionate data engineering team and will be working on all the aspects of design, development and implementation of scalable and reliable data products and pipelines.

Applying the latest techniques and approaches across the domains of data engineering, and machine learning engineering isn’t just a nice to have, it’s a must.

This candidate builds fantastic relationships across all levels of the organization and is recognized as a problem solver who looks to elevate the work of everyone around them. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important\: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care for Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include\:

· Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally

· Flexible work schedule

· Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center

· A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption

· Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Overview

The Senior Data Engineer designs, develops, and supports scalable data products, platforms, and pipelines that enable operational reporting, business intelligence, self-service analytics, and advanced AI capabilities. This role partners with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into reliable, high-quality technical solutions while providing operational leadership and solving complex data-engineering challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with product managers, data scientists, machine-learning teams, business stewards, engineering teams, and program management to define product features, business deliverables, and data-product strategies.
  • Collaborate with business partners, operations teams, and senior management to provide day-to-day operational support and resolve data-related issues.
  • Support operational reporting, self-service data-engineering initiatives, production data pipelines, business-intelligence platforms, and the advancement of AI capabilities.
  • Engage with diverse stakeholders to gather and understand business requirements, assess feasibility and impact, and deliver high-quality solutions on schedule.
  • Design scalable, secure, and sustainable data solutions, recommending alternative approaches when appropriate.
  • Work with high-volume datasets, optimize database queries, and resolve complex technical problems across data platforms and pipelines.
  • Acquire, ingest, transform, and integrate large and complex datasets using modern data-engineering technologies.
  • Contribute to multiple projects, priorities, and business demands simultaneously while maintaining quality and delivery commitments.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, and iterative environment.
  • Exercise independent judgment in selecting methods, technologies, and approaches to achieve business and technical objectives.
  • Participate actively in an Agile/Scrum environment, including planning, estimation, refinement, delivery, and continuous improvement.
  • Promote data quality, reliability, scalability, observability, security, and operational excellence across data products and platforms.
  • Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and architectural decisions.

Core Competencies

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical expertise, sound judgment, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and a commitment to delivering practical business outcomes. The candidate also reflects Hyatt’s core values of respect, integrity, humility, empathy, creativity, and fun in every aspect of their work.

title: Member Experience Consultant I
description:
Who We Are

We have the fundamental belief that we, as an organization, can and will improve lives. Rooted in the centuries-old credit union philosophy of people helping people, we maintain a simple premise. Those we interact with will receive equal and just treatment, devoid of intolerance, false judgment, racism, or discrimination of any kind. We must not accept less if we are to fulfill our mission, "We Improve Lives." This mission empowers us to serve the greater good and to make a difference in our world. Our cooperative structure creates a cycle of mutual assistance towards the common goal of the financial well-being of members.

At Black Hills Federal Credit Union (BHFCU), we’re committed to improving the lives of our members every day, and we look for people who share that passion. Don’t have a ton of financial industry experience? No problem. Our onboarding includes an orientation program with ongoing training to help staff further their career at BHFCU by building on their existing strengths.

General Purpose:

Responsible for providing outstanding lending and member service while actively encouraging and educating members on utilization of ITMs and other credit union products and services.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Welcome members to the Branch and guide them to the ITMs when appropriate. Provide education for using the ITMs.
  • Responsible for performing teller transactions, when appropriate, to include but not limited to change orders and business deposits.
  • Perform member service tasks on a daily basis to include but not limited to: opening new consumer memberships, new youth memberships, maintenance of all account types, credit card applications, assisting members with online banking support, instant issue and member select PIN requests, quick draw loans, wire transfers, notaries, ordering checks, address and phone number updates, opening certificates and sub share accounts, changing account types, funding both personal and auto loans, and closing memberships.
  • Responsible for providing information and taking applications for a variety of consumer loans including auto and recreational vehicle loans, personal loans, credit cards, and secured loans following Credit Union procedures and policies. Follow-up and maintain pending loan queue. Maintain loan information and follow-up documentation. Assist members with loan payment issues.
  • Remain current on changes within the legal, regulatory, economic, competitive, and technology environments that may affect the Teller, Member Services, and Lending functions.
  • Responsible for obtaining clear title to collateral and dealing knowledgably with all title and CPI issues. Assist members with CPI issues.
  • Educate and inform members of all BHFCU products and services, and cross-sell when applicable, using the ENGAGE model. Make referrals when appropriate.
  • Performance expectations to meet appropriate production goals.

Other Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Maintain account accuracy by working various reports, workflows, and projects as requested.
  • When applicable, request members to bring accounts positive and to maintain minimum balance requirements. Request members make payments on delinquent loans or over-the-limit-credit card balances.
  • Provide coverage at other Branch locations, in the contact center, or through other channels as needed.
  • Build relationships with local businesses and community organizations with the direction of the Branch Manager or Market VP.
  • Perform other duties as may be assigned.

Job Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of laws and regulations affecting teller, member service, and lending transactions.
  • Knowledge of general ledger accounts pertinent to the department.
  • Knowledge of the credit union's products and services.
  • Knowledge of organization's policies/procedures and Credit Union's service philosophy.
  • Knowledge of safety and security programs includes but not limited to information security, alarms, robberies, bomb threats and extortion.
  • Knowledge of Credit Union's in-house computer system, Internet, and any relevant software programs.
  • Knowledge and delivery of the ENGAGE model.
  • Knowledge of opening and closing procedures.

Job Qualifications (Skills):

BHFCU is committed to working with its employees to reasonably accommodate them with the physical aspects of the position. The following list outlines the physical considerations that are normally encountered in this job.

  • Vision: A sighted person to handle cash transactions and verify financial transactions. Ability to complete necessary paperwork.
  • Speech/Hearing: Ability to communicate verbally and in writing with staff, members and vendors.
  • Manual Dexterity: Ability to perform necessary computer-related input.
  • Physical Mobility: Must be able to man teller window and remain standing for prolonged periods of time.
    1. Ability to carry bags of coin or other items up to 30 lbs. occasionally throughout the day.
    2. Ability to work flexible hours

Job Qualifications (Ability):

  • Ability to understand and follow complex written and verbal instructions and disseminate that knowledge in a clear and understandable format to others.
  • Ability to operate multiple monitors and software systems simultaneously without interfering with member service.
  • Ability to express oneself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
  • Ability to interact positively with co-workers, management, and the public to promote a team effort and maintain a positive attitude even under extreme pressure.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain confidential records and reports.
  • Ability to produce a high volume of work in a timely manner that is accurate, complete, and of high quality. Ability to prioritize work. Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to analyze out-of-balance situations, statistics, and financial data. Gather, assemble, correlate, and interpret facts and develop solutions.
  • Ability to work within standardized guidelines with latitude to make decisions and take initiative to resolve problems even in unique circumstances.
  • Ability to use a rational and organized approach to completing tasks.

Job Qualifications (Education/Experience) - Job Levels:

Member Experience Consultant I

  • Two-year college level of language, math and reasoning skills or equivalent experience. Zero to two years of relevant experience preferred. Meets the essential job duties/responsibilities, job knowledge, and job qualifications. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.
  • Performance expectations to meet Tier I production goals.

Member Experience Consultant II

  • Two-year college level of language, math and reasoning skills. Two to five years of relevant experience preferred. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.
  • Meets all qualifications for a Member Experience Consultant I
  • Have an elevated understanding of all knowledge requirements (refer to job knowledge).
  • Responsible for opening IRAs, business accounts, estate accounts, and trust accounts.
  • Responsible for providing information and taking applications for all loans required of an MXC I, and home equity loans, home improvement loans, mobile home loans and business loans following Credit Union procedures and policies.
  • Performance expectations to meet Tier II production goals.

Member Experience Consultant III

  • Four-year college level of language, math, and reasoning skills. Five to seven years of experience in lending and member service (or equivalent) is required. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.
  • Meets all qualifications for a Member Experience Consultant II.
  • Have an advanced understanding of all knowledge requirements (refer to job knowledge).
  • Performance expectations to meet Tier III production goals.

Member Experience Consultant IV

  • Four year-college level of language, math, and reasoning skills. Seven or more years of experience in lending and member services is required; equivalent experience in the financial services industry may be considered. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.
  • Meets all qualifications for a Member Experience Consultant III
  • Have an expert understanding of all knowledge requirements (refer to job knowledge).
  • Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization and with outside parties.
  • Assist in ensuring procedures are up to date by informing the appropriate staff or updating procedures as requested by supervisor.
  • Acts as a back-up to the Branch manager, if requested.
  • Performance expectations to meet Tier IV production goals.

Production/Business Track

  • Ability to take applications for commercial/business loans. Gather documentation as needed to support the deposit and/or lending needs of the business member.
  • Seek opportunities to expand Credit Union relationships by actively recruiting business customers and pursuing a business development relationship with the business and their employees.

Leadership Track

  • Working knowledge of management techniques to enhance staff productivity and serve as a mentor to peers.
  • Ability to work within established guidelines with latitude to make decisions and take initiative to resolve problems or unique circumstances.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and promote collaboration with peers. Maintains a professional, friendly, and courteous manner.

Working Conditions:

Material and Equipment Involved

  • Interactive Teller Machines
  • Drive-up Equipment
  • In-House Computer System
  • Multi-functional Device
  • Instant Issue Machine
  • 10-Key Calculator
  • Self-service Coin Machine
  • Coin Counter / Sorter / Roller
  • Currency Counter
  • Scanner
  • ZON Terminal
  • In-House instant messaging system
  • Salesforce

Work Environment/Physical Activities

Occasional travel to one of BHFCU’s branch locations or attendance at community events may be required.

Job requires limited physical effort. It is primarily a desk assignment. Work is performed within a highly structured and closely supervised environment. Ability to function in a fast-paced area. Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Work creates normal fatigue daily. Work creates moderate stress during certain periods during daily routine. Job does not have specific volume and pace of work standards except that the job requires that members be served in the timeliest manner possible. Job requires extensive member contact on a continual basis. The job calls for a high degree of mental concentration to interpret and act upon a wide range of situations. The job requires a degree of attention to detail.

Physical Requirements

Perform primarily sedentary work with limited physical exertion and occasional lifting of up to 5 lbs. Must be capable of climbing/descending stairs in emergency situation. Must be able to operate routine office equipment including telephone, copier, facsimile, and calculator. Must be able to routinely perform work on computer for an average of 6-8 hours per day. Must be able to work extended hours whenever required or requested by management. Must by capable of regular, reliable and timely attendance.

Working Conditions

Must be able to routinely perform work indoors in climate-controlled shared work area with moderate noise.

Mental and/or Emotional Requirements

Must be able to perform job functions with supervision and work effectively either on own or as part of a team. Must be able to read and carry out various instructions and follow oral instructions. Must be able to speak clearly and deliver information in a logical and understandable sequence. Must be able to perform basic mathematical calculations with extreme accuracy. Must be capable of dealing calmly and professionally with numerous different personalities from diverse cultures at various levels within and outside of the organization and demonstrate highest levels of customer service and discretion when dealing with the public. Must be able to perform responsibilities with composure under the stress of deadlines/requirements for extreme accuracy and quality and/or fast pace. Must be able to effectively handle multiple, simultaneous, and changing priorities. Must be capable of exercising highest level of discretion on confidential matters.

Notice: This job description is not intended to be, nor should it be construed as, a contract or guarantee of employment. Black Hills Federal Credit Union adheres to all federal and state labor laws regarding termination and probationary periods. This position is also subject to all the personnel policies of Black Hills Federal Credit Union. Changes may be made to this job description at any time by the President. title: Licensing Analyst Supervisor
description:
About this Job

To safeguard the life and health of the citizens of Louisiana by ensuring that persons practicing as Registered Nurses and Advanced Practice Registered Nurses are competent and safe.

Overview
This highly responsible advanced-level supervisory position is responsible for supervising and coordinating departmental work to ensure that Registered Nurse (RN) licenses are timely issued to all eligible and qualified persons. The individual is responsible and accountable to meet the mission of the LSBN to safeguard the life and health of the citizens of Louisiana by ensuring that individuals granted a license are compliant with the requirements of the Board for eligibility for licensure.

Also, as part of the licensure process, this position supervises the verification of licensure to other Boards of Nursing, employers, etc. Frequent contact with RNs, employers and credentialing agencies is required. Collaborate with analysts, investigators, and administrative coordinators in other divisions related to issues that affect the credentialing of RNs seeking licensure. The collection, analysis, and dissemination of data related to nursing licensure are inherent in this role. Requires management/supervision experience as well as knowledge and experience in nursing practice and regulation.

Key Competencies

  • Accepting Direction: The ability to be open and willing to follow guidance or instructions.

  • Building and Supporting Teams: The ability to combine one's actions and efforts with others to work toward achieving a common goal.

  • Communicating Effectively: The ability to convey information, ideas, and emotions using structured communication methods that promote understanding and engagement.

  • Developing Plans: The ability to create structured strategies and plans that support the achievement of defined goals and objectives.

  • Driving Results: The ability to set and pursue goals, maintain focus amid competing demands, and deliver results.

  • Following Policies and Procedures: The ability to follow, reinforce, adapt, or develop policies and procedures to maintain compliance with federal and state legal requirements, State Civil Service rules, and organizational policies.

  • Making Accurate Judgments: The ability to assess options, weigh risks, and make sound decisions using available information and logical reasoning.

  • Managing Performance: The ability to plan, monitor, and document employee performance throughout the year.

  • Thinking Critically: The ability to analyze information objectively, identify connections across sources, and form logical, well-supported conclusions.

  • Training Others: The ability to design and deliver training experiences that build knowledge, develop skills, and improve performance.


Minimum Qualifications

Six years of experience in the issuance, maintenance, or reinstatement of licenses; OR

Six years of full-time work experience in any field plus three years of experience in the issuance, maintenance, or reinstatement of licenses; OR

A bachelor's degree plus three years of experience in the issuance, maintenance, or reinstatement of licenses; OR

An advanced degree plus two years of experience in the issuance, maintenance, or reinstatement of licenses.

EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION:
Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full-time work experience in any field. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any field.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

Job Duties:

  • Responsible /accountable for supervisory functions. Responsible for productivity and quality of subordinates' work. Provides input into subordinates PES planning sessions and recommends appropriate action and ongoing evaluation of subordinates' performance.
  • Interviews and recommend candidates for vacancies. Recommends subordinates for promotions. Determines work assignments, priorities, and procedures for subordinates.
  • Resolves technical problems entailing responsibility for counseling subordinate and finding solutions to problems subordinate is unable to resolve. Resolves complaints from subordinates.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
About the role:

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager to be Rezdy's dependable NA presence — covering the hours our Sydney/Melbourne-based PM and dev team aren't online. This is a strong fit for someone energized by operational rigor and real-time problem-solving: comfortable triaging under pressure, translating between technical and commercial audiences, and building product judgment by working closely alongside a senior PM rather than owning a roadmap from day one. Pacific timezone

What you'll do:

  • Connect the time zones. Be the dependable daily link between North America stakeholders — support and account management teams — and the Sydney/Melbourne-based PM and dev team, flagging decisions and blockers in real time rather than letting them wait for the next overlap window.
  • Be the NA distribution conduit for Commercial leads and distribution partners (Viator, GYG, etc) and Distribution Resellers
  • Keep incidents moving and visible during NA hours. Triage escalations that occur in NA working hours against a defined severity framework, looping in the senior PM and dev lead when judgment calls exceed current scope, and making sure NA support and AM teams get clear, live updates rather than waiting for the next AU working day.
  • Surface and track AM churn risk. Own intake of NA account-manager-flagged churn risk — capturing impact and urgency the moment it's raised — so it's framed and ready to compete fairly when the senior PM and dev lead plan the sprint.
  • Answer for what's in flight. Be NA's go-to for "is this expected / is this known / what's the status" questions on Booking Manager and Distribution, working from close sync with the senior PM's roadmap and known-issues context rather than independent authority over it.
  • Share release communication in NA hours. Help execute the existing release process — communication and post-release follow-up specifically during NA hours — rather than owning release planning or prioritization.
  • Partner with Engineering at a working level. Build enough fluency in our data architecture to relay NA-side context accurately to engineering, without owning technical trade-off decisions.
  • Put AI tools to work. Use AI tools to speed up research, troubleshooting, and day-to-day tasks — a lever for moving faster, not a replacement for judgment.

What you'll bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in product management, product operations, or a closely related operational/customer-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Comfort working within another PM's priorities and roadmap — bringing your own judgment and context to how that work gets executed
  • Experience with incident or issue management processes, and communicating through them clearly under time pressure.
  • Comfort working with legacy technology systems and the teams that maintain them — able to translate between legacy constraints and current product priorities for both engineering and commercial audiences.
  • Strong written communication skills — able to adjust tone and depth for audiences ranging from support and account management teams to engineering.
  • Ease operating in process-driven environments (Jira, Slack, or equivalent).
  • Comfort picking up domain concepts across different product types — e.g., transactional booking flows versus distribution/channel connectivity — without needing deep expertise in both on day one.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the travel, tours, or activities booking software space.
  • Familiarity with multi-brand or multi-product portfolios (Expedition Software operates Checkfront, Rezdy, and Regiondo).
  • Prior experience in a support, account management, or customer-facing product role.
The salary range for this position is $70,000-$95,000 CAD, commensurate with years of experience, skillset, and qualifications.

title: Senior Fabric Engineer
description:
Position Title

Senior Fabric Engineer

Position Location

Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States


Salary

AI2IO recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.


Job Summary

The Senior Fabric Engineer leads the architecture and hands-on build of AI2IO’s next-generation enterprise data platform on Microsoft Fabric. Reporting into the Business Intelligence function, this role is responsible for designing and implementing a governed Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) lakehouse architecture that consolidates data from Deltek Vantagepoint, project performance systems, HRIS, and financial systems into a single, trustworthy foundation for reporting, forecasting, and future AI-enabled analytics.


This is a deeply technical, builder-focused role. The Senior Fabric Engineer partners closely with the Director of Business

Intelligence and a Data Analyst to translate validated business definitions and source-system lineage into a well-modeled,

performant, and maintainable data platform — including ingestion pipelines, Delta Lake table design, dimensional modeling,

and the deployment standards that keep the platform reliable as it scales.


The ideal candidate has hands-on experience standing up or significantly modernizing an enterprise data warehouse on the Microsoft data stack, is comfortable working from imperfect or undocumented legacy source systems, and takes pride in building a platform other people can trust.


Essential Functions

Platform Architecture & Implementation

  • Design and Build the Fabric Lakehouse: Architect and implement the Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) layer structure in Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Lake table design, partitioning strategy, and performance optimization
  • Own Data Ingestion & Integration: Design and build ingestion pipelines from source systems — including Deltek
  • Vantagepoint, Power BI semantic models, project performance data, and financial/HRIS systems — into the Bronze layer, with appropriate error handling and monitoring
  • Establish the Dimensional Model: Design and build a proper dimensional (Dim/Fact) model in the Silver/Gold layers that replaces ad hoc, view-on-view logic with clean, conformed dimensions and auditable fact tables
  • Set Deployment Standards: Define and implement CI/CD, version control, environment promotion, and release standards for the data platform in partnership with the BI operating model and Azure DevOps backlog

Platform Engineering & Reliability

  • Ensure Data Quality at the Source: Build validation, reconciliation, and monitoring into ingestion and transformation pipelines so that data quality issues are caught before they reach reporting layers
  • Optimize for Scale and Cost: Monitor and tune Fabric capacity usage, pipeline performance, and storage costs as the platform grows in scope and usage
  • Document the Platform: Maintain clear technical documentation of pipeline logic, table schemas, and lineage from source system through to the Gold layer, in support of the broader KPI certification and governance effort

Partnership & Delivery

  • Partner with the Data Analyst: Translate validated business requirements, KPI definitions, and source-data findings from the Data Analyst into concrete platform design decisions
  • Support Governance: Work with the Director of Business Intelligence and the KPI Governance Council to ensure the platform enforces, rather than works around, agreed-upon metric definitions
  • Enable Forecasting & AI Enablement: Build the platform foundation needed to support enterprise revenue and IT forecasting initiatives, and future AI-assisted reporting and data Q&A capabilities

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned


Position Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, and Delta Lake, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture patterns
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing dimensional (Dim/Fact) data models for enterprise reporting
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with SQL Server, including reading and reverse-engineering complex, layered legacy views
  • Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines from ERP, financial, or project-based systems (experience with Deltek Vantagepoint or similar professional services ERP systems is a plus)
  • Working knowledge of Power BI semantic models and DAX sufficient to collaborate effectively with BI/analytics stakeholders
  • Experience establishing deployment, version control, and release standards for data platforms, ideally using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to work independently from ambiguous or incomplete requirements, and to raise data quality or governance concerns proactively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical decisions clearly for a non-engineering audience
  • Demonstrated aptitude for learning new technology and adapting to evolving requirements


Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.


Education / Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related discipline

PLUS

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform roles, including hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, or comparable modern lakehouse platforms
  • Experience working on an enterprise data warehouse or BI modernization initiative, ideally within a professional services, project-based, or similarly complex operating environment


Benefits

AI2IO offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

title: 072408  Student Services Program Coordinator II (Academic Advisor)
description: ADVISING: The academic advisor will follow the advising plan designated by the College to advise students following the Appreciative Advising model. The advisor will provide personalized, one-on-one academic advising to students, helping them navigate their educational pathways. The advisor will assist students in understanding degree requirements, developing academic plans, and exploring potential career opportunities. Advisors are expected to offer guidance on course selection, academic progress, and opportunities for co-curricular involvement to support student success while working through a Guided Pathways framework. This includes helping students identify and pursue clear, structured academic pathways; promoting early engagement in academic planning; and ensuring students are aware of resources that will help them stay on track toward graduation. CASE MANAGEMENT: The academic advisor will manage a caseload of 200 - 400 students, maintaining detailed records of interactions, academic progress, and personal concerns. The advisor will have check-ins with students at 15, 30, and 45 credit hours earned. The role involves monitoring student progress through regular interactions, identifying at-risk students, and providing targeted interventions. The advisor will utilize case management strategies to offer personalized support, including referrals to campus resources such as tutoring, counseling, or career services as needed. Monitor and provide resources for students taking six or more credit hours online TECHNOLOGY: The academic advisor will use various advising and student success technologies to track academic progress, maintain records, and provide proactive support. This includes using a Student Information System (SIS), degree audit tools, advising platforms, and communication tools to monitor and advise students. The advisor will stay current on technological advancements in advising and utilize these tools to enhance the student experience and streamline advising practices. Advisors will use the advising system of record for advising appointments. The advisor will provide advising appointments both in-person and virtually, including at non-traditional times. Track students taking six or more credit hours online. ENROLLMENT: The academic advisor will support students through the enrollment process by providing guidance on course registration, program selection, and understanding prerequisites. They will assist students in reviewing their schedules and ensuring that they meet all necessary academic deadlines. Advisors will also offer proactive assistance in navigating any barriers related to enrollment, including waitlist management, course changes, and prerequisite issues. The advisor will participate at college events, extended hours, and peak advising times during heavy enrollment periods as needed. TRAINING: The academic advisor will engage in regular training and professional development to stay informed about the latest trends, best practices, and institutional policies in academic advising. Training will focus on enhancing advising skills, improving knowledge of student support resources, and staying up-to-date on emerging technologies and advising strategies. This includes attending workshops, webinars, and training sessions offered by the College or external organizations. The advisor will participate in Advising Training Academy each fall and spring, attend the college-wide advising meeting held on the first Wednesday of each month, and meet a minimum score on the advising training assessment yearly. The advisor is responsible for maintaining current knowledge of FERPA, college policies and procedures, especially those related to advising. COLLABORATION: The academic advisor will represent advising on various college committees and events related to enrollment management and advising. The advisor will collaborate closely with faculty, staff, and other campus departments to ensure a holistic approach to student support. This includes participating in interdisciplinary teams, attending departmental meetings, and working with other support services (such as tutoring or counseling) to create a coordinated support system. The advisor will actively contribute to implementing and continuously improving the Guided Pathways framework. Collaboration will also extend to community partners to provide students with external resources and opportunities. PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: The academic advisor is expected to engage in ongoing professional development opportunities. This includes attending conferences, webinars, and workshops related to advising, student success, and higher education trends. The advisor will also contribute to the professional community by sharing best practices, participating in advising networks, and staying informed about innovations in student support. title: Director of R & D and Quality
description:
The Director of R&D and Quality is responsible for leading the company's research and development, technical service, process development, scale-up, and quality functions, with a primary emphasis on supporting polyurethane toll manufacturing customers. This position leads the successful transition of laboratory-developed products and processes into commercial manufacturing.

Working closely with customers, Operations, Sales, Purchasing, and other internal stakeholders, the Director translates customer requirements into practical, scalable, and commercially viable solutions. The role is accountable for ensuring that new products and processes meet customer specifications, perform consistently at production scale, and support the company's revenue growth, profitability, and long-term customer relationships.

This position also provides leadership for quality assurance and quality control, ensuring that products, processes, and systems consistently meet established specifications, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory and quality standards.

Core job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Lead the transition of new and modified polyurethane formulations from laboratory development through pilot trials, process validation, and full-scale commercial production.

  • Partner directly with customers to understand technical requirements, product performance expectations, processing needs, and commercial objectives.

· Translate customer concepts, specifications, and performance targets into laboratory development plans and commercially viable formulations.

· Lead formulation development, raw material evaluations, performance testing, troubleshooting, and product optimization.

· Identify opportunities to expand the company's technical capabilities, product offerings, and toll manufacturing business.

· Establish project priorities based on customer commitments, business growth opportunities, technical feasibility, and expected financial returns.

· Collaborate with Chemical Process Engineering and Operations to establish manufacturing procedures, process parameters, quality controls, and acceptance criteria for new products.

· Troubleshoot scale-up challenges, investigate deviations between laboratory and production results, and implement corrective actions to achieve consistent product performance.

· Identify and mitigate technical, operational, safety, and quality risks associated with new formulations and process changes.

· Serve as a senior technical resource for polyurethane toll manufacturing customers, building strong working relationships with customer technical teams, chemists, engineers, and decision makers.

· Lead technical discussions regarding new product development, formulation modifications, process requirements, product specifications, and manufacturing feasibility.

· Provide leadership and oversight for the company's quality function, ensuring effective implementation and maintenance of the Quality Management System.

· Monitor quality performance metrics and implement improvements that reduce scrap, rework, customer complaints, and manufacturing variability.

· Manage both the Analytical and R&D laboratories.

· Lead, develop, and mentor R&D, laboratory, process engineering, and quality personnel, establishing clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and accountability.

· Approve Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for new chemical raw materials.

· Utilize strong, professional communication (oral and written), organizational, and leadership skills.

· This position requires the ability to work in an environment with rapidly changing priorities.

Note: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the core job responsibilities.

title: Field Technician - 2 Hours Weekly
description:
Get Paid to Drive Your Route. Work When It Works for You.

Field Technician — FreshPure Water Machines

1099 Independent Contractor | $25/hr | St. Louis, MO

If you like working independently, hate being stuck at a desk, and want a consistent route you can count on — this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

NWS operates water vending machines in retail stores across the country. We’re building a team of Field Technicians in

St. Louis, MO to keep those machines clean, stocked, and running right. It’s straightforward work, it pays well, and you’re in charge of your own time.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Each week (or every two weeks, depending on the location), you’ll visit your assigned stores and:

  • Clean and disinfect the FreshPure machine inside and out
  • Take meter readings and log the data on your service report
  • Snap photos of the machine condition at every visit
  • Submit your completed report to the home office when you’re done
  • Call in anything that looks off — damage, mechanical issues, anything unusual

That’s it. Each stop takes about an hour. Your total hours per week depend on how many stores are on your route.

What Makes This Different from Other Gig Work

  • Consistent, scheduled route — not random job pickups
  • Same stores every week, so you know exactly where you’re going
  • $25/hr all-in — your mileage and travel are already baked into the rate
  • Supplies provided — we give you everything you need to do the job
  • Real support — a home office contact you can actually reach

This Is NOT a Repair Job

You’re not expected to fix anything. If a machine has a mechanical or technical issue, you flag it and we send a Service Technician. Your job is to keep things clean, documented, and reported — that’s where your value is.


What You Need to Get Started

  • A reliable vehicle and a valid driver’s license
  • A smartphone with a camera for photo submissions
  • Attention to detail — you follow the checklist, every time
  • You show up when you’re scheduled. That’s the most important thing.

No experience in water systems required. If you’ve done field services, retail merchandising, delivery routes, janitorial work, or anything similar — you’ll hit the ground running.

Who Thrives in This Role

This is a great fit if you’re already doing gig work and want something more predictable layered in, or if you’re looking for flexible part-time income that fits around your schedule. People who do well here tend to be:

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone looking over their shoulder
  • Detail-oriented — you notice things other people miss
  • Reliable — your stores count on you showing up
  • Good communicators — you keep the home office in the loop

How to Apply

Click “Apply Now” to be directed to our application. It only takes a few minutes to complete.

If we’re moving forward, you’ll hear from us by email. Interviews are conducted virtually via Microsoft Teams — we’ll send you a calendar invite with everything you need.

You can also view all open positions across our locations at:

freshpure.com/careers

National Water Services, LLC. | freshpure.com/careers

title: Bedrijfsmaatschappelijk Werker (8 uur) | Ouderen- en Gehandicaptenzorg | Amsterdam
description:

Help Amstadammers weer grip te krijgen op hun werk en welzijn. Als Bedrijfsmaatschappelijk Werker bij Amsta in Amsterdam begeleid je collega's bij stress, verlies en persoonlijke uitdagingen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid, werkt zelfstandig en draagt zichtbaar bij aan duurzame inzetbaarheid.

Jouw rol als Amstadammer

Als Bedrijfsmaatschappelijk Werker help je Amstadammers die tijdelijk ondersteuning nodig hebben. Je begeleidt collega's bij stress, werkdruk, verlies, financiële zorgen of andere gebeurtenissen die invloed hebben op hun dagelijks functioneren. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de directe hulpvraag. Je herkent patronen, onderzoekt onderliggende oorzaken en denkt mee over duurzame oplossingen.

Je werkt zelfstandig en vertrouwelijk. Tegelijkertijd help je leidinggevenden en de organisatie om signalen vroeg te herkennen. Zo zorg jij ervoor dat Amstadammers gezond, betrokken en met plezier kunnen blijven werken. Je maakt deel uit van het team Advies, Preventie & Inzetbaarheid binnen HRM. Samen bouwen jullie aan een organisatie waarin hulp vragen normaal is en ondersteuning dichtbij is.

Dit betekent dat jij:

  • Vertrouwelijke gesprekken voert over werkdruk, verlies, conflicten en persoonlijke zorgen.

  • Amstadammers helpt om weer regie te krijgen en haalbare stappen vooruit te zetten.

  • Leidinggevenden adviseert bij psychosociale vraagstukken binnen teams.

  • Signalen uit de organisatie vertaalt naar preventieve acties en verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Workshops verzorgt over onderwerpen zoals stress, communicatie en werkplezier.

Zo lever jij dagelijks een waardevolle bijdrage aan het voorkomen van uitval, het vergroten van werkplezier en het versterken van duurzame inzetbaarheid.

Hier gebeurt het

Je werkt binnen het team Advies, Preventie & Inzetbaarheid van HRM. Vanuit deze rol bezoek je verschillende locaties van Amsta in Amsterdam. Hierdoor spreek je veel verschillende Amstadammers en zie je van dichtbij wat er speelt binnen de organisatie. Je werkt samen met collega's die zich inzetten voor gezondheid, preventie en goed werkgeverschap. Er is veel ruimte voor jouw ideeën en expertise.

Wat dit werk bijzonder maakt?

  • Je werkt binnen zowel de ouderenzorg als de gehandicaptenzorg.

  • Je ziet uiteenlopende hulpvragen en situaties.

  • Je combineert individuele begeleiding met organisatieadvies.

  • Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je werk zelf vorm te geven.

  • Je hebt direct invloed op het welzijn van collega's.

Deze functie past goed bij jou als je graag zelfstandig werkt, makkelijk contact legt en energie krijgt van zichtbaar aanwezig zijn binnen een organisatie.

Quote van een Amstadammer

"Bij Amsta kijken we naar wat iemand nodig heeft. Dat doen we met aandacht voor de mens en voor de situatie waarin iemand zich bevindt."

Daarom pas jij bij Amsta

Jij ziet snel wat er achter een vraag schuilgaat. Je brengt rust, stelt de juiste vragen en weet mensen verder te helpen wanneer het even tegenzit. Verder heb jij:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Social Work, Maatschappelijk Werk en Dienstverlening of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

  • Een afgeronde post-hbo-opleiding Bedrijfsmaatschappelijk Werk.

  • Relevante werkervaring als Bedrijfsmaatschappelijk Werker of in een vergelijkbare functie waarin je medewerkers begeleidt bij psychosociale vraagstukken.

  • Ervaring met contextueel en systemisch werken.

  • Het vermogen om patronen binnen teams en organisaties te herkennen.

  • Ervaring met het adviseren van leidinggevenden.

  • Een methodische en onderbouwde werkwijze.

  • Integriteit en discretie waardoor Amstadammers zich veilig voelen.

Deze functie past bij jou als je graag zelfstandig werkt, makkelijk schakelt tussen medewerkers en leidinggevenden en energie krijgt van het begeleiden van mensen tijdens belangrijke momenten in hun leven.

Zo zorgen wij voor jou

Voor Amsta zijn jullie, Amstadammers, ons grootste goed. Jij zorgt met aandacht voor anderen, wij zorgen dat jij dit met plezier doet. Bij Amsta bieden wij jou een fijne werkplek waar jij goed kunt werken én gezond blijft.

  • Een salaris volgens FWG 50 van de cao VVT, tot maximaal € 4.822,50 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur.

  • Profiteer van een fietsplan, korting op je zorgverzekering, sportschoolabonnement én een Preventief Medisch Onderzoek voor een volledige check-up.

  • Een zelfstandige specialistische rol waarin je direct impact hebt op het welzijn van collega's.

  • Veel vrijheid om jouw expertise zichtbaar te maken binnen de organisatie.

Enthousiast?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Upload je cv en beantwoord drie korte vragen in het sollicitatieformulier. Met de vragen krijgen we niet alleen een beeld van je ervaring, maar vooral van hoe jij in de praktijk werkt. Zo kunnen we beter beoordelen of deze functie bij je past. Een motivatiebrief is niet verplicht, maar mag natuurlijk wel.

En daarna?

  • Je hoort binnen 3 werkdagen iets van ons.

  • De eerste kennismaking is telefonisch met recruiter Roos Luthart.

  • Daarna volgt een gesprek met de Teammanager HRM en betrokken collega's uit het team.

  • Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan bespreken we de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Daarna verwelkomen we je graag bij Amsta.

Twijfel je of heb je nog vragen?

We vertellen je graag meer over de functie, het team en hoe deze rol er in de praktijk uitziet. Een kort gesprek kan al helpen om te ontdekken of deze functie bij jou past. Neem contact op met Polo Pieters (Teammanager HRM) via 06-2842 3453 of p.pieters@amsta.nl.
