title: AI/ML Computational Biologist - Postdoctoral Researcher
description:
We are seeking a Postdoctoral Research Staff Member to conduct research at the intersection of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and computational biology. The successful candidate will apply and adapt state-of-the-art AI/ML approaches to understand host-response dynamics in complex biological systems. Research will focus on integrating large-scale multiomic datasets, including bulk, single-cell, spatial, and multimodal data, from animal models and human cohorts to identify molecular programs associated with disease progression, immune responses, and biological resilience. The candidate will leverage modern machine learning approaches, including deep learning, self-supervised learning, and biological foundation models, to generate biologically meaningful insights from diverse datasets and develop predictive models that generalize across biological systems.

This position is in the Integrative Multi-Omics Group and offers the opportunity to work under the guidance of senior scientists on high-dimensional biological data at scale in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

This is a two-year term appointment with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years.

In this role you will

  • Develop and apply machine learning methods for prediction and representation learning from high-dimensional biological data.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of workflows for integrative analysis of multiomic datasets (bulk, single-cell, spatial, and multimodal).
  • Investigate, develop, and apply approaches for multimodal data fusion, cross-dataset integration, and transfer learning.
  • Train, adapt and evaluate self-supervised and foundation models for omics data.
  • Develop and apply interpretable models linking molecular states to disease trajectories and host-response phenotypes.
  • Process and analyze large-scale sequencing and other omics datasets.
  • Present research findings at seminars, conferences, and technical meetings.
  • Contribute to research design and project execution.
  • Collaborate in a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Publish results in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). See Additional Information section below for details.
  • PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Strong background in machine learning, statistical modeling, computational biology, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience analyzing high-dimensional biological data such as genomics, transcriptomics, or related modalities.
  • Proficiency in Python and R.
  • Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix and scientific computing workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct high-quality research and publish results in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative research environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with deep learning or probabilistic modeling approaches, such as variational autoencoders, scVI, or related methods.
  • Experience with single-cell, spatial, and/or multimodal omics data.
  • Experience with multiomic data integration, including multimodal single-cell datasets.
  • Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, cross-dataset integration, or batch correction.
  • Experience with transformers, self-supervised learning, or pretrained models for biological data.
  • Experience training and scaling machine learning models on large datasets.
  • Interest in immunology, host-pathogen biology, or disease modeling.

Pay: $123,048 Annually

#LI-Onsite

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Position Information

This is a Postdoctoral appointment with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years. The postdoctoral appointment is a temporary, mentored training position intended for individuals in the early stages of their postdoctoral research careers. Consistent with the structure of the program, applicants must have received their Ph.D. (or equivalent doctorate) within five years of the anticipated start date.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Flexible Benefits Package
  • 401(k)
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

None required. However, if your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check.

National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams:

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

title: New Product Technician
description:
Job Title: New Product Technician
Department: New Product Development / Engineering
Location: Moncks Corner, SC
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $25.00-$30.00/hr
Reports To: New Product Development Manager / Engineering Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt (subject to classification review)

Position Summary

Sea Fox Boats is seeking a skilled, detail-oriented, and motivated New Product Technician to support the development, assembly, testing, and implementation of new boat models and product enhancements.

This position plays a key role in bringing new boat designs from concept to production by working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Production teams. The ideal candidate will have strong mechanical aptitude, hands-on boat-building experience, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist with the development, fabrication, assembly, and modification of new boat models and prototypes.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Production teams to support new product launches and design improvements.

  • Install, assemble, and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural components on prototype vessels.

  • Interpret and follow engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and technical instructions.

  • Identify potential design, fitment, assembly, and manufacturing issues during prototype development.

  • Recommend improvements to enhance product quality, functionality, manufacturability, and efficiency.

  • Perform modifications and adjustments to fiberglass components, hardware, consoles, interiors, and other boat systems.

  • Assist in testing and evaluating new materials, components, equipment, and manufacturing processes.

  • Document prototype builds, design changes, technical issues, and recommended corrective actions.

  • Collaborate with Quality Control to ensure new products meet company standards and specifications.

  • Support the transition of new boat models from development into full-scale production.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and quality standards.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Previous experience in boat manufacturing, marine assembly, fabrication, or a related manufacturing environment preferred.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and hands-on troubleshooting abilities.

  • Knowledge of boat construction, fiberglass components, mechanical systems, and assembly processes.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, measurements, and assembly instructions.

  • Experience using hand tools, power tools, and manufacturing equipment.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.

  • Ability to identify problems, develop solutions, and adapt to changing project requirements.

  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in new product development, research and development (R&D), or prototype manufacturing.

  • Experience with center-console boat construction and assembly.

  • Familiarity with marine electrical systems, plumbing, rigging, and hardware installation.

  • Fiberglass fabrication, lamination, or gel coat experience.

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and continuous improvement practices.

  • Experience collaborating with engineering teams on product modifications or new model launches.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, and reach for extended periods.

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds independently, with assistance or lifting equipment for heavier items.

  • Ability to work in confined or restricted areas within boats when necessary.

  • Ability to safely operate hand tools, power tools, and manufacturing equipment.

  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, dust, fiberglass materials, and varying temperatures.

  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Key Skills and Competencies

  • Mechanical and technical aptitude

  • Problem-solving and troubleshooting

  • Prototype development and assembly

  • Attention to detail and quality workmanship

  • Teamwork and communication

  • Adaptability and willingness to learn

  • Time management and organization

  • Manufacturing and production knowledge

Why Join Sea Fox Boats?

At Sea Fox Boats, we take pride in building high-quality boats through craftsmanship, innovation, and teamwork. As a New Product Technician, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the development of new boat models, collaborate with experienced professionals, and play an important role in bringing innovative marine products to life.

Sea Fox Boats is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.

title: Director, Software Engineering, Legal
description:
The Director, Software Engineering leads the Legal Engineering delivery pillar within our Legal, Privacy & Compliance Engineering organization. You will lead the engineering team that build, integrate, and operate the technology powering our Legal department including, spanning contract lifecycle management, legal document management, eDiscovery and legal hold, intellectual property management, eBilling, and a growing portfolio of AI agentic workflows.

This is a build-and-lead role: you will own a portfolio that blends enterprise SaaS platforms with bespoke software and lead the engineering of the interoperability layer and differentiated custom applications that make the whole ecosystem greater than its parts.

This role requires both deep technical and leadership with business acumen in the corporate legal space. This leader will own the end-to-end delivery of legal technical solutions that enable capabilities across jurisdictions, partners directly with Product Management, Legal, and Cyber. This role will be responsible for hiring, retaining, and continuously assessing the health and growth of the legal engineering team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Engineering Leadership & Delivery
    • Leads a team of engineering managers, staff software engineers, and architects), plus contractors and interns
    • Own engineering delivery, technical health, reliability, and quality across the legal technology portfolio — SaaS platforms, custom applications, integrations, and data flows
    • Drive engineering excellence: architecture reviews, code quality, CI/CD, automated testing, and operational readiness
    • Steer programs at the right altitude — owning key decisions, pro-active escalations, and delivery health in partnership with our Technical Program Management and Product Management functions
    • Establish and uphold software quality, legal architecture and engineering standards, and NBCU cyber guidelines
    • Drive delivery across multiple complex concurrent programs/projects
    • Partner with Principal architect, scrum lead, product owner, and technical project manager to ensure standards and stakeholder visibility
  • Platform Ownership
    • Provide technical leadership across contract lifecycle management, legal document management, eBilling, intellectual property management, and eDiscovery/legal hold capabilities
    • Lead the strategy and engineering for interoperability between SaaS platforms and bespoke software — APIs, data integration, workflow orchestration, and shared services
    • Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and data governance standards
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
    • Serve as the senior technical voice for Legal engineering
    • Communicate program status, risk exposure, and engineering trade-offs to SVPs, VPs and Directors in a clear and business relevant terms
    • Represent the organization in regulatory discussions, 3rd party audits, and external partner engagements as needed
    • Build a deep, strategic partnership with our Product organization — embedded in roadmap conversations, contributing engineering perspective to business process design in way of shift left mindset
    • Engage directly with Legal department and Legal Operations leaders; translate their operational needs into reliable, scalable and secure engineering solutions
    • Partner with our Principal Architect on technical standards fit for purpose design principles and with Cyber on secure integration practices while securing the perimeter protecting the brand, consumer’s rights, and data
  • System Reliability & Performance: Proactively manage reliability and performance of all systems to ensure they meet global business needs. Partner closely with SaaS providers and internal teams to maintain system health and performance.
  • Defect & Enhancement Management: Manage the defect management process from identification to resolution. Manage the delivery of enhancements that improve user experience and system efficiency.
  • Problem & Incident Management: Own the problem management process, conducting root cause analysis to reduce the number of recurring incidents. Focus on implementing minor enhancements or process changes to prevent future issues. Manage the end-to-end response to major incidents impacting Legal business processes. Manage RCA sessions and ensure timely executive – level communications. Reduce “noise” in the system by analyzing ticket trends and automating routine fixes.
  • Support Standards & SLAs: Enforce global support standards and best practices including adherence to SLAs for all support activities. Monitor and report on performance metrics (e.g. MTTR, backlog aging) and use data to drive continuous improvements.
  • Data Integration: Manage the support and maintenance of data integrations between enterprise systems.
  • People Leadership
    • Hire, develop, retain, and coach engineering managers, staff engineers, and architects; build a high-trust, high-accountability team culture
    • Grow your leaders through honest feedback, career development, and intentional coaching
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering with 7+ years in engineering management or senior technical leadership
  • 5+ years of experience leading ML and automation solutions
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with AI including, building or leading agentic workflows and/or agent orchestration
  • Demonstrated deep legal technology experience delivering technology in a large enterprise environment
  • Working knowledge of application security fundamentals - SSO/IAM, API security, secure SDLC, and security review practices when integrating SaaS
  • Strong track record of leading cross-functional programs with legal stakeholders
  • Proven ability to influence and communicate at S/VP levels
  • Experience managing and growing engineering teams (software engineers + managers) in a matrixed Fortune 100 or equivalent environment

University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus | Department\: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

Job Title\: Post-Award Admin Professional (Part-Time, Non-Benefits Eligible)

Position #\: 00853808 | Requisition #\: 41341

Job Summary\:

The Department of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation is seeking a collaborative professional to provide comprehensive support to post-award research administration, sponsored projects, procurement and administrative operations. The position works with faculty, staff, department leadership, Principal Investigators, research teams, hospital affiliates, and central campus partners to coordinate complex operational and sponsored-project activities while maintaining confidentiality, accuracy, and compliance. The role combines day-to-day departmental support with post-award research administration, procurement and travel.

Key Responsibilities\:

  • Support sponsored project administration by tracking expenditures, maintaining documentation, and assisting faculty and research staff with financial and operational processes.

  • Reconcile purchases against financial detail reports to ensure accuracy and appropriateness

  • Provide travel coordination and reimbursement support for faculty and research personnel in compliance with University and sponsor requirements.

  • Procure research equipment, supplies, and services, ensuring costs are allowable and compliant with grant and institutional guidelines.

  • Liaison for research groups within Department and Procurement Service Center

Remote given small FTE. However, if the FTE increases at any point, the department will reassess the hybrid workspace.

Thank you for considering joining our team. The field of rehabilitation believes in using your whole body to improve your human performance. The department of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation at the University of Colorado (which we affectionately call "CU PM&R") is at the forefront of using team science, regenerative medicine, and exercise treatments. It is uniquely situated in the state-of-the-art CU Anschutz Medical Campus, the first campus in the nation to be built from the ground up to bring research, education, and patient care into one visionary collaboration. title: Senior FullStack Engineer (AI)
description:
About Us 🚀

Bridgit is a leading non-bank lender transforming the way Australians access property equity. Purpose-built to make property transactions faster and easier, we pioneered the Buy Now, Sell Later solution - empowering homeowners to unlock their property equity and move on their terms. With a simple digital application, fast approvals, and flexible loan options, we're making property finance seamless and stress-free.

We're now five years old and making huge strides. We've accredited over three-quarters of Australia's broker network, and launched white label solutions with Australia's largest aggregators - Connective, Aussie Home Loans, Finsure, and Loan Market Group - and we're just getting started.

Our momentum has been recognised with awards including Best Growth Story at the 2025 Fintech Awards, the 2025 Finder People's Choice Award for Lending Innovation, Deloitte's Tech Fast 50 2025, and a place among LinkedIn's Top 20 Startups in Australia 2025.

The difference you’ll make
Bridgit is transforming property lending, and AI is key to scaling our platform. We are expanding our AI capabilities to transform how financial data and operational workflows are processed across our core platform.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (AI), you will work closely with our Tech Lead to design, ship, and scale production-ready AI systems. You will take ownership across the entire stack, building intelligent data pipelines, implementing agentic workflows, and establishing the monitoring and evaluation frameworks required to ensure real-world accuracy and reliability.

We are looking for an engineer who brings proven experience shipping AI features into production (such as AI Agents, RAG pipelines, or automated workflows) and who actively monitors, measures, and refines model outputs using real-world performance metrics.

What you'll do:

  • Build Production AI Systems: Architect and ship reliable AI capabilities, utilizing frameworks like LangGraph to orchestrate agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and intelligent document processing systems that automate complex financial and operational processes.

  • Full-Stack Application Development: Write clean, secure RESTful APIs in TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS framework) and build modern user interfaces in React/Vue to bring AI features directly into the hands of users.

  • Evaluation & Telemetry: Build evaluation loops, logging, and observability frameworks to track model accuracy, latency, and real-world decision reliability, using performance data to continuously iterate and refine outputs.

  • Support AI Governance: Contribute to systems for reproducibility, traceability, and quality controls in accordance with Bridgit’s AI Governance Framework and Risk Appetite Statement. Support monitoring and observability.

  • Adopt standardised AI coding tools: Use and provide feedback on standardised AI coding tools, such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, within org-wide configurations. Help track tool usage and reliability.

  • Contribute to a “shift-left” culture: Share practical, AI-enabled workflows and coding practices with peers, and continuously improve your own productivity without compromising code quality.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ Years of Full-Stack Engineering: Proven experience building and scaling web applications, with experience in Node.js and modern frontend frameworks.

  • Experience Building AI Products (Not Just Using AI Tools): A proven track record of shipping AI capabilities into software, such as building RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, or intelligent document processing as core product features.

  • Monitoring & Measuring Success: A proven track record of monitoring AI features in live production environments. This includes defining clear success metrics, tracking real-world performance, and using data-driven feedback loops to continuously refine model outputs over time.

  • Clear Communication & Ownership: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs, scope features clearly, write high-quality technical documentation, and collaborate cross-functionally.

  • Fintech / Domain Experience (Bonus): Prior exposure to finance, fintech, lending, or data analysis is a bonus

Why Join Us?

Bridgit values its team, they are the heart of how we build this business. Along with competitive remuneration, slick offices and the chance to be part of an innovative, agile fintech, we also offer:

  • Extra Leave – we offer birthday leave + an additional day of paid leave to be used for life events, celebrations or just a mental health reset.

  • Two weeks from anywhere – we encourage employees to work remotely from a location of their choice for two weeks each year.

  • Learning and Development – all employees are encouraged and empowered to engage in professional development including a number of learning initiatives run internally.

  • Social events – we have a jam-packed social scene, with events throughout the year.

Ready to Make an Impact? 🙌

If you’re excited about reshaping the lending industry and want to be part of a company that values authenticity and innovation, we’d love to chat. Apply now and let’s build the future of finance together!

A heads-up that because we operate in the financial services space, any offer made will be subject to successful pre-employment screening, including reference checks and a standard police check.

title: Embedded Systems Intern
description:
The Company

EngeniusMicro is a hardware focused small business with offices in Huntsville, AL and in Atlanta, GA. Our multi-disciplinary staff of engineers, technicians, and scientists provide research and development engineering services to industry and the Federal Government. Our primary research areas are Additive Manufacturing, MicroElectroMechanical Systems (MEMS) / Nanotechnology, and Microelectronics. As a research-focused small business, we offer opportunities for growth and advancement for a motivated candidate.

The Culture

EngeniusMicro seeks self-motivated, highly organized, and responsive employees able to work in a fast-paced, small team environment. The ideal employee will thrive in a learning environment that encourages independence, initiative, leadership, and professional growth.

As an Engineering Intern, you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers and gain practical, hands-on experience applying concepts learned in the classroom to real-world research and development projects.

Why should you apply?

  • You want to apply what you have learned in the classroom to real-world engineering challenges
  • You are interested in embedded systems and enjoy working at the intersection of hardware and software
  • You want hands-on experience developing, testing, and troubleshooting engineering systems
  • You enjoy solving technical challenges and figuring out why something isn't working
  • You want to work alongside experienced engineers and learn from their expertise
  • You are interested in working on research and development projects rather than performing repetitive or highly routine work
  • You want exposure to the complete engineering process, from development and prototyping through testing and documentation
  • You like taking on new challenges and expanding your technical skills
  • You want to develop practical engineering and problem-solving skills before entering the workforce
  • You are interested in working in a small company where your contributions can have a meaningful impact

The Position

EngeniusMicro is seeking an Engineering Intern with an interest in embedded systems to support our engineering team in research and development activities. This position is intended for a motivated college student in their junior or senior year who is looking for an opportunity to apply their academic knowledge in a professional engineering environment.

The ideal candidate will have completed coursework and/or personal or academic projects involving embedded systems and will have some experience programming microcontrollers or other embedded devices. The intern will work under the direction of experienced engineers and will have opportunities to contribute to active projects involving hardware development, embedded software, system integration, testing, and troubleshooting.

This position is designed to provide meaningful practical experience while allowing the intern to continue developing their technical skills.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Assist engineers with the development, integration, and testing of embedded systems
  • Develop, modify, and debug embedded software under the direction of experienced engineers
  • Assist with programming and configuring microcontrollers and other embedded devices
  • Assist with hardware/software integration and troubleshooting
  • Support prototype development and proof-of-concept activities
  • Assist with circuit bring-up, testing, and debugging
  • Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and other test equipment
  • Develop and execute basic test procedures and document test results
  • Analyze test data and assist engineers in identifying and resolving technical issues
  • Research components, technologies, and potential solutions to engineering challenges
  • Read and interpret technical documentation, schematics, datasheets, and specifications
  • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and project meetings as appropriate
  • Document development activities, test results, and technical findings
  • Maintain organized project files and development documentation
  • Perform other engineering-related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Basic

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field
  • Junior or senior standing in an undergraduate program
  • Demonstrated interest in embedded systems through coursework, academic projects, personal projects, or previous work experience
  • Basic programming experience, preferably in C or C++
  • Ability to read and understand technical documentation, schematics, and specifications
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a small technical team
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and techniques
  • Authorization to work for employers in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas at this time.

Preferred

  • Experience developing software for microcontrollers or other embedded platforms
  • Experience with C and/or C++
  • Familiarity with embedded development environments and debugging tools
  • Experience with communication protocols such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, USB, or Ethernet
  • Experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, or other laboratory equipment
  • Experience with PCB design, circuit prototyping, or hardware bring-up
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control systems
  • Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS)
  • Experience with Linux or other embedded operating systems
  • Experience with personal, academic, or extracurricular engineering projects demonstrating hands-on technical ability

The Legal Stuff

title: Engineering Technician
description:
Techniplas is a global supplier of sophisticated plastic components and design-focused, multifunctional surfaces that are primarily for the automotive sector, as well as the industrial, consumer goods, medical and other markets. The company’s products follow industry trends like weight reduction and vehicle electrification, innovative operating concepts, high-quality surface finishes, and an increasing focus on convenience and safety.

The Techniplas Group runs 30 sites worldwide with production, sales and / or technology hubs and employs just under 4,000 members of staff. The company serves customers and platforms around the world, focusing on technological expertise and collaboration with customers in the fields of design and engineering. Techniplas has long-term relationships with many of the world’s leading automotive and industrial OEMs.

Job Summary:

The Engineering Technician / Technical Writer supports injection molding, thermoforming, and assembly operations by solving hands-on process and equipment issues and turning engineering knowledge into clear, controlled documentation. About half the role is on the floor supporting trials, launches, and troubleshooting; the other half is creating and maintaining work instructions, setup sheets, PFMEAs, control plans, and training materials that operators, setup techs, and auditors rely on.

Responsibilities:

  • Support process and manufacturing engineers on new product launches, tool trials, and engineering changes for injection molding and thermoforming lines.
  • Troubleshoot process, tooling, and fixture issues on the floor; collect data and help identify root cause.
  • Document process parameters and setup conditions during trials, PPAP runs, and validated process changes.
  • Perform dimensional checks and first-article inspections using calipers, height gauges, check fixtures, and other measuring tools.
  • Participate in problem-solving activities (8D, 5-Why, fishbone) and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Help build, modify, and maintain fixtures, poka-yokes, and work cell layouts.
  • Collect and analyze production data (scrap, downtime, cycle time) and present findings to engineering and operations.
  • Support continuous improvement, 5S, and safety initiatives in assigned areas.
  • Write, revise, and maintain Standard Work Instructions (SWIs), setup sheets, process sheets, and visual aids, using photos and diagrams so operators can follow them at a glance.
  • Update PFMEAs, process flow diagrams, and control plans as processes change, in partnership with Engineering and Quality.
  • Own document control for engineering documents: revision levels, approvals, distribution to the floor, and removal of obsolete copies.
  • Audit the floor regularly to confirm posted documents are current and match how the job is actually run.
  • Prepare and organize PPAP packages and customer-required documentation for submission.
  • Create training materials and job aids for new parts, launches, and process changes; support Training in rolling them out to operators and setup techs.
  • Write technical reports, trial summaries, and engineering change records in clear, plain language.
  • Support IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and customer audits by locating records and answering documentation questions.
  • Maintain organized electronic files and help standardize document templates across the plant.
  • Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Production Control, and production supervisors to keep engineering changes moving.

title: Cannabis Budtender - Full-Time Position - Nights and Weekends
description:
THE ROLE

The Budtender is the heart of the Bud's guest experience. This is a guest-facing, non-supervisory position responsible for helping guests navigate our products, completing accurate & compliant cannabis transactions, & creating the welcoming, knowledgeable & hospitality-driven experience that keeps people coming back.

You'll spend the majority of your shift directly interacting with guests - learning what they're looking for, answering product questions, completing transactions & helping maintain an organized, efficient & inviting retail environment.

Budtenders are also one of our most important lines of defense when it comes to compliance. You'll be responsible for verifying information, maintaining transaction accuracy, protecting cannabis products & cash, & following all Company procedures & applicable cannabis regulations.

This role requires curiosity. Great Budtenders continually build their cannabis knowledge, learn our products, understand the menu, & adapt as our technology, systems & industry evolve.

CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

You bring:

  • A genuine passion for hospitality & creating an exceptional guest experience
  • Strong interest in cannabis products & continued product education
  • Excellent interpersonal & communication skills
  • Ability to connect with a diverse guest population
  • Strong attention to detail & transaction accuracy
  • Reliable cash-handling & basic mathematical skills
  • Ability to remain calm, professional & effective under pressure
  • Strong personal accountability & willingness to learn from mistakes
  • Ability to prioritize tasks & remain productive in a fast-paced environment
  • A collaborative, team-oriented mindset
  • Ability to follow established policies, procedures & management direction
  • Comfort learning & using point-of-sale systems & other Company technology
  • Curiosity & adaptability when learning new technology, systems & tools
  • Multilingual skills - a plus

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION

  • High school diploma or equivalent - required
  • One or more years of work experience - required
  • Retail, hospitality or customer-facing experience - preferred
  • Cannabis industry experience - preferred
  • Cash-handling experience - preferred
  • Experience using POS or other retail technology - preferred
  • Strong communication & interpersonal skills - required

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

GUEST EXPERIENCE & SALES

  • Welcome every guest with a friendly, professional & hospitality-driven approach
  • Guide guests through the retail experience & help them navigate available cannabis products
  • Listen to guest needs & preferences & provide appropriate product information
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of the products, brands & promotions available on the menu
  • Educate guests on product types, consumption methods, storage requirements & other Company-approved product information
  • Complete guest transactions accurately & efficiently through the point-of-sale system
  • Help maintain efficient guest flow during both high- & low-volume periods
  • Create positive interactions that build guest trust, loyalty & repeat business
  • Represent Bud's values & brand professionally during every guest interaction

CANNABIS KNOWLEDGE & EDUCATION

  • Maintain current knowledge of cannabis products available on the menu
  • Build understanding of product categories, cannabinoids, consumption methods, storage requirements & other relevant product information
  • Participate in Company-required product education & training
  • Stay informed about new products, brands & Company promotions
  • Communicate cannabis information responsibly & within the scope of Company training
  • Never provide medical advice or make claims outside of approved product information

TRANSACTIONS & CASH HANDLING

  • Dispense cannabis & cannabis products in strict accordance with Company procedures & applicable regulations
  • Accurately process transactions using the Company's POS system
  • Maintain responsibility for an assigned cash till when applicable
  • Accurately make change & follow all cash-handling procedures
  • Verify cash amounts & transaction records as required
  • Immediately report cash or transaction discrepancies to Retail Management
  • Maintain accuracy throughout the entire dispensing & sales process

COMPLIANCE & SAFETY

  • Follow all Company policies, Standard Operating Procedures & applicable cannabis regulations
  • Maintain required knowledge of METRC & Company POS processes
  • Follow all age-verification & identification requirements
  • Help prevent sales to minors, theft & diversion
  • Maintain awareness of cannabis products & assigned inventory at all times
  • Immediately report compliance, security or safety concerns to Retail Management
  • Maintain guest privacy & confidentiality
  • Follow all security & emergency procedures
  • Maintain safety awareness throughout each shift

STORE OPERATIONS

  • Maintain a clean, organized & guest-ready sales floor
  • Support opening & closing procedures as assigned
  • Assist with front desk, guest check-in or other guest-facing responsibilities as assigned
  • Monitor product levels on the sales floor & communicate replenishment needs
  • Assist with product labeling & stickering, restocking or other inventory-related tasks as directed
  • Maintain accuracy of assigned inventory
  • Complete assigned side work & operational tasks
  • Help prepare the store & sales floor for the next shift
  • Adapt to procedural & operational changes as communicated by Retail Management
  • Perform additional non-supervisory duties as assigned

FULFILLMENT DUTIES

  • Maintain the pick-up order & kiosk order flow, ensuring accurate & timely fulfillment for guests
  • Verify pick-up & kiosk orders for accuracy before releasing them to guests
  • Communicate fulfillment delays, issues or discrepancies to Retail Management

TEAMWORK & COMMUNICATION

  • Work collaboratively with Budtenders, Lead Sales Associates, Inventory & Retail Management
  • Follow direction provided by Retail Management & Shift Supervisors
  • Communicate guest-flow, inventory, cash, technology or operational concerns promptly
  • Support teammates during high-volume periods
  • Contribute to a positive, respectful & inclusive work environment
  • Ask questions when expectations or procedures are unclear
  • Take accountability for mistakes & work collaboratively to resolve them

TECHNOLOGY & AI

  • Use Company-approved technology & systems to complete sales, inventory, training & other assigned responsibilities accurately
  • Use approved AI tools, when appropriate, to support learning, organization & individual productivity
  • Leverage approved technology to strengthen product knowledge & better understand Company-provided information
  • Demonstrate curiosity & adaptability as new technology, systems & AI tools are introduced
  • Review AI-generated information for accuracy before relying on or using it
  • Never enter confidential employee, guest, Company or regulated information into an AI tool unless specifically authorized by Company policy
  • Understand that AI & technology may support the role but do not replace Company training, approved product information, established procedures or management direction

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

A successful Budtender consistently:

  • Creates an exceptional & welcoming guest experience
  • Completes accurate, efficient & compliant cannabis transactions
  • Builds strong cannabis & product knowledge
  • Maintains cash & inventory accuracy
  • Follows all compliance, safety & security procedures
  • Communicates effectively with guests & teammates
  • Maintains a clean, organized & guest-ready environment
  • Demonstrates reliability, accountability & strong attention to detail
  • Adapts positively to new procedures, products & technology
  • Uses technology & AI responsibly to support learning & productivity
  • Contributes positively to the overall success of the store & team

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be at least 21 years of age
  • Must pass all required background checks
  • Must remain eligible for state-required cannabis industry badging
  • Must maintain required licenses, certifications & trainings
  • Must remain compliant with all Company policies & applicable cannabis regulations
  • Must be available to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including mornings, evenings, nights, weekends & holidays
  • Must be able to work successfully in a fast-paced retail environment

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Able to stand & move throughout the store for extended periods, including shifts of up to 10 hours
  • Able to lift & move up to 50 lbs
  • Able to bend, reach, crouch & move safely throughout the facility
  • Able to perform repetitive POS, cash-handling & inventory-related tasks
  • Able to work outside in varying weather conditions when required
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume retail environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates primarily on the retail sales floor in a fast-paced, high-volume cannabis environment with frequent direct interaction with guests, cannabis products, cash, technology systems & other team members.

The Budtender is a guest-facing, non-supervisory position & is eligible to receive tips in accordance with applicable law & Company policy.

Strict adherence to all Company policies, Standard Operating Procedures & applicable cannabis regulations is required at all times.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Bud's Goods & Provisions is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace free from discrimination, harassment & retaliation.

title: Security Engineer, Ring Application Security
description:
At Ring, we endeavor to Make Neighborhoods Safer, and a large part of this goal is achieved through the work of our dedicated security teams. Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for analysing the security of applications and services, discovering and addressing security issues, building security automation, and quickly reacting to new threat scenarios. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Senior Project Manager: Partner Accounts
description:
Founded in 2005, iam8bit is a creative production emporium that has quietly redefined the entertainment industry, time and time again. In 2020, iam8bit evolved into financing and publishing games, with several yet-to-be-announced PC, console and tabletop games on the horizon under its iam8bit Presents imprint.

As a Senior Project Manager: Partner Accounts, you are responsible for overseeing the planning, execution, and monitoring of all aspects of an XP project, including setting timelines, managing budgets and ensuring successful delivery of promotional product, swag, and related pop-up activations. Attention to detail is critical to the success of the position accompanied by excellent communication and problem-solving skills. You enjoy owning projects and have a proven track record of delivering results in project management. You’ll be collaborating on impressive global IPs, communicating with and presenting to a variety of partners and personalities, and making unique and memorable swag objects that innovate. Sometimes you’ll even be traveling to cool locations to operate pop-ups for brands you’ve definitely heard of.



RESPONSIBILITIES

PROJECT-LEVEL MANAGEMENT:

  • Oversee the financial aspect of each project, ensuring that budgets are adhered to.
  • Monitor progress to ensure client expectations and all deliverables and are met on time.
  • Allocate and share resources across multiple department projects and/or teams.
  • Manage vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to produce events and marketing assets.
  • Collaborate with others for efficient execution, delegate tasks, and provide support as needed.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, tracking all decisions, budgets, schedules, and communications for reference and reporting on specific project metrics, (i.e. timelines, budget adherence, and deliverable quality).
  • Lead post-mortems for every project, identifying successes, challenges, and areas to improve.



QUALIFICATIONS

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

title: Project Director, Houston
description:
Butcher Power Products is a Panelmatic company.

At Panelmatic, we design and manufacture high-performance electrical and control systems that drive efficiency and reliability across the industrial, utility, renewable energy, and data center markets. With over 60 years of experience, our solutions include precision-built control panels and fully integrated control houses. These systems are trusted by customers who demand uptime, safety, and long-term performance.

Now backed by strategic investment, Panelmatic is scaling rapidly to meet the evolving needs of our customers. Our growing national footprint, advanced engineering capabilities, and commitment to quality ensure we deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions at every stage of your project.

Project Director
We are seeking an accomplished Project Director based in Houston, Texas, to lead a portfolio of complex projects ranging from $100M to $500M annually across multiple strategic and key customers. This is a highly visible leadership role with broad responsibility for customer satisfaction, operational execution, financial performance, and portfolio delivery. Travel up to 20% is required to support customer engagements, project reviews, manufacturing facilities, supplier visits, and other business needs.

The Project Director will be accountable for ensuring projects are executed on time, on budget, on margin, and in accordance with all quality, safety, and contractual requirements. This role serves as the senior leader responsible for coordinating the efforts of Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Production, Quality, Safety, Finance, Estimating, Testing, and Sales to achieve successful customer outcomes.

This position is designed for a senior leader who combines executive presence, strong commercial judgment, and a hands-on operating style. The successful candidate will have the ability to lead strategically while remaining closely engaged in day-to-day execution, proactively identifying risks, removing barriers, and driving accountability across the organization.

You will serve as the central integrator for the full customer portfolio, with direct leadership over the Project Management organization and strong matrix influence across Engineering, Procurement, Production, Quality, Safety, Finance, Estimating, Materials Management, Testing, and Sales. You will be expected to know the projects in detail, anticipate issues before they escalate, communicate effectively with executive leadership and customers, and maintain an active presence in the business, including time on the shop floor, in design reviews, and in execution-focused operating rhythms.

The Opportunity
This role is ideal for a leader who thrives in complex, high-accountability environments where customer success, operational excellence, project execution, and financial performance are equally important.

The Project Director will oversee multiple concurrent projects and customer programs, ensuring all functional teams remain aligned to common priorities, schedules, milestones, and delivery commitments. The successful candidate will play a critical role in shaping execution strategy, improving project performance, protecting margin, influencing leadership decisions, and strengthening long-term customer relationships.

You will work closely with senior internal leadership and partner directly with Sales leadership to strengthen customer relationships, provide transparency, and ensure a coordinated, high-confidence experience across the entire portfolio.

What You'll Do
  • Provide overall leadership and accountability for a $100M to $500M portfolio of projects across multiple customers, ensuring successful execution and customer satisfaction.
  • Lead projects and programs to achieve delivery commitments while meeting schedule, cost, margin, quality, and safety objectives.
  • Provide direct leadership to Project Managers and project teams while driving strong matrix leadership across Engineering, Procurement, Production, Quality, Safety, Finance, Estimating, Materials Management, Logistics, Testing, and Sales.
  • Establish and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, forecasts, resource plans, and execution strategies across the portfolio.
  • Lead internal project reviews, portfolio reviews, risk reviews, and executive project status meetings to ensure alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making.
  • Lead customer project reviews, executive business reviews, and portfolio performance discussions, serving as the primary escalation point and trusted advisor for customers.
  • Ensure all functions are aligned around common priorities, schedules, project milestones, and customer commitments.
  • Drive proactive risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and recovery actions across all projects.
  • Maintain deep operational visibility into engineering progress, procurement status, material availability, production readiness, manufacturing performance, testing activities, quality performance, and delivery schedules.
  • Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, cost, cash flow, profitability, margin performance, forecasting, and change management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve execution efficiency, reduce project risk, enhance customer satisfaction, and increase profitability across the portfolio.
  • Spend meaningful time on the shop floor reviewing materials, drawings, build progress, testing activities, and execution readiness to ensure projects remain on track.
  • Influence executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment, remove barriers, and support business objectives.
  • Develop and promote a culture of accountability, execution excellence, responsiveness, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.
  • PMP Certification required.
  • 15+ years of progressive project management leadership experience, including experience as a senior Project Management leader responsible for large and complex project portfolios.
  • Demonstrated success leading project portfolios ranging from $100M to $500M across multiple customers and multiple concurrent projects.
  • Proven experience leading Project Management organizations and managing Project Managers within a matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects involving protection and control systems, medium- and low-voltage switchgear, relay panels, motor control centers (MCCs), power distribution equipment, industrial control panels, integrated E-House/control house solutions, and other engineered electrical systems.
  • Strong understanding of project execution across engineering, design, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, production planning, quality, testing, logistics, and customer delivery.
  • Advanced knowledge of project planning, scheduling, critical path methodology, resource planning, forecasting, project controls, and recovery planning.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, margin management, contract administration, claims management, and change management.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive leadership, customers, and cross-functional leaders to drive alignment and achieve project objectives.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience leading executive-level project reviews, customer reviews, portfolio reviews, and operational performance reviews.
  • Ability to operate effectively at both the executive level and the detail level, shifting easily between strategic leadership and day-to-day execution oversight.

Leadership Profile
The ideal candidate is more than a traditional project leader. This individual takes full ownership of customer outcomes, portfolio performance, and project execution. They establish credibility through deep operational understanding, strong leadership presence, and disciplined execution.

They are proactive rather than reactive, comfortable challenging teams when needed, and effective at bringing diverse functional groups into alignment around a shared objective. They know how to ask the right questions, identify risks early, remove obstacles, and ensure execution remains disciplined from engineering through manufacturing, testing, and delivery.

They are equally comfortable leading executive reviews, customer discussions, strategic planning sessions, project operating reviews, and shop floor engagement. Most importantly, they possess the leadership presence and influence necessary to align diverse functional organizations around a common objective and consistently deliver projects safely, on time, on margin, and to the highest quality standards.

Location & Travel
  • This position is based in Houston, Texas.
  • Travel of up to 20% is required to support customer meetings, project reviews, manufacturing operations, supplier engagements, and business activities as needed.
  • The Project Director is expected to maintain a visible presence with customers, project teams, and manufacturing operations to ensure alignment, execution excellence, and successful project delivery.

title: Operating Engineer Apprentice
description:
Operating Engineer Apprentice

The term of the apprenticeship is 2 years with an OJL attainment of 4000 supplemented by the minimum required 353 hours of related instruction.

Learn on-the-job (OJL) to operate equipment safely and efficiently to excavate, move, and grade earth for trenching and pipe installation at various landfills as well as maintain equipment.

Complete related instruction NCCER Courses online including Core: Introduction to Basic Construction Skills (85 hrs), Heavy Equipment Operations Level 1 (100 hrs), and Heavy Equipment Operations Level 2 (167.5 hrs)

Responsibilities:

  • Operate one or several types of power construction equipment, such as bulldozers, excavators, forklifts, haul trucks, and skid steers
  • Excavate, move, and grade earth for trenching and pipe installation at various landfills
  • Repair and maintain equipment in addition to other duties as needed
  • Complete related instruction courses and check in with instructors/supervisors

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to safely navigate and work within a landfill environment, which includes exposure to uneven terrain, steep slopes, holes, and other physical hazards. The position requires regular walking, climbing, and standing on varied ground surfaces in outdoor conditions.
  • The ability to stand, walk, kneel, crawl, bend, lift, and squat repeatedly for up to eight hours a day.

Wage Schedule:

  • Entry - $18/hr
  • Intermediate - $20/hr (2000+ OJL hours completed)

title: Developer Advocate
description:
All Together, Extraordinary

adunaglobal.com

Aduna is the Connector of networks, bringing together leading telecom operators and technology partners to simplify global access to Network APIs. Through a single, unified platform, we enable businesses and developers to build more secure, seamless and innovative digital services.

We are looking for a Developer Advocate to become Aduna's public-facing voice within the global developer community as part of our Demand Generation team.

In this role, you will help developers discover, understand, and adopt Network APIs by creating technical content, building sample applications, engaging directly with developer communities, and representing Aduna at industry events.

This is a unique opportunity to build and scale Developer Advocacy from the ground up. You will engage directly with cloud-native developers, hyperscaler communities, and technical decision-makers across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud ecosystems, helping them understand how programmable network capabilities can unlock new possibilities for their applications and services.

As Aduna's first dedicated Developer Advocate, you will have the autonomy and visibility to shape our developer engagement strategy, create a thriving technical community, and influence how developers experience the future of network APIs.

What You'll Do

  • Engage directly with developer communities across hyperscaler ecosystems, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Build Aduna's presence on developer-focused channels such as GitHub, Stack Overflow, technical forums, and developer communities.
  • Create technical content including blogs, tutorials, demos, code samples, walkthroughs, and developer documentation.
  • Build and maintain sample applications that showcase the value and practical implementation of Aduna's Network APIs.
  • Deliver live demonstrations, technical presentations, webinars, and conference talks.
  • Produce hands-on educational content that helps developers accelerate adoption and reduce time to first successful API call.
  • Gather developer feedback and advocate for developer needs across Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams.
  • Monitor and report on developer engagement metrics, sandbox adoption, content performance, and community growth.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Senior Use-Case Leads to ensure technical accuracy and compelling storytelling.

Experience, Knowledge and Skills Required

  • 4+ years of experience in Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, Technical Evangelism, Solutions Engineering, or a hands-on software engineering role with public-facing responsibilities.
  • Strong software development background with the ability to write, test, and demonstrate working code.
  • Experience creating technical content for developer audiences.
  • Proven ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience working with APIs, SDKs, developer platforms, or cloud-native technologies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience presenting at technical meetups, conferences, webinars, or community events is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with CPaaS, telecommunications APIs, communications platforms, or related technologies is a plus but not required.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You have credibility within developer communities and genuinely enjoy helping developers succeed.
  • You are an excellent technical storyteller who can combine engineering depth with business context.
  • You are comfortable speaking publicly and representing your employer externally.
  • You are highly self-directed and thrive when building new initiatives from scratch.
  • You enjoy experimentation and continuously look for new ways to engage technical audiences.
  • You are passionate about open communities, knowledge sharing, and technology innovation.

Why Join Aduna?

  • Be the public voice of a company shaping the future of programmable connectivity.
  • Build a Developer Advocacy function from the ground up and have a direct impact on strategy.
  • Work at the intersection of telecommunications, cloud platforms, APIs, and developer ecosystems.
  • Collaborate with global technology leaders, hyperscalers, and innovative partners.
  • Gain visibility across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Help define how developers interact with one of the most exciting new technology categories in the market.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team of industry experts.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Professional development and conference participation opportunities.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and global-scale initiatives.
  • The chance to shape a rapidly growing company and make a visible impact from day one.

Aduna is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who are passionate about driving the next wave of innovation in telecommunications.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
About the role:

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager to be Rezdy's dependable NA presence — covering the hours our Sydney/Melbourne-based PM and dev team aren't online. This is a strong fit for someone energized by operational rigor and real-time problem-solving: comfortable triaging under pressure, translating between technical and commercial audiences, and building product judgment by working closely alongside a senior PM rather than owning a roadmap from day one. Pacific timezone

What you'll do:

  • Connect the time zones. Be the dependable daily link between North America stakeholders — support and account management teams — and the Sydney/Melbourne-based PM and dev team, flagging decisions and blockers in real time rather than letting them wait for the next overlap window.
  • Be the NA distribution conduit for Commercial leads and distribution partners (Viator, GYG, etc) and Distribution Resellers
  • Keep incidents moving and visible during NA hours. Triage escalations that occur in NA working hours against a defined severity framework, looping in the senior PM and dev lead when judgment calls exceed current scope, and making sure NA support and AM teams get clear, live updates rather than waiting for the next AU working day.
  • Surface and track AM churn risk. Own intake of NA account-manager-flagged churn risk — capturing impact and urgency the moment it's raised — so it's framed and ready to compete fairly when the senior PM and dev lead plan the sprint.
  • Answer for what's in flight. Be NA's go-to for "is this expected / is this known / what's the status" questions on Booking Manager and Distribution, working from close sync with the senior PM's roadmap and known-issues context rather than independent authority over it.
  • Share release communication in NA hours. Help execute the existing release process — communication and post-release follow-up specifically during NA hours — rather than owning release planning or prioritization.
  • Partner with Engineering at a working level. Build enough fluency in our data architecture to relay NA-side context accurately to engineering, without owning technical trade-off decisions.
  • Put AI tools to work. Use AI tools to speed up research, troubleshooting, and day-to-day tasks — a lever for moving faster, not a replacement for judgment.

What you'll bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in product management, product operations, or a closely related operational/customer-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Comfort working within another PM's priorities and roadmap — bringing your own judgment and context to how that work gets executed
  • Experience with incident or issue management processes, and communicating through them clearly under time pressure.
  • Comfort working with legacy technology systems and the teams that maintain them — able to translate between legacy constraints and current product priorities for both engineering and commercial audiences.
  • Strong written communication skills — able to adjust tone and depth for audiences ranging from support and account management teams to engineering.
  • Ease operating in process-driven environments (Jira, Slack, or equivalent).
  • Comfort picking up domain concepts across different product types — e.g., transactional booking flows versus distribution/channel connectivity — without needing deep expertise in both on day one.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the travel, tours, or activities booking software space.
  • Familiarity with multi-brand or multi-product portfolios (Expedition Software operates Checkfront, Rezdy, and Regiondo).
  • Prior experience in a support, account management, or customer-facing product role.
The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $100,000, commensurate with years of experience, skillset, and qualifications.

title: Snow Removal
description:
What's the role?

The Seasonal Snow Removal Team Member helps keep REMS and Secure Storage properties safe and accessible during winter weather conditions. We are seeking part-time team members based in the Baraboo area to support properties throughout Sauk County. This seasonal role is ideal for someone who enjoys working outdoors, takes pride in a job well done, and can be counted on when winter weather arrives. Opportunities for year-round employment may be available for candidates interested in supporting maintenance, groundskeeping, landscaping, or other property services during warmer months.

Duties include:

  • Respond to snow and ice events by clearing snow from designated property areas and customer sites
  • Operate snow plows, snowblowers, vehicles, and other equipment safely and efficiently while following recommended operating procedures
  • Control ice accumulation through the application of approved de-icing materials and hand-treating walkways, entrances, and other priority areas as needed
  • Perform basic maintenance and minor repairs on vehicles and equipment while maintaining safe working conditions
  • Communicate professionally with residents, customers, and team members while complying with all health and safety regulations

What experience and skills do I need to be successful?

We are always willing to train candidates in the earlier stages of their career or utilize the wealth of skills from a seasoned pro. Here are some skills we'd love to see on your resume:

  • Snow removal, landscaping, groundskeeping, construction, maintenance, or similar experience
  • Experience operating snow plows, snowblowers, skid steers, tractors, or other equipment is helpful but not required
  • Valid driver's license to travel between job sites as needed
  • Equipment operator certifications preferred
  • Ability to work outdoors in winter weather, hand shovel snow, and lift up to 50 pounds
  • Dependable, safety-minded, and able to work independently or as part of a team

Great Perks and Benefits:

Whether you're looking for seasonal work or interested in future opportunities with REMS, we offer flexible schedules and the chance to be part of a hardworking team that keeps properties safe and accessible year-round. Benefits for eligible team members include:

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • FSA/HSA account options
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) employer matching program to help save for retirement
  • Tuition reimbursement and opportunities for continued learning and professional growth
  • Supplemental insurance options including life, AD&D, STD, LTD, and critical illness coverage
  • Employee bonus program for assisting in business leads

Please keep in mind that certain insurance benefits are only eligible to team members working 30 hours per week or more year-round.

What's the schedule?

This is a seasonal, part-time position that works on an as-needed basis during snow and ice events. Team members must be available to respond when winter weather impacts our properties. Scheduling is flexible and based on weather conditions, property needs, and your availability. Additional seasonal work or future year-round opportunities may be available for candidates interested in supporting maintenance, groundskeeping, landscaping, or other property services.

How do I join?

Submit your resume and fill out all application questions to get started. Qualified candidates may complete a phone screen with our recruiting team followed by an interview with REMS leadership.

What else are you hiring for?

See all REMS' openings on our website or reach out to our Lead Recruiter, Cass Allard, on LinkedIn.

More about REMS:

REMS is part of the MBE CPAs affiliate group. The team provides property management services working with both the property owners and tenants. We manage properties across Wisconsin including Door Country, Fort Atkinson, Mauston, Marshfield, Portage, Reedsburg, Sun Prairie, Tomah, Wausau, Wisconsin Dells-Lake Delton, and our corporate headquarters in Baraboo.

activities across the MAS LAC region. • Evaluate, structure, negotiate, and close new investment transactions, portfolio restructurings, reschedulings, capital increases, equity sales, and other portfolio management activities. • Develop innovative and appropriate financial structures for complex transactions. • Lead or participate in negotiations, leveraging strong financial expertise and influencing skills to achieve successful outcomes. • Work independently and collaborate with senior colleagues to develop a strong pipeline of high-quality investment opportunities in the countries. • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, sponsors, financial institutions, private sector partners, and multilateral organizations to originate new investment opportunities. • Mentor and coach junior investment staff on all aspects of investment processing, portfolio management, and client engagement. • Support dissemination of best practices within the team. • Collaborate closely with Advisory, Environmental Social, Legal, Treasury, and other internal partners to deliver integrated client solutions, manage transaction risks, and maximize development impact. • Collaborate closely with the Upstream team to support market creation efforts and develop a robust pipeline of future investment opportunities. • Collaborate on the preparation of Country Private Sector Diagnostics (CPSD), Country Partnership Framework (CPF), Senior Management Briefs, Country Climate and Development Reports (CCDR), etc. • Engage with World Bank colleagues on MAS-related issues. •
