title: Head of Product
description:
Head of Product

Who We Are:

Customer experience is the key to growth, but other customer experience management platforms ignore that customer-facing teams often hold that key. They’re the people who can take feedback from customers and take immediate action to create change.

At AskNicely, we believe great experiences start with clarity and recognition. That’s why we built a platform focused on uncovering powerful insights, taking action, and motivating teams to deliver their best.

Trusted by over 1,000 service businesses and backed by top investors, AskNicely is on a mission to grow people-powered businesses everywhere.

AskNicely is an AI-powered customer experience platform built for multi-location service businesses. It captures real-time customer sentiment and proactively turns that into actions that grow reputation and attracts and retains customers.

What differentiates AskNicely?

  • Real-time, actionable insights through AI

  • Instantly analyzes customer sentiment (surveys, reviews and more) to provide actionable insights to all levels of the organization.

  • Identify issues and fix them immediately. Instantaneously reward positive behavior.

  • Built for multi-location, service businesses, not data analysts

  • Real-time, actionable insights for everyone: from the head office to the branch to the individual customer-facing employees.

  • Manage customer feedback and reviews to reduce churn, improve reviews and grow referrals.

  • Designed to deliver growth through exceptional customer experiences

  • Insights and action from AI. An unparalleled customer success team to help you drive culture change.

  • More than spreadsheets and reports - actions to improve customer experience and drive culture change at the point of service delivery.


Benefits

  • Free optional health insurance through Southern Cross

  • Accrue up to 4 weeks annual leave - plus an 5 extra "Nice Days" per year

  • Flexible, remote work environment

  • 8 Weeks Paid Parental Leave

  • Yearly Learning and Development reimbursement stipend


Cultural Pillars

If, like us, you put a lot of value in culture, lifestyle and opportunity as well as benefits, you'll like what's on offer here (watch this).

Lot’s of people ask about the culture at AskNicely. There are three non-negotiables to what we call “living in the purple”:

  • Be NICE: We believe a great business can be built by nice people that are nice to each other.

  • Play to WIN: Bring your "A" game. We have high standards but favor speed over perfection.

  • Love your FEEDBACK: Get feedback to improve your game and give feedback generously to help others improve theirs.


What You'll Do

You’ll lead the product execution across the business while assisting the COO in developing the product strategy. You'll be responsible for defining and delivering a compelling product vision, building and coaching a high-performing product team, influencing engineering and ensuring alignment between product, customers, and company goals.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strategic thinking, operational rigour, and a deep understanding of SaaS and customer-centric development.

  • Lead the product roadmap – prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and communicate clearly to stakeholders.

  • Be the messenger - Build internal buy in for product initiatives through strong story telling and communication around product strategy and value.

  • Drive the product strategy – align it with company objectives, market opportunity, and customer needs.

  • Mentor and grow the product team – provide clear goals, feedback, and development opportunities.

  • Collaborate and influence cross-functionally – work closely with Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales, and Leadership.

  • Champion the voice of the customer – bring data and insights into every decision; lead discovery processes.

  • Measure success and iterate fast – use data to validate ideas, track adoption, and drive improvements.

  • Own product lifecycle management – from ideation to sunset, ensure timely, quality releases.


Who You Are

  • Proven experience in a senior product leadership role within a SaaS business (Head of Product, Director of Product, or similar).

  • Strong strategic thinking, with a track record of delivering results in scaling environments.

  • Deep understanding of agile product development and working closely with engineering teams.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills – you can align and influence across all levels.

  • A natural leader who inspires teams and builds a culture of ownership, experimentation, and accountability.

  • Customer-obsessed, data-driven, and outcomes-focused.


Studies have shown that, while men will typically apply to a role when they have 60% of listed qualifications, women and marginalized communities tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Upholding marginalized communities is central to our core at AskNicely, so we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet 100% of listed criteria.

title: Flexible Side Work For Drivers- Only One Store Visit Weekly
description:
Get Paid to Drive Your Route. Work When It Works for You.

Field Technician — National Water Services, LLC- Water Machines

1099 Independent Contractor | $25/hr | Indianapolis, IN

If you like working independently, hate being stuck at a desk, and want a consistent route you can count on — this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

NWS operates water vending machines in retail stores across the country. We’re building a team of Field Technicians in the Indianapolis, IN, to keep those machines clean, stocked, and running right. It’s straightforward work, it pays well, and you’re in charge of your own time.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Each week (or every two weeks, depending on the location), you’ll visit your assigned stores and:

• Clean and disinfect the FreshPure machine inside and out

• Take meter readings and log the data on your service report

• Snap photos of the machine condition at every visit

• Submit your completed report to the home office when you’re done

• Call in anything that looks off — damage, mechanical issues, anything unusual

That’s it. Each stop takes about an hour. Your total hours per week depend on how many stores are on your route.

What Makes This Different from Other Gig Work

• Consistent, scheduled route — not random job pickups

• Same stores every week, so you know exactly where you’re going

• $25/hr all-in — your mileage and travel are already baked into the rate

• Supplies provided — we give you everything you need to do the job

• Real support — a home office contact you can actually reach

This Is NOT a Repair Job

You’re not expected to fix anything. If a machine has a mechanical or technical issue, you flag it and we send a Service Technician. Your job is to keep things clean, documented, and reported — that’s where your value is.

What You Need to Get Started

• A reliable vehicle and a valid driver’s license

• A smartphone with a camera for photo submissions

• Attention to detail — you follow the checklist, every time

• You show up when you’re scheduled. That’s the most important thing.

No experience in water systems required. If you’ve done field services, retail merchandising, delivery routes, janitorial work, or anything similar — you’ll hit the ground running.

Who Thrives in This Role

This is a great fit if you’re already doing gig work and want something more predictable layered in, or if you’re looking for flexible part-time income that fits around your schedule. People who do well here tend to be:

• Self-starters who don’t need someone looking over their shoulder

• Detail-oriented — you notice things other people miss

• Reliable — your stores count on you showing up

• Good communicators — you keep the home office in the loop

How to Apply

Click “Apply Now” to be directed to our application. It only takes a few minutes to complete.

If we’re moving forward, you’ll hear from us by email. Interviews are conducted virtually via Microsoft Teams — we’ll send you a calendar invite with everything you need.

You can also view all open positions across our locations at:

freshpure.com/careers

title: Project Specialist
description:
MSM North America is seeking a detail-oriented and resourceful Project Specialist to support project planning, business operations, activities, and program execution across our growing organization. This position works closely with program leadership and cross-functional teams to evaluate project requirements, develop execution plans, identify operational challenges, and recommend solutions that support successful project delivery.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical and organizational skills, experience supporting complex projects, and the ability to exercise independent judgment in managing assigned responsibilities within a dynamic defense contracting environment.

What You'll Do

  • Support project planning and execution. Independently manage assigned project activities, evaluate requirements, establish work plans, and recommend approaches to support project objectives.

  • Analyze project requirements. Review customer requests, project documentation, and contractual requirements to identify operational considerations, resource needs, and potential execution challenges.

  • Support proposal development. Evaluate proposal requirements, coordinate cross-functional inputs, develop supporting project materials, and recommend approaches to address customer needs and submission requirements.

  • Evaluate project performance. Analyze schedules, milestones, deliverables, and performance information to identify trends, assess potential risks, and recommend corrective actions.

  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives. Work with program leadership, engineering, operations, contracts, finance, and supply chain to evaluate dependencies, resolve coordination challenges, and support execution priorities.

  • Develop project reporting. Prepare project assessments, management reports, schedules, and presentations that provide meaningful analysis and recommendations to support leadership decisions.

  • Support resource and cost planning. Assist with evaluating resource requirements, project estimates, and cost information to identify potential constraints and recommend adjustments.

  • Improve business processes. Evaluate existing project management practices, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and recommend improvements to workflows, reporting, and documentation.

  • Manage assigned responsibilities. Exercise independent judgment in prioritizing activities, determining appropriate approaches, and resolving project-related challenges within established authority.

  • Support project lifecycle activities. Contribute to project initiation, planning, execution, performance evaluation, and closeout activities as business needs evolve.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, operations, engineering, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • 3–5 years of applicable experience in project management support, program operations, contract administration, business operations, or a related professional environment.

  • Demonstrated experience analyzing project requirements, coordinating complex activities, and developing recommendations to support business objectives.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate information and recommend effective solutions.

  • Experience managing multiple priorities and assigned projects with limited day-to-day supervision.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information and recommendations to internal stakeholders.

  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, take initiative, and adapt to changing project requirements.

Experience supporting government contracts, defense programs or technically complex projects is preferred.

What Success Looks Like

You will serve as a reliable resource to program leadership by independently managing assigned project activities, evaluating requirements, and providing recommendations that support informed decision-making. Your ability to anticipate challenges, improve processes, and coordinate effectively across teams will contribute to project performance and the continued growth of MSM North America.

Benefits & Culture

We believe a strong workplace is built on more than benefits. We are committed to fostering a professional, collaborative, and respectful environment where employees are valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We complement our workplace culture with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, and work-life balance of our employees. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance; and the option to purchase additional voluntary life insurance.

title: Analytical Development Scientist ADQC
description:
The Analytical Development Scientist ADQC provides strong scientific judgment as well as hands-on laboratory expertise within the ADQC laboratory. This role focuses on driving day-to-day lab performance, ensuring consistent cGMP and regulatory compliance and data integrity standards. The role is responsible for executing analytical development activities supporting biologics programs from early phase to pivotal phase, regulatory submission, and commercialization. The incumbent will lead method development, optimization, qualification, validation, method transfer to internal and external laboratories, method lifecycle management, and ensure analytical readiness to support CMC milestones and regulatory submissions.

The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners in a highly regulated, fast-paced environment is crucial to this position.

Please note that some relocation assistance is available for this role.

Duties and Responsibilities (Include but are not limited to):
  • Lead and perform hands-on analytical work including method development, qualification, validation, transfer to internal and external QC labs, lifecycle management, and author associated documentation (method development reports, technical reports, qualification / validation reports, method SOP etc.)
  • Ensure analytical readiness for late‑stage development, PPQ, and commercial launch of SAB-142 polyclonal antibody program.
  • Lead and perform hands-on method troubleshooting, method optimization, method bridging, method performance monitoring, investigations (deviations, system suitability failure, OOT, OOS), CAPA, change control, continuous method improvement initiatives, and author associated documentation.
  • Contribute to qualification and stability monitoring of reference standard, assay control, and critical reagents, qualification and testing of extended characterization assays, and forced degradation/stress sample study.
  • Ensure analytical activities performed internally and at external partners are scientifically rigorous, comply with cGMP, ICH, USP, global regulations, and QbD principles, and align with industry’s best practices and company quality standards.
  • Contribute to specification setting, and regulatory submissions.
  • Manage general laboratory operations, equipment qualification & maintenance, support the scaling of analytical capabilities, establishment of analytical non-GMP development area, and implementing workflows and LIMS.
  • Partner closely with Quality Control and Quality Assurance to establish, maintain, and oversee analytical quality, GMP compliance infrastructure, and inspection readiness for internal and external analytical documents and data.
  • Other duties/responsibilities as assigned.
Supervisory Responsibilities:
This position does not supervise employees at this time. May supervise junior staff as the group expands.
Will have indirect supervisory level responsibilities with external partner/CDMO partnerships, and relationships.

Education/Experience/Skills:
  • Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of progressively responsible and relevant experience in life sciences, Biophysics, Biochemistry or a related discipline in a biotech/pharma environment. Master’s degree highly desirable.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in A280, HPLC, CE-SDS, cIEF, and LC-MS for biologics. Experience in ELISA, and cell-based potency methods is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of method validation, method transfer, and applicable guidelines (ICH, FDA guidance documents, USP/EP chapters etc.) with deep expertise in cGMP requirements.
  • Experience in reference standard program, critical reagent program, and forced degradation study
  • Utilizes established mathematical and scientific techniques including simple statistical analysis to compile and analyze data. Trend analysis /control charting is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and technical writing skills and the ability to effectively present information in one-on-one, small groups, and departmental/cross functional meetings.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).

Working Environment and Travel:
Duties will be performed in normal office, laboratory and BSL2 laboratory environments.
Travel is not typical for this position.

Physical Requirements:
Ability to regularly move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this individual include close vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee will view a computer monitor for long periods of time.

The NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs team develops and executes advocacy strategies that advance NBCUniversal’s business priorities and protect the company’s operations at the state and local levels. title: Lead Program Facilitator
description:
Title: Lead Program Facilitator

Location: In Person at exalt's location in Syracuse, NY (224 Harrison Street, 7th Floor)

Schedule: Working Hours: 11am-7pm; Classes 3pm-5pm


ABOUT exalt

exalt is a nationally recognized nonprofit organization dedicated to transforming outcomes for court-involved youth ages 15–19. For two decades, exalt has inspired young people at a critical crossroads to believe in their worth and create lasting behavioral change. Through our integrated model of structured classes, individualized support, paid internships, court advocacy, and alumni resources, we equip youth with the skills, experience, and confidence to avoid further justice system involvement and become self-sufficient, productive members of society. At exalt, we empower youth to see a future filled with hope — and we provide the road map to get there.

POSITION SUMMARY

exalt is seeking a Lead Program Facilitator to join the Syracuse team. The Lead Program Facilitator guides cohorts of young people through exalt's program — a transformative journey that moves participants from classroom learning to real-world internship experience and, ultimately, to a concrete plan for their future. The Lead Program Facilitator guides three components of this core program:

  • Pre-Internship Preparation (4 weeks): A daily workshop-style class that builds four core skills — critical thinking, communication, creative problem-solving, and resource management (the ability to identify and leverage available supports and opportunities) — while connecting employability, educational engagement, and justice system avoidance to real-life decision-making.

  • Internship Phase (4 weeks): During this phase, participants are placed in paid internships. The Lead Program Facilitator leads weekly Friday Seminars that help students connect their workplace experiences to the three key areas where exalt supports its participants: justice system avoidance, academic progression, and employability.

  • Post-Internship Phase (1 week): A daily class during which participants synthesize their internship experience with prior learning and develop tangible, personal goals and strategies for staying on track after the program — in school, at work, and in their communities.

exalt's approach centers the voices, experiences, and cultures of our young people. Rather than relying on traditional lecture-based instruction, the Lead Program Facilitator creates space for participants to explore ideas through dialogue, creativity, and real-world application — building critical thinking and self-advocacy through active participation. This approach also builds discipline and accountability, inspiring youth to internalize and apply exalt's four core skills to decision-making across settings — in school, in professional environments, and in their daily lives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Facilitate multiple program cycles annually for cohorts of youth ages 15-19, creating an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Build authentic relationships with young people who are typically resistant to traditional educational settings.
  • Assess individual student learning styles, challenges and strengths and tailor instruction to maximize engagement and comprehension.
  • Communicate regularly with Program Coordinator and exalt staff to share students' obstacles, assets and opportunities.
  • Enter weekly data in Salesforce database including attendance, performance and notes assessing developmental progress and setbacks of students.
  • Devise creative strategies to address the diverse needs of students at risk of not completing the program.
  • Link all classroom discussion and instruction to exalt’s long-term goals for students: increased investment and persistence in school, employability, and sustained avoidance of further justice system involvement.
  • Conduct all pre- and post- assessments on schedule.
  • Collaborate with Program Coordinator to develop individualized goals for students and support their progress towards goals by conducting school visits, attending court appearances, or connecting them to additional resources as needed.
  • Collaborate with exalt staff on a regular basis to assess and support participants’ ongoing progress and needs, particularly in education, criminal justice system avoidance, and employment.
  • Support the program team in maintaining a positive organizational culture, including setting and maintaining the tone for student behavior in the office space, welcoming external visitors, and upholding office policies and procedures.

PERFORMANCE MEASURES

  • Students’ progress in classroom engagement and participation as measured through Likert scales, attendance, adherence to program contract obligations, and progress notes.
  • Students’ progress in comprehension, internalization and application of exalt’s four core skills and additional curriculum content as measured through pre- and post-program assessments.
  • Retention of at least 75% of enrolled students in each class through entire four-week pre-internship classroom session, and 55-60% full program completion.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • Bilingual, Spanish-speaking a plus.
  • We welcome candidates from diverse professional backgrounds including the arts, social work, community organizing, youth development, and other non-traditional paths. A background in formal education is not required.
  • All employees are required to have had a Covid 19 vaccination.


Core Competencies

  • Creative Engagement: Ability to use creative tools and approaches to connect with young people where they are and bring concepts to life. Comfort thinking outside traditional educational frameworks to reach participants who have been disengaged by conventional learning environments.

  • Group Facilitation: Demonstrated ability to lead a group of high school-aged youth who may be resistant to traditional educational settings. Balance clear structure, accountability, and high expectations with an engaging, participatory facilitation style that fosters trust and active involvement.

  • Adaptability: Able to adapt quickly to new information and unexpected obstacles, and approach change positively. Comfortable adjusting exalt's curriculum to the specific needs, learning styles, and personalities of each cohort of participants.

  • Applied Learning: Able to learn and apply new position-related information quickly. For example, all exalt youth interface with the juvenile or criminal (adult) justice systems. The Lead Program Facilitator must become familiar with these systems to understand their role in participants' lives and relevance to the curriculum.

  • Communication: Clearly and effectively convey and receive information and ideas with participants and colleagues through a variety of formats. Strong written, verbal, and listening skills.

  • Planning and Organizing: Organize work, set priorities, determine resource requirements, and seek input from supervisors and colleagues. Identify the necessary sequence of activities to achieve goals.

  • Stress Tolerance: exalt participants face significant obstacles and often have pending court requirements that put their freedom in jeopardy. Staff must be able to make challenging decisions (e.g., potentially releasing a participant who cannot meet program standards despite flexibility) and manage the emotional weight of working with young people facing serious challenges.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Salary: $65,000-$70,000
  • Insurance: medical, dental, vision and life
  • 401k matching plan: 50% matching of employee's contribution up to 5% of salary
  • Commuter and parking flexible spending
  • Generous paid time off

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Child and Family Services Administrative Reviewer
description:
Department Information




This position is open to current Colorado residents only.
Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies.

About this Unit:
The Administrative Review Division's (ARD) vision is to create a safe and promising future for children and at-risk adults. Our mission is to strengthen the communities, families, and systems that work to make that future possible. As a neutral, third party, we do this by facilitating reviews, gathering and analyzing data, publishing research, and providing training and technical assistance to effect change in practice, policy, and programs that lead to improved outcomes for Colorado's children and at-risk adults.

Colorado's Administrative Review Division (ARD) serves as an independent third party review system under the auspices of the Colorado Department of Human Services. The ARD manages quality assurance and quality improvement programs for Colorado’s child welfare and adult protective services systems. Specifically, the ARD is the mechanism responsible for the federally required Case Review System and a portion of the Quality Assurance System for both the Division of Child Welfare and the Division of Youth Services. Additionally, the ARD conducts quality assurance reviews of Adult Protective Services cases.

With an ultimate passion of providing permanency and well-being for Colorado's children, and the safety and protection of at-risk adults, the Administrative Review Division works closely with Colorado's counties to train, measure and assess their adherence to State and Federal regulations. Such regulations are in place to help prevent unnecessary moves for children in foster care and to assess (and encourage) that the needs of the families', children, and at-risk adults are being appropriately addressed.

Specifically, the ARD is the mechanism responsible for:
  • Child Welfare Quality Assurance:
    • The federally required child welfare Case Review and Qualitative Case Review systems,
      • Administrative Reviews
      • Court ordered substituting Administrative Reviews
      • Screen Out Reviews/Assessment Reviews
      • In-home Services Case Reviews
      • Institutional Abuse/Neglect Reviews

    • Colorado’s statutorily mandated Child Fatality Review Team

    • Foster Home Certification Reviews

    • Child Welfare Hotline Reviews

  • Adult Protective Services Quality Assurance:

    • Adult Protective Services qualitative case reviews

  • Child and Adult Maltreatment Dispute Review Section

    • Child abuse and neglect dispute review unit

    • Adult Protective Services dispute review unit

  • Qualified Residential Treatment Program Placement Review

Description of Job

PLEASE NOTE: This position follows a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote work with regular travel. The employee will maintain a home office located within 20 miles of the Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS) offices at 1575 Sherman Street, Denver, CO 80203. Candidates are preferred to reside in the following counties within the Denver metro region: Denver County, Broomfield County, Northern Jefferson County, Western Adams County, and Southern Boulder County. The ideal home location is north of Interstate 70 (I-70), east of the foothills corridor served by the major highways such as Interstate 25 (I-25) and Interstate 76 (I-76) within this metro zone, and no further east than Denver International Airport. These major transportation routes support the frequent travel requirement throughout the assigned counties.


Please note: These working arrangements are subject to change



About this Position:
Provides independent third party review and quality improvement processes for the Division of Child Welfare (CW) and the Division of Youth Services (DYS) service delivery. These reviews and quality assurance processes include:
  • Administrative Reviews,
  • Court-ordered Substituting Administrative Reviews,

  • Quality Assurance Reviews (including reviews of child protection assessments and in-home service cases),

  • Child and Family Services Reviews

  • Ad-hoc reviews, and

  • IV-E eligibility reviews to maximize Title IV-E revenue and ensure that court orders contain federally required language.


Qualitative Case Reviews:

  • Responsible for conducting periodic Administrative Reviews for children every six months they are in care, and Administrative Permanency Reviews every 12 months children are in out-of-home (foster) care per CRS 19-2- 906.5 and 19-3-702. This process involves collecting, analyzing, interpreting and summarizing data gathered through the file read and personal interview. Based on the data collected, a determination will be made as to the compliance or non-compliance with Federal and State regulations that govern all children and youth in the custody of the county department of human/social services or Division of Youth Services. Recommends administrative response and/or sanctions for non-compliance. This position will also conduct reviews of child welfare assessments as well as cases involving the provision of in-home services. description:
Job Title: Cycle Counter
Manager Title Inventory Manager

FECON, LLC is a vegetation management equipment manufacturer located in Lebanon, Ohio near Kings Island Amusement Park. FECON is known for having very high-quality products and a team culture – and we are growing! The Cycle Counter is responsible for monitoring warehouse inventory locations throughout Fecon and performing cycle counting duties that all material is properly verified and are reflective of reported inventory within the ERP System.   • Assists other team members in the locating of necessary items.
  • Acts as a back up to Cycle Count team members in cases of absenteeism, if needed.
  • Completes any other tasks or project assigned by a member of the Materials Management Team.
  • Follows all Fecon Safety rules and regulations.
Required Skills/Abilities:
  • Possesses strong attention to detail abilities.
  • Basic computer skills needed to work within company ERP system.
  • Possesses basic problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate either verbally or electronically.
  • Be self-driven and safety minded.
Education and Experience:
  • Must have a high school degree or equivalent
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience in a like role
Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to lift parts weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to handle short term weather conditions for counts of material in outside warehousing locations.

title: Sr. Architect
description:
"Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship"


About the role

Prime Data Centers is a private developer, owner, and long-term operator of hyperscale and purpose-built data centers across top-tier U.S. and European markets. We build the infrastructure that powers AI, high-performance computing, and digital transformation for the world's leading hyperscalers and Neoclouds.


What you'll do

  • The Sr. Architect is a technical individual contributor within the Civil/Structural/Architectural (CSA) Engineering discipline in Design & Engineering (D&E) at Prime Data Centers. This role owns architectural scope across PDC's hyperscale and purpose-built data center projects — building shell, life safety, code compliance, and space planning — from concept through construction support, across multiple U.S. and European markets with different codes, jurisdictions, and AHJ requirements.
  • This is a hands-on technical role, not a people-management position. It exists because architectural decisions on hyperscale campuses — code compliance, life safety, jurisdictional entitlement — carry real schedule, permitting, and liability exposure in markets PDC hasn't built in before.

TECHNICAL EXECUTION & OWNERSHIP

  • Lead architectural design and review for building shell, life safety, and space planning across hyperscale and purpose-built projects
  • Research and apply jurisdiction-specific code and entitlement requirements for new and existing markets, domestic and international
  • Resolve technically ambiguous architectural problems: unusual AHJ requirements, life safety coordination with MEP/Fire Protection, space planning conflicts
  • Balance speed, risk, cost, and quality in architectural decisions; flag when a design choice trades one for another

STANDARDS & TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE

  • Define, apply, and evolve PDC's architectural design standards and prototype layouts for repeatable campus deployment
  • Identify opportunities for standardization and reuse across projects to reduce engineering effort and design cycle time
  • Reduce technical debt and late-stage architectural surprises — code, permitting, life safety — through sound judgment early in design

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Partner with Design, Structural, Civil, MEP Engineering, Construction, and Operations on architectural coordination
  • Support site selection and due diligence with zoning, entitlement, and code-risk assessment for candidate sites and markets
  • Communicate code and design tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders — schedule, cost, and permitting risk, not just code citations
  • Support third-party architectural consultant management: scoping, review, and quality control of deliverables


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of architectural experience, including mission-critical, industrial, or large-scale technical facility design
  • Licensed Architect (RA) strongly preferred; NCARB certification a plus
  • Strong knowledge of IBC, NFPA, ADA, and code compliance across multiple U.S. jurisdictions
  • Experience with entitlement, permitting, and AHJ coordination in new markets
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction; strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Have deep architectural experience in data centers, industrial, mission-critical, or comparable large-scale technical facilities
  • Are comfortable owning large, complex architectural scopes independently with minimal oversight
  • Have navigated code compliance and entitlement across multiple U.S. jurisdictions (international experience a plus)
  • Communicate technical and code tradeoffs clearly and pragmatically to non-architects
  • Take pride in design that is buildable, permittable, and repeatable — not just aesthetically resolved


Benefits

  • Competitive salary range and performance bonus program
  • 401k fully vested upon enrollment, up to a 4% employer match
  • 100% employee premiums paid by employer for medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability
  • Paid Time Off + Sick time

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

title: Junior Test Engineer (VOR)
description:
Expression is seeking a Junior Test Engineer to help improve the quality, reliability, and usability of VOR, our platform for connecting data, AI agents, and workflows to support complex operational needs.

You will work alongside developers, product owners, and experienced engineers to test web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-enabled workflows. You will help investigate unexpected behavior, identify gaps in the user experience, and build repeatable ways to verify that the product works.

We are looking for someone who asks good questions, enjoys figuring out how systems behave, and is eager to use AI and automation in their work. Test plans provide a starting point; curiosity and sound judgment help uncover the problems they miss. You do not need to arrive as an automation expert, but you should want to learn how to turn repetitive testing into reliable automated checks.

Clearance: Eligibility to obtain a clearance is required.
Location: Hybrid or Remote. Our HQ is located at the heart of Washington, DC. If you are local you are welcome to use our office and all the perks that it offers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test VOR’s web interfaces, APIs, and workflows, including how users connect data sources, configure tools and agents, and review workflow results.
  • Explore real user scenarios, edge cases, and failure conditions to find issues beyond documented acceptance criteria.
  • Work with developers and product owners to clarify expected behavior and identify quality risks early.
  • Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and useful evidence such as screenshots, logs, or API responses.
  • Use approved AI tools to help explore test scenarios, generate test data, draft automation, and investigate failures. Review and verify their output.
  • Build and maintain automated tests with guidance from experienced engineers, prioritizing repeatable checks that protect important user journeys.
  • Help evaluate AI-enabled features for grounded responses, useful citations, appropriate tool behavior, and consistent handling of uncertainty.
  • Test permissions, data boundaries, approval steps, and error recovery to help ensure workflows behave appropriately.
  • Investigate failed tests, distinguish product defects from test or environment issues, and verify fixes.
  • Contribute clear testing evidence and communicate remaining risks to support release decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related fields and 1 year of professional experience.
  • 2+ years of foundational experience with software testing or development through employment, internships, coursework, or personal projects.
  • Basic understanding of functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
  • Ability to translate a user goal or requirement into meaningful test scenarios, including unexpected inputs and failure cases.
  • Willingness to learn scripting and test automation using languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Openness to using AI tools thoughtfully, checking their work, and improving your approach through experimentation.
  • Strong analytical skills and the persistence to investigate an issue when the cause is unclear.
  • Ability to explain findings clearly and collaborate constructively with others.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to browser automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
  • Experience testing APIs with tools such as Postman, curl, or automated test frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and reading application logs.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL, data validation, or testing data ingestion and retrieval.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or testing applications that incorporate language models.
  • Exposure to containers, cloud environments, or enterprise software.
  • Eligibility to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

What Success Looks Like: You will learn how VOR’s users work, find meaningful defects, and make those findings easy for the team to act on. Over time, you turn recurring checks into useful automation and help the team understand what has been tested, what remains uncertain, and where more investigation is needed.

Benefits:

Expression offers competitive salaries and benefits, such as:

  • 401k matching
  • PPO and HDHP medical/dental/vision insurance
  • Education reimbursement up to $10,000/yr
  • Complimentary life insurance
  • Generous PTO and 11 days of holiday leave
  • Onsite gym facility at our HQ
  • Commuter Benefits Plan
  • In-office Cold Brew Coffee

About Expression:

Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Washington DC, Expression provides data fusion, data analytics, AI/ML, software engineering, information technology, and electromagnetic spectrum management solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of State, and national security community. Expression’s culture focuses on creating immediate and sustainable value for our clients via agile delivery of tailored solutions built through constant engagement with our clients. Expression was ranked #1 on the Washington Technology 2018's Fast 50 list of fastest-growing small business Government contractors and a Top 20 Big Data Solutions Provider by CIO Review.

We make sure to provide everyone with the tools and opportunities to grow while working on some of the newest technologies in the industry. We get excited about celebrating our professionals' milestones, accomplishments, promotions, overcoming challenges, and many other aspects that make an engaging collaborative environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled
Expression is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please submit your request to our Human Resources department through the application portal.

title: Clinical Diabetes Specialist - Greensboro, NC
description:
About Beta Bionics

Beta Bionics, Inc. is a medical technology company dedicated to bringing innovative type 1 diabetes management solutions to the many, not the few. We are committed to bringing better access to better solutions – and a better life for those living with diabetes – with the world’s first bionic pancreas called the iLet. The iLet Bionic Pancreas is the first and only insulin delivery system that does not require carb counting*, bolusing, correction factors, or pre-set basal rates. The only number needed to get started with the iLet Bionic Pancreas is a user’s weight – the iLet does the rest. The iLet lets users “Go Bionic” with their diabetes management.
*User must be carb aware.

Successful candidates will be working with highly experienced colleagues, who are amongst the best in their fields. We have a mission-driven, passionate and collaborative culture where you will have a high degree of empowerment and opportunity to make a significant impact.

Please contact us if you fit the profile below and if you are interested in joining the Beta Bionics team!


Beta Bionics is seeking a passionate and driven Clinical Diabetes Specialist to join our fast-growing startup. We’re revolutionizing diabetes care with the iLet, the world’s first closed-loop insulin delivery system with fully autonomous insulin dosing and no requirement to count carbs. In just our first 18 months on the market, we’ve experienced unprecedented growth—outpacing any other diabetes product launch! Our future looks even more exciting with the development of a patch pump and a bi-hormonal system utilizing insulin and glucagon.

This is your chance to get in on the ground floor of an exciting, mission-driven start-up company. If you’re a CDCES, interested in working in the industry or have already made a career in the industry, and passionate about healthcare innovation, we’d love to have you on our team.

Join us and help shape the future of diabetes care!

Summary/Objective:

As the Clinical Diabetes Specialist, you are responsible for the promotion and clinical support of Beta Bionics products and services within your assigned geography. You are responsible for managing the training journey for people with diabetes. You will be the main point of contact for the educational needs of the iLet user, healthcare professionals and staff. In partnership with the Territory Business Manager and Inside Sales Specialists, you will develop a targeting and business strategy and develop and maintain strong relationships with our customers. This role requires that you work well in a collaborative environment with the ability to influence cross-functional team success. You must have strong planning and organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities. You will operate with a passion to serve people living with diabetes and our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

[Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Qualified candidates who need a reasonable accommodation with the application process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position should notify the company’s HR contact]

  • Responsible for driving territory goals through strong clinical experience in diabetes
  • Manages, conducts, and supports the training journey for people with diabetes
  • Demonstrates strong teaching and training ability for providers and people with diabetes
  • Will use strong selling skills through a clinical medium
  • Works in conjunction with Territory Business Manager and Inside Sales Specialist to achieve territory goals
  • Maintains compliant communication/documentation with team through Salesforce.com
  • Assists with providing product demos to providers, people with diabetes and families
  • Demonstrates excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Responsible for training the trainer in provider offices
  • Demonstrates empathy with a passion to serve people with diabetes
  • Stands out as a Health Coach – sees the person with diabetes holistically
  • Demonstrates effective planning and organization skills with ability to handle multiple priorities
  • Ability to navigate and influence at all levels within an HCP and IDN environment

Required Education and Experience

  • RN or RD
  • CDCES required
  • Acceptable licenses: APRN, NP, PA
  • Minimum requirement of 3 years diabetes experience

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • 5+ years diabetes experience
  • Preferred industry experience

Work Environment and Personal Protective Equipment

  • This is a field-based position. Candidate must reside in the geography specified in the job title

Physical Demands

  • While performing the duties of this job, the incumbent is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with co-workers
  • This position requires travel depending upon business needs

Compensation and Benefits

The annual base salary for this position is $90,000 - $100,000, plus an annual commission target, resulting in an annual earnings target of $128,000 - $138,000. Beta Bionics offers a competitive compensation package that includes equity and comprehensive benefit offerings.

Beta Bionics offers healthcare benefits for employees and their families including medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as flexible spending accounts (FSA) and a health savings account (HSA) that includes an annual company contribution. Our comprehensive benefits package also includes a 401k with a generous company match and no waiting period plus immediate vesting, an open PTO policy, and 10 paid holidays per year.

Annual base salary will vary based on skills and experience, and may vary depending upon a candidate’s location and relevant market data.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

It is the policy of Beta Bionics to provide equal employment opportunity to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Beta Bionics will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

title: Houseperson
description:
HOUSEPERSON
This is a hands-on, physically active position that works closely with Housekeeping and may also provide support to Engineering, Front Desk, and other hotel departments as needed.
The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys staying busy, and is always willing to jump in and help wherever needed.
POSITION SUMMARY
The Houseperson supports the daily operations of the Housekeeping Department and assists with maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of the hotel.
Responsibilities include assisting Room Attendants, maintaining public areas, delivering guest amenities and requested items to guestrooms, assisting with hotel laundry, supporting Engineering with basic hotel needs, and setting up and breaking down meeting and event spaces.
The Houseperson must be comfortable performing physical work throughout the shift and must be able to lift and carry up to 40 pounds.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Housekeeping Support

Support Room Attendants with daily housekeeping operations.

Deliver and collect linens, towels, and housekeeping supplies.

Assist with the distribution and collection of linen throughout the hotel.

Remove trash and soiled linens from guestrooms and housekeeping areas.

Assist with cleaning and maintaining housekeeping storage areas.

Assist Room Attendants with special cleaning projects and high-occupancy needs.

Assist with deep-cleaning projects as assigned.

Help maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Provide additional Housekeeping support wherever needed based on hotel occupancy and business levels.

Public Area Cleaning

Maintain the cleanliness and appearance of hotel public areas.

Clean and maintain hallways, elevators, stairways, lobby areas, and other assigned spaces.

Vacuum, sweep, mop, dust, and perform other cleaning duties as needed.

Clean and maintain public restrooms.

Empty trash and maintain trash collection areas.

Respond promptly to spills and other cleanliness concerns.

Help ensure the hotel maintains a clean, welcoming appearance throughout the day and evening.

Guest Requests & Guest Service

Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests.

Deliver requested amenities, towels, blankets, pillows, and other approved items to guest rooms.

Assist guests with basic requests within the scope of the position.

Communicate guest concerns or requests requiring additional assistance to the appropriate department or manager.

Maintain a friendly and professional attitude when interacting with guests.

Protect guest privacy and belongings at all times.

Represent the Courtyard Marriott brand and hotel professionally.

Meeting & Event Support

Set up meeting rooms and event spaces according to hotel specifications.

Move and arrange tables and chairs safely and efficiently.

Assist with room setups for meetings, social events, and other functions.

Tear down meeting and event setups after functions are completed.

Return tables, chairs, and other equipment to their proper storage locations.

Clean meeting rooms and event spaces following events.

Remove trash and leftover materials from meeting spaces.

Assist with resetting meeting rooms for the next event.

Work with the Front Desk, Sales, Housekeeping, and management teams to ensure meeting spaces are ready on time.

Laundry Support

Assist the Laundry Attendant with laundry operations as needed.

Sort, wash, dry, fold, and organize hotel linens and towels when assigned.

Transport clean and soiled linens throughout the hotel.

Maintain an organized and clean laundry and linen storage area.

Assist with maintaining appropriate linen levels throughout the hotel.

Follow all hotel laundry, chemical handling, safety, and sanitation procedures.

Engineering Support
The Houseperson may assist the Engineering Department with basic hotel support duties as needed and within the scope of their training and responsibilities.
Duties may include:

Assist Engineering with moving or transporting materials and equipment.

Assist with basic hotel maintenance projects and preventative maintenance tasks.

Help prepare areas for maintenance work.

Report maintenance issues identified in guestrooms, public areas, or back-of-house spaces.

Assist with furniture or equipment movement.

Help maintain clean and organized Engineering and storage areas.

Immediately report safety hazards, equipment concerns, or maintenance issues to management or Engineering.

Perform only those maintenance tasks for which the employee has been properly trained and authorized.

Teamwork & Cross-Department Support

Work closely with Housekeeping, Front Desk, Engineering, Sales, and other hotel departments.

Assist other departments when business needs require additional support.

Be willing to change priorities based on hotel occupancy, guest needs, meetings, events, and operational requirements.

Maintain a positive and professional attitude.

Communicate effectively with supervisors and fellow team members.

Help create a strong team environment by being willing to step in, help out, and get the job done.

SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY
This position requires flexibility in scheduling.
The successful candidate must be available to work:

Day shifts

Evening shifts

Weekends

Holidays as needed

Schedule changes based on hotel occupancy, meetings, events, and business needs

Because hotel meetings, events, guest requests, and operational needs may occur at different times of the day, employees must be willing to work both day and evening shifts.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
This is a physically active position.
The Houseperson must be able to:

Lift and carry up to 40 pounds.

Frequently stand and walk for extended periods.

Push and pull housekeeping carts and equipment.

Move tables, chairs, furniture, and other hotel equipment.

Bend, stoop, kneel, reach, and climb stairs as needed.

Safely handle linens, housekeeping supplies, and meeting-room equipment.

Perform repetitive physical tasks throughout the shift.

Work indoors and, when necessary, assist with exterior hotel areas.

QUALIFICATIONS

Previous hotel, housekeeping, custodial, engineering, or hospitality experience preferred but not required.

Reliable and dependable attendance.

Strong work ethic and positive attitude.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

Ability to prioritize multiple tasks.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced hotel environment.

Must be able to lift up to 40 pounds.

Must have flexible availability for both day and evening shifts.

Willingness to assist multiple departments and perform a variety of hotel support duties. technician.

title: Software Developer
description:

Client: Ontario Public Service – Central Agencies Cluster
Ministry: Ministry of Treasury Board Secretariat
Location: 222 Jarvis St., Toronto, ON
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite – 5 days per week
Start Date: January 4, 2027
End Date: October 5, 2027
Openings: 2
Security Requirement: CRJMC
Application Deadline: October 14, 2026 at 12:00 PM EST
Position Overview
The Ontario Public Service is seeking Intermediate Software Developers to support the Central Agencies Cluster. The successful candidates will be responsible for translating business requirements and technical system specifications into reliable, tested enterprise applications.
The role requires strong hands-on experience with Java Enterprise technologies, Java EE, Spring Framework, JPA/Hibernate, databases, application design, deployment, troubleshooting, and unit testing, along with exposure to modern UI frameworks and cloud technologies.
Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze business requirements and technical system specifications and translate them into working software solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise applications.
  • Develop n-tier enterprise applications using Java Enterprise technologies.
  • Perform hands-on Java EE development, application design, coding, integration, deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • Apply current software architecture principles and design patterns to develop scalable and maintainable applications.
  • Develop and execute unit tests and support automated testing practices.
  • Develop and maintain applications using JPA/Hibernate and Spring Framework.
  • Design and work with relational databases, SQL queries, and stored procedures.
  • Troubleshoot application, database, integration, and deployment issues.
  • Develop and maintain web-based user interfaces using JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, technical teams, architects, QA professionals, and other project stakeholders.
  • Participate in Agile development practices, where applicable.
  • Support web services, service-oriented architecture, cloud-based solutions, and business process management initiatives.


Requirements

Mandatory Skills & Experience
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
Java Enterprise Development
  • 7+ years of experience developing n-tier enterprise applications.
  • 7+ years of hands-on development experience with Java Enterprise technologies.
  • Extensive hands-on development and troubleshooting experience on the Java EE platform.
  • Strong expertise in application design, current/latest design patterns, deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale applications.
  • Strong experience with unit testing.
JPA / Hibernate & Spring
  • Expertise with JPA or Hibernate.
  • Strong experience with the Spring Framework.
  • Experience with Spring technologies such as Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Batch, and/or Spring Security is highly relevant.
Database Technologies
  • Proficient experience working with various databases.
  • Strong SQL development experience.
  • Experience writing SQL and stored procedures.
  • Experience with databases such as:
    • Amazon Aurora
    • Amazon RDS
    • PostgreSQL
    • Oracle
    • PL/SQL
    • MySQL
    • Cosmos DB
  • Expertise with Amazon Aurora, RDS, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and PL/SQL is highly desirable.
Development Tools
  • Proficiency working with Eclipse IDE or Rational Application Developer (RAD).
Front-End / UI Development
  • Experience with modern JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, including one or more of:
    • React
    • Angular
    • jQuery
Evaluation Criteria
1. Technical Expertise – 40%
Candidates will be assessed on:
  • 7+ years developing n-tier enterprise applications.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience with Java Enterprise technologies.
  • Java EE development, application design, design patterns, deployment, troubleshooting, and unit testing.
  • Experience with ORM technologies including JPA, Hibernate, or MyBatis.
2. Spring Framework – 15%
  • Hands-on experience with the Spring Framework.
  • Experience with Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Batch, Spring Security, and related Spring technologies.
3. Database Management – 15%
  • Strong SQL development experience.
  • Experience writing stored procedures.
  • Experience with Oracle, PL/SQL, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
  • Experience with Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS is highly desirable.
4. Cloud & BPM – 20%
Experience with AWS cloud technologies, including:
  • Aurora Serverless
  • Amazon Athena
  • Amazon S3
  • Amazon ElastiCache
  • Amazon OpenSearch
Business Process Management experience with technologies such as:
  • Camunda BPM
  • Drools Rule Engine
Additional relevant BPM experience includes:
  • jBPM

title: Shipping & Receiving Coordinator
description:
Shipping & Receiving Coordinator

Broadata Communications, Inc. (BCI) – Torrance, CA
On-site

Company Overview
Broadata Communications, Inc. (BCI) is a privately held California-based corporation. BCI is a leading and innovative company specializing in the development of market-driven products for the transmission of digital multimedia (video, audio, and data) over fiber. Our clients are world leaders in their industries, spanning entertainment, broadcast, medical, professional audio/video, house of worship, education, government, military, and transportation sectors. We are ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified, with a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Job Summary
We’re seeking a motivated Shipping and Receiving Coordinator. You will support our fast-paced Shipping and Receiving Department in meeting daily customer demands by working independently to ship customer orders on time and provide outstanding service.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-driven professional who thrives in a high-tech manufacturing environment and values teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. This critical, hands-on role is based in Torrance, CA. We offer a fast-paced, high impact and stimulating work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development within BCI. Veterans welcome!

This is a hands-on position. This is NOT a remote or hybrid position.

Key Responsibilities
  • Package and process daily shipments within time constraints.
    • Run required reports and send out shipment notifications daily.
    • Maintain Shipping log daily.
  • Receive inbound material into a system of record and quality data base.
    • Issue material as needed and send receipt notifications as required.
    • Maintain Receiving log daily.
  • Compare identifying information and counts, weighs, or measures items of incoming and outgoing shipments to verify information against Bills of Lading, Invoices, Purchase Orders, or other records. Attention to detail is critical.
  • Generate contractually required shipping and receiving documentation for all shipments (Packing Lists, Receiving Reports, Commercial Invoices, custom forms) using customer portals.
  • Maintain awareness of small pack carrier changes, applicable regulations, customer shipping requirements, freight forwarders and carriers utilized.
  • Review and follow up on shipping agreements, discounts, claims and carrier issues. Generate LTL freight quotes for customers and vendors as needed.
  • Organize finished goods and perform physical counts as needed. Manage and account for packaging materials, replenish as needed to support shipments.
  • Assist with various material management and projects as time permits.
  • Generate Export and Import International shipping documents. Reconcile freight Invoices.
  • Work with Supply Chain Team to identify specific contract requirements related to shipping administration. Communicate with Supply Chain Team and support Production, Engineering and Business Development.
  • Follow policies and procedures in the Broadata Quality Assurance Manual and follow applicable shipping and receiving procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Job responsibilities within our organization are dynamic. This may not be a complete list of duties. Other responsibilities and duties may be assigned by your supervisor or upper management.

Education & Experience
  • High School Diploma. Some college/vocational coursework preferred.
  • 2–4 years’ experience performing shipping and receiving or related tasks.
  • Shipping experience preferred with UPS, USPS, Fed Ex, DHL, LTL.
Skills & Abilities
  • Solid packaging knowledge is needed to make decisions on box size and protective packaging with lowest cost and best performance.
  • Ability to work within deadlines, under pressure and handle interruptions
  • Strong communication, mathematical, and problem-solving skills in addition to the ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities while adapting to changing business needs.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills across departments.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment, working extended hours (as needed).
  • Strong self-motivation and attitude for personal career growth, willingness to self-learn, and work in new technology domains
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
Physical Job Requirements
The employee in the position will be required to occasionally move throughout the facilities, including climbing stairs, when necessary. Occasional bending and reaching in an office environment, including opening and closing file cabinets drawers with light grasping. Type on a standard keyboard (laptop or desktop). Use standard computer display screens. Use standard push-button phones and must speak clearly and be understood by others. Sit or stand in a standard upright position for a minimum of one hour, but up to 12 hours a day. Be able to lift and carry weight unassisted not exceeding 50 lbs.

Compensation and Benefits
  • Salary Range: $20 - $30 (based on experience and qualifications)
  • 2 weeks paid vacation
  • 1 Week paid sick leave
  • 10 paid holidays
  • 401(k) with 100% employer matching up to 4% of salary (no vesting period)
  • Multiple options medical, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 100% Paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 100% Paid Basic Life, AD&D, LTD Insurance
  • Voluntary Life Insurance

description:

title: Service Coordinator
description:
About Us

Locally owned and operated since 1996, Wiseworth Canada Industries Ltd. is the Master Distributor for Ingersoll Rand compressed air products, parts, and services across British Columbia, Alberta, the Yukon, and Northwest Territories.

We are proud to be the largest compressed air sales and service provider in Western Canada, recognized as Top Ingersoll Rand Distributor in North America and awarded the Consumer Choice Award for Business Excellence. Our partnership with Ingersoll Rand, a global leader in compressed air innovation, positions us as the supplier of choice in our industry.

At Wiseworth, our success starts with our people. We believe in building lasting relationships, supporting one another, and creating a workplace where employees feel respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. We are a team driven by integrity, teamwork, safety, and a shared commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a friendly, organized, and customer-focused Service Coordinator to join our Lower Mainland service team, based at our head office in Surrey, BC.

In this important role, you'll be at the heart of our service operations, helping customers get the support they need while coordinating the activities of our field service technicians. You'll work closely with customers, technicians, management, and other team members to ensure service work is scheduled efficiently, customer needs are addressed promptly, and our service commitments are consistently delivered.

If you're someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, staying organized, and working in a busy, team-oriented environment, we'd love to hear from you. We're looking for someone who brings a positive attitude, strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a genuine desire to make a difference. Technical aptitude and previous service coordination experience are valuable assets, but equally important are your willingness to learn, ability to build relationships, and commitment to providing outstanding customer service.

You'll be joining an experienced and supportive team that takes pride in working together, sharing knowledge, and helping one another succeed.

Service Coordination & Scheduling

  • Proactively organize, schedule, and coordinate daily service activities for our field service technicians throughout the Lower Mainland.

  • Communicate with customers to arrange preventive maintenance, equipment repairs, and other service appointments.

  • Coordinate technician availability, service priorities, required parts, and customer expectations to support efficient service delivery.

  • Create, update, and maintain accurate service work orders using company business and scheduling systems.

  • Review completed work orders, technician time records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness prior to billing.

  • Work closely with technicians, service management, and parts personnel to address scheduling challenges and keep service activities running smoothly.

  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation, as required, to help coordinate after-hours service requests and ensure timely support.

  • Provide occasional vacation coverage for fellow service team members, helping maintain continuity of service and supporting the team.

Customer Service Excellence

  • Serve as a friendly, professional, and dependable point of contact for customers seeking service assistance.

  • Respond promptly to customer inquiries by telephone, email, and in person.

  • Listen carefully to customer concerns, ask appropriate questions, and help identify practical solutions to their service needs.

  • Prepare service and repair estimates, communicate recommendations, and follow up with customers to obtain necessary approvals.

  • Build strong, lasting customer relationships through responsive communication, reliability, and a genuine commitment to customer satisfaction.

  • Help resolve customer concerns by working collaboratively with technicians, management, and other departments.

Service Growth & Teamwork

  • Proactively contact customers to schedule maintenance and other service work that supports equipment reliability and performance.

  • Identify opportunities to recommend preventive maintenance programs, replacement parts, repairs, and other Wiseworth products and services when they provide meaningful value to customers.

  • Support service revenue growth through timely follow-up, effective scheduling, and professional customer interactions.

  • Collaborate with Account Managers, technicians, parts personnel, and other team members to provide a seamless customer experience.

  • Maintain accurate customer information, service records, estimates, and other documentation.

  • Assist with general office and service administration activities as needed.

  • Contribute to a positive, respectful, and supportive workplace where teamwork and continuous improvement are encouraged.

Qualifications

title: Maintenance Trainee
description:

Schumann Printers, Inc. is looking for a Maintenance Trainee to join our second-shift team!

You don't need to be an experienced maintenance technician to get started. We're looking for someone with basic mechanical aptitude, familiarity with hand and power tools, and a strong willingness to learn.

In this entry-level position, you'll work alongside experienced maintenance professionals who will provide hands-on training and guidance. You'll start with basic maintenance tasks and gradually develop the skills needed to maintain, troubleshoot, and repair industrial equipment.

About Us

Schumann Printers, Inc. is a national leader in commercial printing, binding, and mailing services. For over 60 years, our family-owned and operated company has been committed to quality, innovation, and outstanding customer service.

Recognized as a 2026 Top Workplace, we take pride in our employees and providing opportunities to learn, grow, and build rewarding careers.

What You'll Learn to Do

  • Identify and troubleshoot basic mechanical problems.
  • Assist with equipment repairs and replacement of mechanical components.

  • Use a variety of hand and power tools for maintenance work.
  • Assist with equipment installations and maintenance projects.

Helpful, but not required:

Why Join Schumann Printers?

  • Hands-on training: Learn directly from experienced maintenance professionals.
  • No extensive maintenance experience required: We'll help you build your technical skills.

  • Variety of work: Gain exposure to different types of equipment and maintenance projects.

Apply today to join the Schumann Printers maintenance team!
