ABOUT THE COMPANY

Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC (EMS) is a full-spectrum consulting and management firm specializing in back-office operations, financial infrastructure, executive oversight, and operational support for health and human services and community-serving organizations.


EMS provides strategic and administrative support through contractual partnerships, helping organizations strengthen operations, maintain accountability, pursue sustainable growth, and focus on their core missions.


COMPANY WEBSITE:


COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: (667) 309-5345


HR DEPARTMENT PHONE NUMBER: (667) 309-5345 EXT 10


HR DEPARTMENT EMAIL ADDRESS: hr@enterprisemgmtinc.com


POSITION TITLE: Executive Director


ALTERNATE TITLE(S): Nonprofit Executive Director, Community Development Executive Director, Executive Director – Fundraising & Grants, Community Leadership Executive


COMPANY: Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC


DIVISION: Operations


DEPARTMENT: Corporate and Professional Services Staffing


BENEFITS PACKAGE: Eligibility for applicable Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC benefit plans is subject to plan terms, part-time eligibility requirements, and applicable waiting periods.


WORK SCHEDULE: Part-Time, In Office – King William, Virginia. Weekly hours and the regular office schedule will be established before hire. Occasional evening or weekend availability may be required for Board meetings, community outreach, fundraising activities, donor meetings, events, and other authorized organizational responsibilities.


ACCOUNTABLE TO: Board of Directors for organizational direction and performance priorities, with administrative and employment coordination through designated Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC leadership.


ACCOUNTABLE FOR: Providing executive leadership; strengthening grassroots and community engagement; developing and implementing fundraising strategies; identifying and pursuing grant opportunities; cultivating donors and community partners; advancing authorized capital projects; coordinating organizational operations; implementing Board-approved priorities; maintaining appropriate financial and administrative controls; and providing comprehensive weekly reports to the Board.

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director provides hands-on leadership for a community-serving organization in King William, Virginia. The role focuses on community engagement, fundraising, grant development, daily operations, and Board-approved organizational and capital initiatives.


Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director turns organizational priorities into measurable results while demonstrating initiative, sound judgment, strong communication, relationship-building, accountability, and consistent follow-through.

title: Field Technician - 1 Hour Weekly
description:
Get Paid to Drive Your Route. Work When It Works for You.

Field Technician — FreshPure Water Machines

1099 Independent Contractor | $25/hr Mishawaka, IN

If you like working independently, hate being stuck at a desk, and want a consistent route you can count on — this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

NWS operates water vending machines in retail stores across the country. We’re building a team of Field Technicians in Mishawaka, IN to keep those machines clean, stocked, and running right. It’s straightforward work, it pays well, and you’re in charge of your own time.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Each week (or every two weeks, depending on the location), you’ll visit your assigned stores and:

• Clean and disinfect the FreshPure machine inside and out

• Take meter readings and log the data on your service report

• Snap photos of the machine condition at every visit

• Submit your completed report to the home office when you’re done

• Call in anything that looks off — damage, mechanical issues, anything unusual

That’s it. Each stop takes about an hour. Your total hours per week depend on how many stores are on your route.

What Makes This Different from Other Gig Work

• Consistent, scheduled route — not random job pickups

• Same stores every week, so you know exactly where you’re going

• $25/hr all-in — your mileage and travel are already baked into the rate

• Supplies provided — we give you everything you need to do the job

• Real support — a home office contact you can actually reach

This Is NOT a Repair Job

You’re not expected to fix anything. If a machine has a mechanical or technical issue, you flag it and we send a Service Technician. Your job is to keep things clean, documented, and reported — that’s where your value is.

What You Need to Get Started

• A reliable vehicle and a valid driver’s license

• A smartphone with a camera for photo submissions

• Attention to detail — you follow the checklist, every time

• You show up when you’re scheduled. That’s the most important thing.

No experience in water systems required. If you’ve done field services, retail merchandising, delivery routes, janitorial work, or anything similar — you’ll hit the ground running.

Who Thrives in This Role

This is a great fit if you’re already doing gig work and want something more predictable layered in, or if you’re looking for flexible part-time income that fits around your schedule. People who do well here tend to be:

• Self-starters who don’t need someone looking over their shoulder

• Detail-oriented — you notice things other people miss

• Reliable — your stores count on you showing up

• Good communicators — you keep the home office in the loop

How to Apply

Click “Apply Now” to be directed to our application. It only takes a few minutes to complete.

If we’re moving forward, you’ll hear from us by email. Interviews are conducted virtually via Microsoft Teams — we’ll send you a calendar invite with everything you need.

You can also view all open positions across our locations at:

freshpure.com/careers

title: Sr. HW Regulatory Compliance Engineer
description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Echo, Ring, and Blink — icons of ambient computing reaching hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. What will you help us create?

The Hardware Safety & Compliance (HWSC) team is the critical bridge between bold hardware innovation and worldwide market access. We don't just check boxes — we embed compliance into the DNA of product design from Day 1, ensuring that hundreds of millions of devices meet the highest standards for safety, electromagnetic compatibility, and radio frequency performance across 100+ countries.

We're looking for a Sr. HW Regulatory Compliance Engineer based in China who excels at hands-on execution of compliance testing, certification, and factory-level validation across our product portfolio. You will work closely with contract manufacturers (CMs), in-region test laboratories, and cross-functional engineering teams to drive EMC and RF compliance from engineering builds through mass production. You will be experienced in Radio Frequency (RF) and ElectroMagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing, debugging, and product certification processes. You will have strong familiarity with North American and international regulatory standards. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to validate and certify innovative wireless consumer electronic products.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused engineering role where your work directly determines whether Amazon can achieve certification milestones on schedule and maintain compliance across production lines. You will be the HWSC team's on-the-ground presence in China — coordinating test lab activities, supporting CM builds, debugging compliance issues in real time, and ensuring production units meet all certification requirements. This role requires approximately 20% travel to test laboratories and CM sites. You must be analytical, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively across multiple teams and time zones. Additionally, you must excel at communicating compliance status and technical findings clearly to both local engineering teams and global HWSC leadership.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute end-to-end compliance testing and certification activities for product programs — from engineering builds through mass production, ensuring all regulatory milestones are met on schedule
• Work closely with the product design team by researching and specifying regulatory and industry compliance requirements, with emphasis on China, FCC, IC, CE, and other international certification schemes
• Drive hands-on EMI/EMC and RF compliance testing and debugging — partnering with Electrical, Mechanical, and Wireless engineers to resolve compliance issues at the circuit, layout, firmware, or mechanical design level
• Manage day-to-day relationships with in-region 3rd party test laboratories — planning, scheduling, and directing compliance testing to drive first-pass certification success
• Support CM site compliance activities — validating that production configurations, shielding, grounding, and assembly processes maintain compliance established during development
• Debug compliance failures at the root-cause level — understanding why at the circuit, layout, firmware, or mechanical design level, and driving the fix with engineering teams in real time
• Coordinate with global HWSC team members to align on compliance strategies, share test results, and escalate issues that may impact product launch timelines
• Perform detailed, independent research and literature reviews to yield actionable conclusions to ambiguous regulatory compliance issues
• Deliver concise and informative compliance status updates to global HWSC leadership, translating test results and certification progress into clear schedule impact assessments
• Work with manufacturing partners to test and ensure all in-production devices remain compliant with all certifications, including production line testing validation
• Maintain compliance documentation, test reports, and certification records with thoroughness and accuracy to support audits and market access filings
• Contribute to best practices and mechanisms that prevent repeat compliance issues and improve certification efficiency across the device portfolio

title: Multimodal Transportation Planner
description:
Alta Planning + Design is seeking a Planner I or II for our Houston office. This production-level position is a great opportunity for someone who believes in active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation and wants to grow their career as a transportation planning professional. If you’re looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!

TEI Planning + Design recently joined Alta to launch our first Texas office, located in the heart of Downtown Houston. The Houston team has worked across the mobility spectrum in Texas, including bicycle planning and design, sidewalk and trail design, signal design and traffic operations, transit planning, corridor planning and design, holistic mobility planning, and more! As transportation continues to evolve in our communities, so does our work.

About Alta
Alta is a mission-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 250 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.
In this role, you will work on a wide variety of transportation, trails, safety, and multimodal projects. You’ll evaluate data and conduct site visits and assessments, including roadway corridors, trail corridors, and school sites, and then apply your knowledge of multimodal transportation and trail design standards to develop recommendations for our clients. You’ll participate in public outreach activities, including virtual and in-person workshops, site audits, pop-up events, charettes, and demonstration projects. You’ll use your writing, research, mapping, or graphics skills to develop reports and plans. Throughout your work, you'll collaborate with an interdisciplinary team, attend team meetings and trainings, and have opportunities to develop your technical expertise across multiple project types.
Required

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to
  • Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning or related field
  • Broad knowledge of multimodal transportation planning practices and trail design standards
  • 0-3 years of relevant work experience (internships in related fields can qualify)
  • Effective oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to lead, prepare, and contribute to the preparation of plans, reports, memos, and presentation materials.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to independently work on multiple projects and complete tasks at a high level of quality.
  • Ability to participate in public outreach or conduct site visits.
  • Desire to collaborate and participate in multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to:
  • Basic understanding of ArcGIS Pro, Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, and/or Acrobat
  • Ability to prepare graphics and maps
  • Master’s degree in planning or related field
  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Interest or experience in the active transportation field
  • Membership in a professional practice organization
Flexible Schedule
Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

Compensation
The pay range for this job in Houston is $70,000-$85,000. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

Benefits
Alta offers comprehensive benefits to all full-time employees:

  • Medical: PPO or HSA medical plans
  • Dental/Vision: PPO
  • Life Insurance: Alta pays 100% of the premium for life and AD&D, equal to your base compensation
  • 401(k): Alta provides a match up to 3%
  • PTO: 21 days accrued annually to start
  • Holidays: 11 total company paid holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave/Short-Term Disability
  • Additional Benefits: Wellness reimbursement up to $800 annually, Alta Gets Around benefit of up to $900 annually, 5-year travel award, and professional development opportunities

title: Director of Content
description:
About Shatterproof
Shatterproof is a national nonprofit working toward a world where addiction never defines or ends a life. Through evidence-based programs, advocacy, and public education, Shatterproof works to transform systems for tomorrow, support families today, and end stigma forever. Learn more at shatterproof.org.

Who Succeeds at Shatterproof
Shatterproof is in a period of transformative and rapid growth. We are building new systems, reimagining how work gets done, and creating more cross-functional alignment to accelerate our mission.
To thrive here, you should be energized by building, not just maintaining, and excited to bring structure, clarity, and innovation to evolving spaces.
We’re looking for team members who:
  • Build systems and processes from the ground up and improve them continuously as we scale.
  • Take ownership and act with a builder’s mindset, bringing forward solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Influence and collaborate across teams, shaping work through strong communication and relationship-building.
  • Move quickly, learn fast, and adapt with resilience, especially in a high-growth, high-impact environment.
  • Are mission-driven and motivated to leave their mark on an organization working to reverse the addiction crisis.
Position Summary
Director of Content leads Shatterproof’s content operations and execution across organic digital and owned platforms. Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing & Communications, this role is responsible for shaping and executing the organization’s editorial and content strategy — translating strategic priorities into clear plans, workflows, timelines and deliverables and ensuring every message, campaign and story reinforces Shatterproof’s mission, brand and values.
This leader will oversee content planning, social strategy, writing, and creative production, guiding a multidisciplinary team to deliver cohesive, data-driven narratives that engage audiences, elevate our leaders’ voices, and advance organizational goals. A highly skilled project manager and operator, this person serves as the connective tissue across the Marketing & Communications team – ensuring priorities are clear, work is coordinated, deadlines are met, and campaigns move seamlessly from strategy through execution.
Core Responsibilities
Content Strategy & Leadership
  • Translate organizational and marketing strategy into actionable content plans and lead the implementation of Shatterproof’s integrated content strategy across digital, social, and print channels.
  • Lead and mentor a creative team (social, writing, design) to produce high-quality, cohesive, and mission-aligned content.
  • Build and manage a comprehensive editorial calendar that integrates campaigns, policy milestones, cultural moments, and brand storytelling.
  • Own content production workflows and project management across the content team, establishing clear timelines, roles, dependencies and review process.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure content reflects Shatterproof’s strategic priorities and amplifies impact across programs, development, and policy.
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand standards, voice, tone, and messaging framework.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance creative culture that balances storytelling, speed, quality, and accountability.
Social & Digital Content
  • Oversee organic social media strategy and execution (through the Senior Social Marketing Strategist), ensuring alignment with campaign and organizational goals.
  • Guide content development for Shatterproof’s priority platforms — including LinkedIn, TikTok, Meta properties, and YouTube — driving growth, engagement, and community building.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders including the Direct Response Director to align content with email, web, and paid strategies.
  • Ensure integrated campaigns are translated into coordinated channel plans, with clear deliverables, owners, timelines, and handoffs across teams.
  • Ensure all digital content reflects data-driven insights and best practices for audience engagement and accessibility.

Editorial & Storytelling

  • Oversee the production of blogs, reports, newsletters, and web content that clearly communicate Shatterproof’s mission and impact.
  • Work closely with the Staff Writer and Multimedia Designer to translate complex information — including data and research — into compelling and accessible narratives.
  • Contribute directly to content creation and production as needed, including writing, editing, or managing assets during key campaigns, high-volume periods, or rapid-turnaround moments.
  • Manage the editorial review and approval process, ensuring content moves efficiently from brief through development, stakeholder review, final approval, and publication.
  • Ensure all website content, statistics, and references are regularly reviewed and updated to reflect the latest evidence-based data.
  • Partner with internal subject matter experts to ensure accuracy, relevance, and consistency in all materials.
Executive Visibility
  • Support the Vice President of Marketing & Communications in executing Shatterproof’s executive visibility efforts, ensuring leadership communications reflect organizational priorities and brand voice.
  • Draft and edit LinkedIn posts, blogs, talking points, and other written materials on behalf of the CEO, and senior executives as needed.
  • Coordinate content and creative support for executive presentations, speaking engagements, and organizational announcements.
  • Manage executive communications workflows and calendars, anticipating upcoming opportunities and ensuring materials are developed, reviewed, and finalized on time.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure executive messaging is consistent across internal and external channels.
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Measurements & Insights
  • Establish and track KPIs for content performance, including engagement, reach, and conversions.
  • Produce monthly and quarterly reports summarizing key insights and recommendations for optimization.
  • Maintain visibility into team and campaign performance, including deliverable status, deadlines, capacity, and operational risks.
  • Continuously refine content strategy based on analytics, testing, and emerging digital trends.
​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Qualifications
  • 6–10 years’ experience in content marketing, editorial management, content operations, project/program management or digital storytelling, ideally within a mission-driven or public health organization.
  • Exceptional project management and operational skills with demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional campaigns involving multiple workstreams, stakeholders and deadlines.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional creative teams and managing content production across multiple platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate high-level strategy into actionable plans, workflows, briefs, timelines, and deliverables — and drive work through completion.
  • Highly organized and proactive, with the ability to anticipate needs, identify gaps or risks early, and keep teams aligned in a fast-moving environment.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to translate complex issues, research and data into accessible, emotionally resonant stories.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social media best practices, content analytics, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience managing creative workflows, editorial calendars, and brand standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to use content to drive measurable impact — awareness, engagement, and conversion.
  • Familiarity with SEO, accessibility, and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Sprout Social, etc.).
  • Experience using Asana (or similar project management and content planning tools) to manage workflows, editorial calendars, and cross-departmental collaboration preferred.
Additional Information
  • Ability and authorization to work in the United States required.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time Zone hours required.
  • Domestic travel may be required based on organizational needs.
  • Shatterproof is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
  • Individuals with lived experience of substance use, addiction, or recovery, including family members and loved ones, are encouraged to apply. Sharing your experience is always your choice and is never required to be considered.

title: Buying & Inventory Coordinator - Head Office (Yorkdale Mall)
description:
Who are we?

Fox Group, a leading and fast-growing retailer with over 10,000 employees globally, is proud to partner with Flying Tiger Copenhagen to bring this unique shopping experience to Canada. As part of our expansion, we aim to establish Flying Tiger Copenhagen as a key player in the Canadian retail landscape, complementing our existing operations of Mango, Laline, Fox Clothing, and Nike (operated by Retailors). This collaboration marks an exciting chapter in our journey to become the number one leading group in the retail industry in Canada. With numerous growth opportunities and expansions on the horizon, now is the perfect time to join our team and turn your retail job into your dream career.

Flying Tiger Copenhagen is a Danish lifestyle retail chain that began in 1995 with a single store in Copenhagen, where every item was priced at 10 Danish kroner. The name "Tiger" plays on the Danish word "tier" (pronounced tee-uh), meaning ten kroner, which phonetically resembles the English word "tiger" . Over the past three decades, the brand has expanded to over 1,000 stores across 42 countries, with its largest markets in Denmark, the United Kingdom, Italy, and Spain. Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers a wide array of products, primarily focusing on accessories and toys, all designed to bring a sense of fun and surprise to everyday life. The store layout is intentionally maze-like, encouraging customers to embark on a "treasure hunt" experience, with at least 300 new items introduced each month

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a highly organized and analytical Buying & Inventory Coordinator to support purchasing, inventory management, replenishment, and product availability across our stores. This role works closely with Stores, Warehouse, Buying, Merchandising, and Operations to ensure inventory supports business and sales needs.



Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment across stores.
  • Manage inventory transfers, allocations, and product availability.
  • Create, maintain, and track purchase orders and deliveries.
  • Analyze sales trends, inventory movement, and stock performance.
  • Identify shortages, excess, and slow-moving inventory and recommend solutions.
  • Prepare inventory reports and support forecasting and planning.
  • Resolve inventory, shipment, and purchase order discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with Stores, Warehouse, Buying, Merchandising, Planning, and Operations.
  • Qualifications & Skills
  • 1–3 years of experience in inventory, buying, replenishment, merchandising, or retail operations.
  • Retail experience preferred.
  • Strong analytical and inventory planning skills.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
  • Experience with ERP, inventory, or purchasing systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.


Why Join Flying Tiger Copenhagen?

Join a creative, fast-growing global brand as we expand in Canada. You’ll have the opportunity to make an impact, collaborate across teams, and grow your career with us.

Pay Range: $40,000–$46,000 annually
This is a vacant position.

Fox Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process and will be handled confidentially.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomi, Syynimaan päiväkoti
description:
Haluatko asteen verran paremman työpaikan? Tulepa töihin Oulun kaupungin varhaiskasvatukseen!

Meillä tutkitusti viihdytään työssä: saat kannustavat ja innostavat työkaverit ja esihenkilön. Saat kehittyä ja kouluttautua, ja halutessasi pääset myös työkiertoon. Olemme aina kansallisen kehittämisen kärjessä. Meistä alkaa oululainen yhtenäisen kasvun ja opin polku. Tule lapsiystävälliseen Ouluun tekemään kulttuuri-ilmastonmuutosta!

Haettavana on VARHAISKASVATUKSEN SOSIONOMIN vakinainen tehtävä Syynimaan päiväkodissa.

Syynimaan päiväkoti sijaitsee rauhallisella Syynimaan asuinalueella. Iso piha-alue tarjoaa erinomaiset mahdollisuudet erilaisiin ulkona tapahtuviin toimintoihin. Piha-aidan takana oleva metsäpiha tarjoaa hyvät mahdollisuudet laajentaa ryhmittäin ulkoilualuetta vuorotteluperiaatteella. Päiväkodissa on kolme lapsiryhmää. Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin tehtävä sijoittuu työsuhteen alkaessa alle 3-vuotiaiden ryhmä Aamuruskoon.

Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin tehtävänä on tuoda yhteisöllisiä, yhteiskunnallisia ja sosiaalipedagogisia näkökulmia pedagogiseen työhön. Työssä vaaditaan varhaiskasvatuslain, asetusten sekä valtakunnallisen ja Oulun kaupungin varhaiskasvatus- ja esiopetussuunnitelmien hallintaa.

Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin työ tukee lapsen kokonaisvaltaista kehitystä. Työ perustuu asiakaslähtöisyyteen sekä lapsia ja perheitä kunnioittavaan yhdenvertaiseen ja tasa-arvoiseen kohteluun. Tehtäviin kuuluu lapsen yksilöllistä ohjausta, yhteistyötä vanhempien kanssa sekä lasten hyvinvoinnin seurantaa yhdessä varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan ja muun varhaiskasvatuksen tiimin kanssa.

Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018 27§) mukainen kelpoisuus huomioiden varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 henkilöstöä koskevan siirtymäsäännöksen (75§) mukaiset hakijat. Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin tehtäviin on vähintään sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto, johon sisältyvät varhaiskasvatukseen ja sosiaalipedagogiikkaan suuntautuneet vähintään 60 opintopisteen laajuiset opinnot, joista voidaan säätää tarkemmin valtioneuvoston asetuksella, tai sosionomin tutkinto, jota on täydennetty mainituilla opinnoilla.

Tehtävä edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ihmissuhdetaitoja lasten, perheiden ja henkilöstön kanssa sekä kykyä ymmärtää asiakasperheiden ja henkilöstön erilaisia tilanteita. Lisäksi tehtävässä vaaditaan kykyä tiimi- ja työparityöskentelyyn.

Varhaiskasvatuksen sosionomin tehtäväkohtainen palkka muodostuu tasopalkkajärjestelmän sekä osaamisen ja vastuun tasojen mukaisesti 2 866,22 € - 2 961,73 € välille. Varsinainen palkka koostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta ja mahdollisista muista KVTES:n mukaisista tasolisistä.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Tartuntatautilain 55 §:n mukaan työnantajan vastuulla on vaatia ennen töiden aloittamista työntekijältä ja harjoittelijalta/opiskelijalta luotettava selvitys siitä, ettei tämä sairasta hengityselinten tuberkuloosia. Selvitys tehdään ennen työsopimuksen tekemistä.

Tehtävässä käytetään kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55A. Kirjallisessa hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/13851/2026 . Oulun kaupunki ei käytä tekoälyä hakemusten käsittelyssä. title: SPK Campus - Aircraft Parts/Inventory Control Clerk
description:
Aircraft Parts/Inventory Control Clerks offer a tremendous amount of value to FLT Academy and their full-time maintenance staff. The Parts Clerk constitutes a very important link in the supply chain between FLT Academy Maintenance and our suppliers and vendors. FLT Academy utilizes parts clerks to build and foster relationships with suppliers and vendors, digitally track and maintain parts inventories, research part numbers and issue parts orders as requested by maintainers and conduct monthly and quarterly audits on inventory and parts expenses.

Duties

Duties of a Parts Clerk include, but are not limited to, the following:

  1. Daily control of parts inventory
  2. Monitor minimum parts inventory
  3. Research part numbers for ordering accuracy
  4. Reorder items that are considered consumable and that FLT maintains a continuous inventory of
  5. Track and order items requested by aircraft mechanics
  6. Inventory parts into FLT Academy’s inventory system, and remove and issue them from inventory as required
  7. Reviews purchase order claims and contracts for conformance
  8. File warranty cards, as necessary
  9. Conduct bi-annual physical inventory count


Requirements

  1. High school diploma or equivalent required
  2. 1-year aircraft illustrated parts manual experience
  3. High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, with an emphasis on Word and Excel and Access
  4. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and an ability to communicate clearly and concisely
  5. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact at all levels of the organization
  6. Must be able to prioritize multiple tasks by levels of importance and urgency
  7. Strong focus on customer service, support the FLT Academy network of bases, and maintenance department
  8. Willingness to ‘dig in’, recommend, plan, and execute initiatives
  9. Shipping and receiving experience
  10. Inventory stocking/tracking experience
  11. Administration of warrant parts, cores, other administrative tasks
  12. Regular attendance and punctuality is required
  13. Physical requirements include climbing ladders, lifting heavy objects, working on your feet for many hours per day.
  14. As part of the maintenance team, you may be required to occasionally work after hours and weekends
  15. Must possess a valid driver’s license and have access to an automobile in good repair

Preferences

  1. Parts Department experience preferred
  2. Aircraft purchasing experience preferred
  3. Experience in working with and leading diverse teams is preferred

Working Conditions & Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, use hands and arms to reach. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. The employee must be able to frequently bend, twist, lift, and practice safe lifting methods.

Salary Info and Job Outlook

This position is a full-time position, 35-40 hours per week. FLT Academy offers competitive benefits with paid time off, paid federal holidays, and matching 401(k) program.

title: Airline Cargo Coordinator
company: Japan Airlines Co., Ltd. Helsinki Regional Office
description:
Japan Airlines is one of the World-renowned international airlines established in Japan in 1951. We have been operating direct flights between Helsinki and Tokyo since 2013.

We are looking for a hardworking, adaptable, communicative member to join our Helsinki cargo team to ensure the team's consistent delivery of high-standard safety, smooth and timely cargo operation at Helsinki airport. We expect you to start working with us in the first quarter of 2027 (the actual schedule for joining will be confirmed later).

Core tasks of this job:

Airline Cargo Coordinator's duties include the provision of safety and to contribute to maximizing the cargo revenue by coordinating the work of cargo handling stakeholders and supervising entrusted companies' work quality, as well as by taking care of office tasks related to cargo handling.

Your typical tasks are:

  • Cargo handling preparation by coordinating information with stakeholders.

  • Supervision of the work quality of stakeholders (following company's safety rules etc.).

  • Confirming and inputting cargo data to JAL's systems in different stages of cargo handling process.

  • Office tasks such as cargo accounting work and reporting.

  • Dealing with customer claims/inquiries.

  • Participation in meetings with cargo stakeholders.

What we expect from you:

Below is the list of what we expect from applicants:

  • At least 18 years old and eligibility to work in Finland.

  • At least a high school level education and at least 2-3 years of professional experience in cargo business.

  • A clean background (standard security clearance is needed for working in the restricted area of the airport).

  • Excellent written and spoken English skills.

  • Readiness to work on weekends and on national holidays as well as depending on the flight schedule.

  • Knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft Office applications.

  • Flexibility to expand your role, cross-train, and take on additional operational duties in the future as business needs evolve.

  • Strong organizational skills, prioritizing skills, resilience as well as a strict safety mindset.

  • Ability to build and maintain positive relationships within the team.

What we consider as an advantage:

  • Knowledge of cargo terminal operation.

  • Knowledge of cargo regulations (Customs etc.).

  • Business-level written and spoken Japanese skills.

  • Business-level written and spoken Finnish skills.

  • Cultural agility and adaptability to diverse business environments.

title: Part-Time Doorstep Waste Removal

title: Senior Solutions Designer – Oracle Siebel CRM / Adobe AEM
description:
Position: Solutions Designer – Senior
Client: Enterprise Financial Services Division, Ministry of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement (Ontario Public Service)
Location: 222 Jarvis St., Toronto, ON
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite – 5 days/week
Contract: October 13, 2026 – March 31, 2027
Extension: Possible, subject to client requirements
Openings: 1
Clearance: No security clearance required
Submission Limit: 1 candidate
Position Overview
The Ontario Public Service is seeking a Senior Solutions Designer to design and develop technology solutions supporting complex enterprise applications and business initiatives within the Enterprise Financial Services Division.
The successful candidate will bring 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions using Oracle Siebel CRM and/or Adobe AEM, with strong experience translating business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.
The resource will work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, technical teams, architects, developers, QA teams, and other project members to design scalable, highly available, accessible, and sustainable solutions.
Important: This is a 100% onsite position at 222 Jarvis St., Toronto, Monday to Friday. The resource must be available to work 7.25 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM, excluding lunch.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design hosting and application technology solutions based on client business requirements, OPS standards, policies, architecture principles, best practices, and cost models.
  • Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements.
  • Develop business design documents and document functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Develop high-level application flows that support and demonstrate business requirements.
  • Develop detailed functional design documents.
  • Create detailed process flows and high-level screen designs mapping business process steps to application views.
  • Design solutions that incorporate user experience, accessibility, WCAG, and AODA requirements.
  • Conduct or support user research and usability testing.
  • Develop user personas and user journey maps.
  • Analyze user feedback and translate identified issues and pain points into solution improvements.
  • Create wireframes and high-fidelity mockups using tools such as Figma or Adobe XD.
  • Develop use cases, including business and system use cases, and identify/document business rules.
  • Create and analyze business requirements documentation.
  • Identify solution risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Develop QA plans and write test cases.
  • Develop and document UAT test strategies, scenarios, and plans.
  • Create and maintain business architecture artefacts.
  • Develop application screen mockups and screen flows and translate workflows into wireframes/prototypes.
  • Develop application view visibility and CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) matrices.
  • Apply industry standards and best practices when evaluating and designing technology solutions.
  • Assess existing systems for technical performance, capacity, scalability, and suitability.
  • Make recommendations regarding system enhancement, expansion, renovation, migration, or replacement.
  • Participate in planning, migration, implementation, and sustainment of large and complex technology initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, products, and technology trends against short- and long-term client requirements.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to bridge business requirements and technical solutions.
  • Support change management activities and apply appropriate change management methodologies.
  • Prepare technical documentation and solution design materials.
  • Work effectively within large, multidisciplinary teams and meet aggressive project timelines.


Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications
Candidates must demonstrate all of the following:
1. Oracle Siebel CRM / Adobe AEM – 7+ Years
  • At least 7+ years of experience designing solutions using Oracle Siebel CRM or Adobe AEM technologies.
  • 7+ years of experience with Siebel and/or Adobe AEM solution implementation.

  • Experience developing business design documents.
  • Experience defining and documenting functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Experience developing high-level application flows supporting business requirements.
  • Experience developing functional design documents.

  • Demonstrated experience creating and updating business architecture artefacts.
4. Solution Design & Application Flows
  • Experience creating detailed process flows.
  • Experience developing high-level screen designs that map process steps to application views.
  • Experience developing application screen mockups and screen flows.
  • Experience translating screen designs and workflows into wireframes and/or prototypes.
5. Business Requirements & Use Cases
  • Demonstrated experience creating and analyzing business requirements documents.
  • Demonstrated experience developing business/system use cases.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying and documenting business rules.
6. UX / Accessibility
  • Experience designing solutions incorporating user experience and accessibility requirements, including WCAG/AODA.
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
  • Experience developing user personas and user journey maps.
  • Experience analyzing user feedback and designing solutions addressing user issues and pain points.
  • Experience creating wireframes and high-fidelity mockups using Figma, Adobe XD, or equivalent UI prototyping software.
7. Testing / QA
  • Demonstrated experience creating QA plans and writing test cases.
  • Demonstrated experience documenting test strategies, scenarios, and plans for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
8. Risk & Problem Solving
  • Demonstrated experience identifying project/solution risks and providing appropriate solutions or mitigation strategies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
9. Change Management
  • Demonstrated experience with change management methodologies.
10. CRUD / Application Design
  • Experience developing application view visibility and CRUD matrices.
11. RUP
  • Demonstrated experience with Rational Unified Process (RUP).
12. Communication & Collaboration
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to develop and present new ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with both functional and technical teams.
  • Ability to work as part of a large project team and collaborate closely with individual team members.
  • Ability to bridge client business requirements with technical team solutions.
  • Proven ability to work under pressure, manage aggressive timelines, and adapt to changing priorities.
Additional Technical & Solution Design Experience
Strong candidates should also demonstrate experience with:
  • Integrated networking technologies
  • Mainframe and midrange server technologies
  • Enterprise storage and SAN technologies
  • Personal computer/system technologies
  • Enterprise infrastructure and architecture
  • OPS directory and messaging standards
  • Infrastructure policies, procedures, and standards
  • Facility infrastructure/service delivery processes
  • Technology cost models and procurement processes
  • Security and recovery procedures
  • Technical specifications for installation, testing, and performance
  • Performance and capacity assessment
  • Highly available and mission-critical applications
  • Large, complex system development and implementation projects
  • Technology migration and sustainment
  • Technology evaluation and modernization
  • Cost/benefit analysis
  • Basic project management methodologies, including PMBOK
  • Analytical tools and processes
Public Sector / OPS Experience
Prior Ontario Public Service (OPS) or broader public-sector experience is strongly preferred.
Candidates with experience working within government environments should be able to demonstrate familiarity with:
  • Government enterprise architecture and technology standards
  • Public-sector governance and documentation practices
  • Corporate QA standards
  • Large-scale government technology implementations
  • Government business processes and stakeholder environments
Public Sector Assets
The following would be considered assets:
  • Experience with a Public Sector Transfer Payment / Grant Model.
  • Experience ensuring that corporate QA standards are followed and maintained.
  • Previous Ontario Public Service or other Canadian public-sector experience.
Strong Asset
Oracle Policy Automation / Oracle Intelligent Advisor
  • Experience working with Oracle Policy Automation (OPA) and/or Oracle Intelligent Advisor (OIA) is a strong asset.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a Senior Solutions Designer with 7+ years of Siebel CRM and/or Adobe AEM solution design and implementation experience, combined with strong business analysis, functional design, UX, accessibility, architecture documentation, testing, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
The candidate should be comfortable moving between business requirements and technical solution design, producing detailed design artefacts, application flows, wireframes, prototypes, test documentation, and architecture-related deliverables.
Prior OPS/public-sector experience is highly preferred, particularly experience working within large government environments and enterprise financial/service-delivery initiatives.

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer
description:
Location: Mountain View,California,United States

*This role is hybrid with 3 days/week onsite at our Mountain View office*

About Us:

Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. We serve customers in the solar, wind, insurance, construction, real estate, and critical infrastructure industries. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here!

About the Role:

As a Senior Mechatronics Engineer, you will be responsible for keeping our fleet of inspection hardware, from aircraft-mounted infrared sensors to custom drone payloads and crawler robots, running reliably in the field and applying what we learn to the next generation of our systems.

Your time will be split between supporting deployed systems and leading new design efforts. Field support involves remotely diagnosing off-nominal behavior, tracing it to root causes across mechanical, electrical, and software domains, and designing the fixes. You will also lead the design of new systems, bringing lessons from the field into the next build. If you enjoy SSH-ing into a misbehaving unit, reading the logs, and working out whether the culprit is a physical connector, a firmware state, or a tolerance stack, we want to hear from you.

This role will be based out of our office and lab space in Mountain View. You'll be expected to spend at least 3 days a week in the office, given the hands-on nature of the role.

Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose field deployed systems and drive root cause to resolution
  • Lead mechanical and electrical design improvements that address field failures and improve reliability, from CAD changes to parts, assemblies, and drawings to updates in circuits, wiring, and harnesses
  • Bring field experience and learnings into new sensor and payload designs, advocating for serviceability, diagnosability, and robustness from the start
  • Work closely with data capture software engineers, hardware technicians, and operations personnel to ensure fixes and improvements are successfully deployed
  • Guide junior engineers and technicians in debugging methods and root-cause thinking

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Aerospace Engineering (or a related field) and 5+ years of hands-on experience with complex electromechanical systems
  • Fluency in a professional CAD package (we use the Autodesk suite for parts, assemblies, and production drawings)
  • Comfort reading schematics and wiring diagrams covering sensors, compute, and power distribution
  • Working command-line skills, including SSH, navigating the filesystem, and pulling and filtering logs (e.g., journalctl, grep, tail)
  • A demonstrated, structured approach to diagnosing failures where the fault could be mechanical, electrical, or software, and the ability to explain your reasoning
  • Clear, concise writing and the ability to translate technical findings into actionable updates for cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to travel up to 5% of the time to support field deployments and operations at customer and partner sites
  • A track record of using AI tools to speed up engineering work, such as triaging logs, drafting scripts, or working through design problems, along with the discernment to recognize their limitations and verify their output

Day-to-Day Tools/Technical Environment:

  • Autodesk suite (Fusion 360, Fusion Electronics, Fusion Simulation)
  • Replica testbed systems for hardware in the loop validation testing
  • Scripting where helpful in Python and Bash
  • Enterprise level AI tooling available and encouraged

What’s Included:

  • Feel great about your work as you join a leading mission-driven intelligent aerial imaging company - our goal is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure, and you personally will play a large part in making this happen!
  • Autonomy and upward mobility
  • Diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture: a place where your voice matters
  • Competive salary with an annual 12% bonus and stock options
  • Your choice of multiple medical insurance plans, including options with an HSA and 100% coverage of the premium for yourself and your dependents
  • 100% paid dental and vision insurance
  • Unlimited PTO: We mean it when we say we prioritize work-life balance and mental health

This role has a base salary range of $150,000 - $180,000 USD, plus a target annual bonus and eligibility for stock options. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location within the USA.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

We are recruiting outstanding software developers with 5+ years full stack experience. Successful candidates should be excelling in their current role, and we will offer a generous remuneration increase to join our multinational team who work remotely in Europe.

We develop, supply and support a modern, state of the art enterprise cloud service for the logistics industry which is world class in all respects. Our Azyra Cloud Intelligence system running on the Azure cloud is the driving force for a rapidly growing list of 150+ companies in 15 countries.

Work with professionals

Our business is owned and managed by our development team, so you’ll always be working with talented professionals who understand and value your skills.

Work from home

All our people work remotely. They live in 8 countries and work from their home or coworking offices. We chat every day on Teams and meet up socially at least 3 times a year.

Work life balance

We have an excellent working environment — for example, we don’t do overtime, so you have the energy for a full life which is the basis of a true professional.

Salary and Benefits

We have a very positive remuneration policy to ensure that you share in the success and growth of our business. We also provide ongoing professional education and learning. In March 2026 we met in Zell am See for hiking, skiing, snowboarding, dining and board games. In September we will meet up in Prague and our Christmas meet up will be in Dublin.

Backend Development

Our Developers work on all aspects of modern IT through all stages of development – from initial requirement, through specification, prototyping, development, testing, release and continuous detailed improvement. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to work on IaC, Platform engineering, automations, and networking. All in addition to their core software development.

Technologies

We use C#, X#, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Office, EDI, APIs, PowerShell and Azure Cloud. Our code is in Git and all our infrastructure is in the Microsoft Azure Cloud. Our GUI is data-driven WPF. Our mobile and web apps are developed in C#, Blazor, ASP and Xamarin.

No dead code

We are continually modernising all aspects of our code, to ensure continued performance and ensure maintainability. The business understands the value of balancing refactoring alongside new features.

Cloud native

We have moved all of our clients from running our software on premises into the cloud. We are taking advantage of huge efficiencies this enables and pivoting further into a fully cloud native application.

Application areas

Our Azyra enterprise system handles order processing, purchasing, supply chain, warehousing, financials, CRM, HR, web portals, smartphones, IoT, maps, Office 365 integration, business intelligence, EDI and APIs.

Versatile

Everything we do is agile, collaborative, holistic and to world class standards. There are always an infinite number of ways of doing anything in software, so we treat every project as a learning experience and react quickly to new knowledge and changing circumstances.

Research and development

We solve every new requirement by researching and developing new components and enhancing existing components. This continual investment gives us many times the productivity and innovation of our competitors.

Technical Management

Top level decision making is made by people that understand technical issues. This frees us from arbitrary deadlines and allows us to focus on quality without having to worry about crunch.

Role

  • All areas of software development
  • Mostly back end focused
  • Desktop, web, mobile
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • SaaS
  • Object oriented development
  • Evolution of in-house frameworks

Requirements

  • Ability to work fluently in English
  • 5+ years full stack experience with a software development company
  • Impressive record of career progress
  • Top class honours degree in Engineering, IT, Maths or Science
  • Top level of skill in C# or Java
  • Significant experience with:
    • Teamwork development with Git
    • SQL
    • Business Systems
  • Attention to detail combined with imagination
  • Practical approach to real world problems

Nice to have

  • Blazor experience
  • MAUI experience
  • Azure mastery
  • Knowledge of distributed systems
  • ASP.NET Core

title: HealthCare Financial Reimbursement Analyst
description:
About AmeriPharma

AmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis. We value new ideas, creativity, and productivity. We like people who are passionate about their roles and people who like to grow and change as the company evolves.


AmeriPharma’s Benefits

  • Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life that fits your lifestyle and goals
  • Competitive total rewards package
  • Employee assistance program to assist with mental health, legal questions, financial counseling etc.
  • Comprehensive PTO and sick leave options
  • 401k program
  • Plenty of opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Company sponsored outings and team-building events
  • Casual Fridays


Job Summary

The role supports the Director of Revenue Integrity and Director of Patient Retention in the financial review process, ensuring cost-effectiveness by analyzing new referrals, existing patients’ health plan fee schedules, and other reimbursement databases. Key responsibilities include evaluating payer reimbursement methodologies, reviewing patient insurance benefits, and educating patients about available drug brands and copayment assistance programs. This position is designed to enhance patient onboarding and ongoing care by ensuring new and existing patients are informed of all available healthcare benefit options.


Schedule Details

Location: Laguna Hills, CA. (This is an on-site position; remote work is not an option at this time.)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, with hours scheduled anytime between 6:30 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., based on department and leadership needs.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist with the reimbursement review and determination process within specialty operations.
  • Review new referrals to ensure cost-effectiveness based on payer fee schedules and/or contracted rates, utilizing both In/Out-of-Network benefits from the patient’s health plan.
  • Generate ad-hoc reports on profitability, cancellations, and other relevant categories.
  • Educate and guide patients on AmeriPharma's products and services, including financial assistance options when applicable.
  • Provide clear explanations of healthcare insurance benefits, including coverage details, copayments, deductibles, and network restrictions.
  • Accurately document patient interactions, insurance details, and other relevant information in the electronic health record (EHR) system. Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and all applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Strong patient care and customer service skills.
  • Strong business acumen, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Knowledge of medical and pharmacy reimbursement methodologies.
  • Familiarity with various types of health insurance benefits and patient access/copayment assistance programs in the marketplace.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities in different areas of the department on an as-needed basis or determined by management.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, collaboration, and service excellence.


Required Qualifications and Education

  • Associates degree.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in specialty pharmacy setting
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with payer reimbursement methodologies within the healthcare revenue specialty reimbursement industry; experience with Medicare Part B & D is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and basic data entry functions.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in specialty pharmacy, home infusion, medical billing, or copay assistance programs strongly preferred.


AmeriPharma’s Mission Statement

Our goal is to achieve superior clinical and economic outcomes while maintaining the utmost compassion and care for our patients. It is our joint and individual responsibility daily to demonstrate to outpatients, prescribers, colleagues, and others that We Care!


Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is continuously required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

The duties and responsibilities of this position are subject to change and other duties may be assigned or removed at any time. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Position: Product Manager – Senior
Location: Toronto / Peterborough, Ontario
Work Arrangement: 100% Onsite – 5 days per week
Contract: November 2, 2026 – March 31, 2027
Extension: Up to 1 additional term
Openings: 1
Security Clearance: No clearance required
Ministry: Ministry of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement
Organization: Government Services Integration Cluster
Closing Date: October 13, 2026 at 12:00 PM EST
Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, discovery, delivery, and ongoing evolution of large-scale digital and IT products within the Government of Ontario.
The successful candidate will combine strong product management, Agile delivery, stakeholder engagement, technology, and governance expertise. This role requires someone who can translate complex business needs into actionable product strategies, roadmaps, user stories, and delivery priorities while working closely with executives, business stakeholders, architects, developers, and cross-functional Agile teams.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, and Dataverse, along with knowledge of enterprise architecture, APIs, integration patterns, modernization, privacy, security, and public-sector governance.
Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy, Vision & Roadmap
  • Define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, objectives, and roadmap.
  • Align product priorities with business goals, strategic objectives, enterprise direction, and technology investments.
  • Conduct product discovery to identify user, business, and operational needs.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation, modernization, process improvement, and digital transformation.
  • Develop business cases, value propositions, investment recommendations, and product options.
  • Establish product success measures, KPIs, and outcome-based performance metrics.
  • Lead the ongoing product lifecycle from strategy and discovery through delivery, release, and operations.
Stakeholder & Relationship Management
  • Engage executives, business partners, subject matter experts, technology teams, architects, and other stakeholders to understand priorities and requirements.
  • Lead stakeholder consultations, discovery sessions, workshops, interviews, and product discussions.
  • Build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups and effectively manage competing priorities.
  • Demonstrate exceptional stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Communicate product vision, roadmap, progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Facilitate negotiation, conflict resolution, and consensus-building activities.
  • Influence executive decision-making through strong analysis, communication, and recommendations.
Agile Product Delivery
  • Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, user needs, strategic priorities, and technical considerations.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product features.
  • Lead and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and demonstrations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, architects, UX, QA, and other delivery professionals.
  • Support quality assurance, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and implementation activities.
  • Manage product releases and ensure delivery aligns with agreed scope, priorities, outcomes, and timelines.
  • Apply Agile, Scrum, and Lean product development practices.
  • Ensure products meet business, operational, accessibility, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
Technology & Modernization Leadership
  • Work closely with enterprise architects, solution architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and digital standards.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud services, APIs, integration patterns, and application modernization.
  • Apply hands-on knowledge of the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including:
    • Microsoft Dynamics 365
    • Microsoft Power Platform
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Microsoft Dataverse
  • Evaluate technology and solution options from business, technical, operational, cost, risk, scalability, and sustainability perspectives.
  • Support large-scale digital transformation and application modernization initiatives.
  • Ensure product decisions align with enterprise technology direction and long-term sustainability.
  • Monitor product performance, user feedback, operational metrics, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Support and maintain product/project governance documentation and artifacts.
  • Develop and maintain Project Charters, Project Change Requests (PCRs), business cases, decision records, risk registers, status reports, executive briefings, and related governance documentation.
  • Identify, assess, track, and mitigate product risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints.
  • Lead or coordinate activities related to:
    • Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA)
    • Threat Risk Assessments (TRA)
    • Security risk assessments
    • Technology risk management
    • Privacy and compliance reviews
  • Participate in architecture review, investment planning, portfolio management, and governance processes.
  • Maintain appropriate product/project information, financial tracking, status reporting, and governance artifacts within approved enterprise tools such as Planview.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable privacy, security, accessibility, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.


Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
Product Management & Digital Delivery
  • Minimum 5 years of Product Management experience in IT or digital services.
  • Proven experience leading enterprise-scale products from strategy through delivery and ongoing operations.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale digital or IT transformation initiatives or delivering user-centric products in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience defining and communicating product vision and strategy.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting product discovery.
  • Strong experience developing and managing product roadmaps.
  • Proven experience with backlog management, prioritization, and release planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to align technology investments and product priorities with measurable business outcomes.
Agile / Scrum / Lean
  • Hands-on experience working within Agile delivery, Scrum, and Lean product development environments.
  • Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and user stories.
  • Experience working through product planning, backlog refinement, sprint delivery, testing, reviews, and releases.
Technical Skills
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Enterprise architecture
    • Cloud services
    • APIs
    • Integration patterns
    • Application modernization
  • Demonstrated experience with:
    • Microsoft Dynamics 365
    • Microsoft Power Platform
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Microsoft Dataverse
  • Ability to evaluate solution options from business, technical, operational, cost, risk, scalability, and sustainability perspectives.
  • Experience leading or coordinating PIA, TRA, and technology risk management activities.
Stakeholder & Communication Skills
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Proven ability to work with executives, business stakeholders, technical teams, architects, and subject matter experts.
  • Strong workshop facilitation and discovery skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare high-quality:
    • Executive presentations
    • Business cases
    • Product roadmaps
    • Status reports
    • Governance documentation
    • Executive briefing materials
  • Strong negotiation, conflict-management, facilitation, and consensus-building skills.
  • Ability to present complex business and technical concepts to both executive and technical audiences.
Ontario Public Sector / Governance
  • Experience with Ontario Public Service (OPS) IT project and architectural governance processes.
  • Understanding of OPS project, architecture, and governance practices.
  • Ability to operate within complex government/public-sector environments.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Knowledge of OPS Digital Standards.
  • Knowledge of OPS privacy requirements.
  • Knowledge of OPS cybersecurity practices.
  • Previous experience working with the Ontario Public Service (OPS).
  • Previous experience in government or broader public-sector organizations.
  • Experience delivering products using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Experience supporting large-scale digital transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • CSPO, PSPO, PMP, or equivalent product/project management certification.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidate will be a Senior Product Manager / Product Owner / IT Product Leader with 5+ years of relevant product management experience who has successfully delivered enterprise-scale digital products in complex environments.
The candidate should be equally comfortable discussing product strategy with executives, facilitating discovery with business stakeholders, managing a product backlog with Agile teams, and collaborating with architects and developers on Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, APIs, integrations, and modernization.
Candidates with OPS or broader public-sector experience, strong governance knowledge, and hands-on experience with PIA/TRA, privacy, security, and architectural governance will be highly preferred.
Work Arrangement & Other Requirements
  • 100% onsite – 5 days per week.
  • Primary locations include 40 St Clair Ave W, Toronto and 300 Water Street, Peterborough.
  • Must be available for the full contract period beginning November 2, 2026.
  • Must be comfortable working in a highly collaborative, enterprise/public-sector environment.
  • No security clearance is required.
  • Only 1 candidate will be submitted for this requirement.
Recruiter Screening – Must Confirm
Before submitting, recruiters should confirm that the candidate has:
  1. 5+ years of IT/digital Product Management experience.
  2. Enterprise-scale product strategy-to-delivery experience.
  3. Product vision, strategy, discovery, and roadmap experience.
  4. Backlog management, prioritization, and release planning experience.
  5. Hands-on Agile, Scrum, and Lean experience.
  6. Cross-functional Agile delivery team experience.
  7. Ability to translate business needs into requirements and user stories.
  8. Enterprise architecture, cloud, API, and integration knowledge.
  9. Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, and Dataverse.
  10. Large-scale digital/IT transformation experience.
  11. Experience with PIA, TRA, and technology risk management.
  12. Exceptional stakeholder engagement and executive communication skills.
  13. Strong workshop facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, and consensus-building skills.
  14. OPS IT project and architectural governance experience.
  15. Understanding of OPS Digital Standards, privacy, and cybersecurity is preferred.
  16. Ability to work 100% onsite, 5 days/week.
  17. Availability for the November 2, 2026 start date.
  18. Rate alignment with the $918/day maximum bill rate.
  19. No conflicting assignment or availability restrictions.
This is a highly competitive Senior Product Manager requirement, so candidates should not be submitted unless the resume clearly demonstrates the mandatory Product Management, Microsoft technology, Agile delivery, stakeholder, transformation, and OPS governance experience.

title: Project Manager, Houston
description:
Butcher Power Products is a Panelmatic copmpany.

At Panelmatic, we design and manufacture high-performance electrical and control systems that drive efficiency and reliability across the industrial, utility, renewable energy, and data center markets. With over 60 years of experience, our solutions include precision-built control panels and fully integrated control houses. These systems are trusted by customers who demand uptime, safety, and long-term performance.

Now backed by strategic investment, Panelmatic is scaling rapidly to meet the evolving needs of our customers. About the Role

The Opportunity
This role is ideal for an experienced Project Manager who thrives in a fast-paced, engineered-to-order manufacturing environment and enjoys managing both customer relationships and complex project execution.

You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of strategic projects while maintaining strong customer relationships, driving internal accountability, protecting profitability, and ensuring successful project outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Manage contractual requirements, scope changes, customer requests, and project documentation.
  • Drive accountability across all supporting functions to ensure project milestones and delivery commitments are achieved.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on execution excellence, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
  • Serve as the escalation point for project-related issues and coordinate corrective actions when needed.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

What We're Looking For
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Business, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of Project Management experience managing complex customer projects in engineered-to-order manufacturing, industrial, utility, power, EPC, data center, or infrastructure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project portfolios valued at approximately $100M annually.
  • Proven success managing strategic customer relationships and acting as the primary customer interface.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects involving protection and control systems, medium- and low-voltage switchgear, relay panels, motor control centers (MCCs), power distribution equipment, industrial control panels, integrated E-House/control house solutions, and other engineered electrical systems.
  • Strong understanding of project execution across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, production planning, quality, testing, logistics, and customer delivery.
  • Advanced knowledge of project planning, scheduling, forecasting, critical path management, resource planning, and project controls.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, change management, contract administration, and margin management.
  • Experience leading project reviews, customer reviews, risk reviews, and operational performance reviews.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution across Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Safety, Finance, Testing, and Sales.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues early and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and customer focus.

Leadership Profile
The ideal candidate is a proactive and customer-focused Project Manager who takes ownership of project outcomes and consistently drives execution excellence.

They possess strong leadership and communication skills, maintain credibility with customers and internal stakeholders, and effectively balance strategic priorities with day-to-day execution. They are comfortable operating in a dynamic environment, coordinating diverse teams, managing competing priorities, and driving results.

They proactively identify risks, escalate issues when necessary, challenge assumptions, and drive accountability across the organization to ensure project success.

Most importantly, they are accountable, action-oriented, and committed to delivering projects safely, on time, on margin, and to the highest quality standards while building long-term customer relationships.

Location & Travel
